詞彙題.stem: Two important secrets of long life are regular exercise and ______ from worry.
詞彙題.stemZh: 長壽的兩個重要秘訣是規律運動和____憂慮。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 自由, 自主, 免於…, 自由權利；搭配：regular exercise and ___ from worry；freedom from + N（免於…，介系詞用 from）／freedom of speech／religion（言論自由、宗教自由）／give sb the freedom to + 原形動詞（給某人做某事的自由）

詞彙題.stem: The policemen have ______ the whole area but haven't found the criminal yet.
詞彙題.stemZh: 警察已經____了整個區域，但還沒找到罪犯。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 搜查, 尋找, 搜索, 搜尋（search 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：have ___ the whole area but haven't found the criminal；search + 地點（搜查某地）／search + 地點 + for + 人或物（在某地搜尋某人或某物）／search for + 人或物（尋找）

詞彙題.stem: If you want to become a good tennis player, you have to ______ your skill.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你想成為一名優秀的網球運動員，你必須____你的技巧。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 提高, 改善, 加強, 使鋒利, 削尖；搭配：have to ___ your skill；sharpen your skills（精進技術）

詞彙題.stem: Newspapers are ______ with advertisements for all kinds of consumer goods.
詞彙題.stemZh: 報紙上____了各種消費品的廣告。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 充滿的, 裝滿的；v. 裝滿, 填滿（fill 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Newspapers are ___ with advertisements；be filled with + N（充滿…，介系詞用 with）／be filled with joy／anger／fear（充滿喜悅、憤怒、恐懼）

詞彙題.stem: After spending one hour on this math problem, John still could not ______ it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 花了一個小時解這道數學題後，約翰仍然無法____它。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 解決, 解答, 破解；搭配：still could not ___ it；solve a problem／puzzle／mystery（解決問題、解開謎題、破解謎團）／solve a case（破案）

詞彙題.stem: The ______ of the story was when the dog saved the little girl from the bad man.
詞彙題.stemZh: 故事的____是當狗從壞人手中救了小女孩的時候。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 高潮, 最精彩的部分, 頂點；搭配：The ___ of the story was when the dog saved the little girl；the climax of + N（…的高潮）／reach a climax（到達高潮）／build up to a climax（逐漸推向高潮）

詞彙題.stem: Tell me what happened at the end of the game. Don't keep me in ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 告訴我比賽最後發生了什麼。別讓我____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 懸疑, 焦慮, 懸念, 懸而不決；搭配：Don't keep me in ___；keep sb in suspense（吊某人胃口、讓某人焦急等待）／wait in suspense（焦急地等待）／be full of suspense（充滿懸疑）

詞彙題.stem: My poor test score does not ______ how much I know about this subject.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我差勁的考試成績並不能____我對這個科目了解多少。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 反映, 顯示, 反射, 深思；搭配：does not ___ how much I know about this subject；reflect + 事實或想法（反映…）／be reflected in + N（反映在…之中）／reflect on + N（仔細思考，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: The ______ I have of the principal is that of a very kind and gentle person.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我對校長的____是一位非常和藹可親的人。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 形象, 印象, 影像, 意象；搭配：The ___ I have of the principal；have an image of sb（對某人抱持某種印象）／public image（公眾形象）／project an image（塑造形象）

詞彙題.stem: My apartment has one ______ I like. It has a fireplace in the living room.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我的公寓有一個我喜歡的____。它客廳裡有一個壁爐。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 特色, 特徵, 容貌, 特寫；v. 以…為特色, 由…主演；搭配：My apartment has one ___ I like；a feature of + N（…的一項特色）／main／key／special feature（主要、關鍵、特別的特色）

詞彙題.stem: When a public official is found involved in a ______, he usually has to resign.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當一位公職人員被發現捲入____時，他通常必須辭職。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 醜聞, 醜行, 恥辱, 反感；搭配：is found involved in a ___；be involved in a lawsuit／a scandal（捲入官司／醜聞）

詞彙題.stem: The transportation in this city is terrible and people have many ______ about it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個城市的交通很糟糕，人們對此有很多____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 抱怨, 投訴, 不滿（complaint 的複數）；搭配：people have many ___ about it；make／file a complaint about + N（對…提出抱怨）

詞彙題.stem: Movies, sports and reading are forms of ______. They help us relax.
詞彙題.stemZh: 電影、運動和閱讀是____的形式。它們幫助我們放鬆。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 娛樂, 款待, 娛樂表演；搭配：are forms of ___；the entertainment industry（娛樂產業）

詞彙題.stem: After reading for nearly two hours, Carol felt ______ to go out for some fresh air.
詞彙題.stemZh: 讀了將近兩個小時的書後，卡羅感到____想出去透透氣。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 引誘, 誘惑, 想要, 想做（tempt 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Carol felt ___ to go out；be tempted to V／be sorely tempted to V（很想做某事，加 sorely 語氣更強）

詞彙題.stem: A polite person never ______ others while they are discussing important matters.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一個有禮貌的人從不在別人討論重要事情時____他們。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 打斷, 插嘴, 中斷（interrupt 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：never ___ others while they are discussing；interrupt a conversation／sb's sleep／the power supply（打斷談話、吵醒某人、中斷供電）

詞彙題.stem: Some students get ______ aid from the government to support their education.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一些學生從政府獲得____援助以支持他們的教育。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 財政的, 金融的；搭配：get ___ aid from the government；financial aid（助學金、財務援助）

詞彙題.stem: Henry, my old classmate, has ______ a true friend of mine all over the years.
詞彙題.stemZh: 亨利，我的老同學，這些年來一直____是我的摯友。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 仍然是, 保持, 留下, 剩餘（remain 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：has ___ a true friend of mine；remain + N／Adj（仍然是…，如 remain single／calm，不加 as）

詞彙題.stem: He was very shy, so his smile was barely (=hardly=scarcely) ______ when he met his teacher.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他非常害羞，所以他見到老師時的微笑幾乎不____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 顯而易見的, 顯著的, 值得注意的；搭配：his smile was barely ___；barely／hardly noticeable（幾乎看不出來）

詞彙題.stem: They had not seen each other for years until they met ______ in Taipei last week.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他們多年未見，直到上週在台北____相遇。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 偶然地, 意外地；搭配：until they met ___ in Taipei；meet sb accidentally／by chance（偶然遇到某人）

詞彙題.stem: The king was ______ for all his cruelties to the people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位國王因他對人民的所有殘酷行為而____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 惡名昭彰的, 聲名狼藉的；搭配：The king was ___ for all his cruelties；be notorious for + N／V-ing（以…惡名昭彰）

詞彙題.stem: Because Mr. Chang has been busy these days, it's _______ whether he will come to the party.
詞彙題.stemZh: 張先生這幾天很忙，他是否會來參加派對還不確定。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 不確定的, 懷疑的, 可疑的, 不太可能的；搭配：it's ___ whether he will come；it is doubtful whether + 子句（是否…還很難說）

詞彙題.stem: I'm quite ________ to the weather in Taiwan, so I think I'll stay here for another year.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我已經很習慣台灣的天氣了，所以我想我會在這裡多待一年。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 習慣於…的, 慣常的；搭配：quite ___ to the weather in Taiwan；be accustomed to + N／V-ing（習慣於…，to 是介系詞）

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Smith won't tolerate talking during class; he says it ________ others.
詞彙題.stemZh: 史密斯先生不能容忍上課時說話；他說這樣會打擾到其他人。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 打擾, 干擾, 使焦慮, 使煩惱（disturb 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：he says it ___ others；disturb + N（打擾某人，直接接受詞、不加 to）

詞彙題.stem: On the basis of the clues, can you predict the ________ of the story?
詞彙題.stemZh: 根據這些線索，你能預測這個故事的結局嗎？
詞彙題.explanation: n. 結果, 後果, 結局；搭配：can you predict the ___ of the story；predict the outcome of + N（預測…的結果）

詞彙題.stem: A good reader can often figure out what new words mean by using ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 好的讀者常常能透過上下文推敲出生字的意思。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 上下文, 背景, 來龍去脈

詞彙題.stem: I wonder why she turned up the radio ________ when I was studying.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我很好奇，為什麼我在讀書時她要故意把收音機轉大聲。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 故意地；搭配：turned up the radio ___ when I was studying；deliberately vague／ambiguous／misleading（故意講得模糊、故意誤導。配的是「刻意做出來的不明確」這一類形容詞，ambiguous 的拼字要留意）

詞彙題.stem: It suddenly ________ me that I had to get to the airport to meet a friend.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我突然想起我得去機場接朋友。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 使突然想起, 使產生…想法, 打, 撞擊, 侵襲, 罷工（strike 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：It suddenly ___ me that I had to；it strikes sb that + 子句（某人突然想到…，不加 to）

詞彙題.stem: Being a very careful person, he is quite ________ in giving his comments.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他是個很謹慎的人，發表意見時相當保留。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 保留的, 含蓄的, 拘謹的, 沉默寡言的, 預訂的；v. 預訂, 保留（reserve 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：he is quite ___ in giving his comments；be reserved in + V-ing（在…上有所保留）

詞彙題.stem: Most viewers agreed that the movie was not as good as the book ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 大多數觀眾都認為這部電影不如原著小說好看。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 版本, 說法, 譯本；搭配：not as good as the book ___；the book／film version of + N（…的書／電影版）

詞彙題.stem: The native greeted the travelers in a ________ language which was strange to them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當地人用一種對旅客來說很陌生、奇特的語言向他們打招呼。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 奇特的, 奇怪的, 古怪的, 獨特的, 特有的；搭配：travelers in a ___ language；be peculiar to + N（為…所特有，加 to 才是這個意思）
adj. 平均的, 一般的, 普通的；n. 平均數, 平均, 一般水準；搭配：The ___ of 18, 13 and 14；above／on／below average／an average salary／income／life expectancy（高於、等於、低於平均，當形容詞是「平均的」，如平均薪資、平均收入、平均壽命）

詞彙題.stem: There are many ______ that the economy will recover from a recession.
詞彙題.stemZh: 有很多____表明經濟將從衰退中復甦。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 跡象, 表明, 指示（indication 的複數）；搭配：There are many ___ that the economy will recover；there are indications that + 子句（有跡象顯示…）

詞彙題.stem: Intelligence does not ______ mean success. You need diligence as well.
詞彙題.stemZh: 聰明並不____意味著成功。你也需要勤奮。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 必然地, 必定, 不可避免地；搭配：Intelligence does not ___ mean success；not necessarily（未必、不見得）

詞彙題.stem: The report says that ______ driving has killed more than 20 persons since June.
詞彙題.stemZh: 報告稱，自六月以來，____駕駛已造成超過 20 人死亡。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 魯莽的, 輕率的, 不顧後果的；搭配：___ driving has killed more than 20 persons；reckless driving（危險駕駛）／drive recklessly（魯莽駕駛）

詞彙題.stem: How can you expect me to ______ exactly what happened twelve years ago?
詞彙題.stemZh: 你怎麼能期望我____十二年前確切發生的事情？
詞彙題.explanation: v. 回想起, 記得, 召回, 收回；n. 記憶力, 召回；搭配：expect me to ___ exactly what happened；vividly／vaguely／dimly recall／if I recall correctly（清楚地、隱約、模糊地想起，最後一個是「如果我沒記錯的話」）

詞彙題.stem: The man made a ______ effort to look happy, though deep in his heart he was very sad.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個人____努力地裝出高興的樣子，儘管內心深處他非常悲傷。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有意識的, 刻意的, 神志清醒的, 意識到的；搭配：made a ___ effort to look happy；make a conscious effort to V／budget-conscious（刻意努力去做…，另一個是「精打細算的」）

詞彙題.stem: Most children find it difficult to ______ the temptation of ice cream, especially on a hot summer day.
詞彙題.stemZh: 大多數孩子發現很難____冰淇淋的誘惑，尤其是在炎熱的夏天。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 抵抗, 抗拒, 忍住, 抵制, 反抗；搭配：difficult to ___ the temptation of ice cream；resist the temptation of + N／to V（抵抗…的誘惑）

詞彙題.stem: We cannot give you a ______ answer now; there are still many uncertainties on this issue.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們現在不能給你一個____的答案；在這個問題上還有很多不確定性。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 明確的, 一定的；搭配：give you a ___ answer now；give a definite answer（給明確的答覆）

詞彙題.stem: The report is much too long—you must ______ it, using as few words as possible.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這份報告太長了——你必須____它，用盡可能少的詞。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 縮短, 精簡（文章）, 濃縮, 凝結；搭配：you must ___ it, using as few words as possible；condense sth into + N／condensed milk（把…濃縮成…，另一個是煉乳，剉冰淋的那一種）

詞彙題.stem: Mary is having a tough time deciding whether to dress ______ or formally for the party tonight.
詞彙題.stemZh: 瑪麗很難決定今晚的派對要穿得____還是正式。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 休閒地, 隨意地, 不經意地, 臨時地；搭配：whether to dress ___ or formally；dress casually／formally（穿得隨性、穿得正式，「隨機」要用 randomly）

詞彙題.stem: I sometimes take John's coat for my own, because the two of them look so ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我有時候會把約翰的外套誤認成自己的，因為兩件外套長得太像了。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 相似的, 類似的；搭配：the two of them look so ___；be similar to + N（與…相似，不用 with）

詞彙題.stem: George at first had difficulty swimming across the pool, but he finally succeeded on his fourth ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 喬治一開始很難游過泳池，但他在第四次嘗試時終於成功了。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 嘗試, 企圖；搭配：succeeded on his fourth ___；on one's first／second attempt（第…次嘗試，用 on）

詞彙題.stem: Several motorists were waiting ________ for the light to change.
詞彙題.stemZh: 幾位駕駛人不耐煩地等著紅綠燈變燈。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 不耐煩地, 急切地, 焦急地

詞彙題.stem: Mary wrote a letter of ________ to the manufacturer after her new car broke down three times in the same week.
詞彙題.stemZh: 瑪莉的新車在同一週內故障了三次，她因此寫了一封投訴信給製造商。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 抱怨, 投訴, 不滿, 疾病；搭配：wrote a letter of ___ to the manufacturer；make a complaint about + N（對…提出申訴）

詞彙題.stem: John's poor math score must have ________ him a lot, because he is not attending the class any more.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰的數學考差了一定讓他很挫折，因為他已經不再去上那堂課了。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 使氣餒, 使洩氣, 阻止（discourage 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 洩氣的, 灰心的；搭配：must have ___ him a lot；discourage sb from + V-ing（使某人不想再做…）

詞彙題.stem: The issue of environmental protection has not received much attention until very ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 環保議題直到最近才開始受到重視。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 最近

詞彙題.stem: The old man could ________ swallow because his throat was too dry.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位老人因為喉嚨太乾，幾乎無法吞嚥。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 幾乎不, 幾乎沒有, 僅僅；搭配：The old man could ___ swallow；can hardly + V（幾乎無法…，hardly 已含否定）

詞彙題.stem: We are more than willing to ________ our ties with those countries that are friendly to us.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們非常樂意加強與這些友好國家之間的關係。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 加強, 增強, 鞏固；搭配：___ our ties with those countries；strengthen ties with + N（加強與…的關係）

詞彙題.stem: The artist is famous for his genius and great ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位藝術家以其天賦與卓越的原創性聞名。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 獨創性, 創意, 新穎；搭配：famous for his genius and great ___；be famous for one's originality（以原創性聞名）

詞彙題.stem: Although some things are ________, they nevertheless exist.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然有些東西是看不見的，但它們依然存在。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 看不見的, 無形的；搭配：Although some things are ___；be invisible to the naked eye（肉眼看不見，介系詞用 to）

詞彙題.stem: My recent trip to Europe has left a ______ impression on me.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我最近的歐洲之行給我留下了____的印象。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 持久的, 持續的, 永久的；搭配：has left a ___ impression on me；leave a lasting impression on sb（給某人留下持久的印象）／lasting peace／damage／effect（持久的和平、永久性的損害、長遠的影響）

詞彙題.stem: A ______ of migrant birds flew to our island yesterday.
詞彙題.stemZh: 昨天一群遷徙的鳥飛到了我們的島上。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 鳥群, 羊群, 一群人；v. 聚集, 蜂擁；搭配：A ___ of migrant birds flew to our island；a flock of birds／sheep（鳥群、羊群）／a flock of tourists／visitors（一群觀光客、一群訪客，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Jack fell down while playing tennis and ______ his ankle very badly.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克打網球時摔倒了，並嚴重____了他的腳踝。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 扭傷, 扭轉, 纏繞, 曲解（twist 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：and ___ his ankle very badly；twist／sprain one's ankle（扭傷腳踝）

詞彙題.stem: These two photographs are too small. Let's have them ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這兩張照片太小了。讓我們把它們____。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 放大, 擴大, 擴展（enlarge 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Let's have them ___；have sth enlarged（把某物放大）

詞彙題.stem: This museum is famous for its ______ of modern paintings.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這家博物館以其現代繪畫的____而聞名。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 收藏品, 收集, 一批（東西）, 募款；搭配：This museum is famous for its ___ of modern paintings；a collection of + N（一批…的收藏，介系詞用 of）／an art／stamp／coin collection（藝術收藏、集郵、錢幣收藏）

詞彙題.stem: The professor did his best to ______ the students with new ideas.
詞彙題.stemZh: 教授盡力讓學生____新思想。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 使熟悉, 使了解, 介紹；搭配：did his best to ___ the students with new ideas；acquaint sb with sth（使某人認識、熟悉某事物，介系詞用 with）／be acquainted with + N（對…有所認識）

詞彙題.stem: Their determination to fight to the last man was really ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他們奮戰到最後一人的決心真的很____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 令人欽佩的, 值得讚賞的, 極好的；搭配：Their determination to fight to the last man was really ___；admirable courage／determination／restraint（令人欽佩的勇氣、決心、克制）／do an admirable job（表現得很出色）

詞彙題.stem: All of us must have the ______ that there is no free lunch.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們所有人都必須有「天下沒有免費午餐」的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 意識, 認識；搭配：All of us must have the ___ that there is no free lunch；have the awareness that + 子句（有…的認知）／awareness of + N（對…的認識，介系詞用 of）／raise public awareness（喚起大眾的意識）

詞彙題.stem: A large poster in beautiful colors ______ the attention of many people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一張色彩美麗的大海報____了許多人的注意。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 抓住, 捕捉, 引起（注意）, 趕上, 感染（catch 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：A large poster in beautiful colors ___ the attention of many people；catch the attention of sb（吸引某人的注意）／catch sb's eye（引起某人注目）／catch a cold／a bus（感冒、趕上公車，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: It rains ______ this summer. The water we've got is not enough for this area.
詞彙題.stemZh: 今年夏天____下雨。我們得到的水對這個地區來說是不夠的。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 偶爾, 有時候, 間或

詞彙題.stem: The main ________ of this test is to find out how much you have learned in high school.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個測驗的主要目的是要了解你在高中學到了多少。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 目的, 目標；adj. 客觀的, 如實的, 不帶個人感情的；搭配：The main ___ of this test；the main objective of + N（…的主要目標）

詞彙題.stem: I hope to live in a student dormitory when I am in college. I am tired of ________ to school in a crowded bus every day.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我希望上大學後能住學生宿舍。我已經厭倦每天擠公車通勤上學了。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 通勤, 上下班往返；搭配：tired of ___ to school in a crowded bus；commute to school／work（通勤上學／上班）

詞彙題.stem: They were behind schedule and had to apply for ________ manpower to complete their project in time.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他們的進度落後，必須申請額外的人力才能如期完成專案。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 額外的, 特別的

詞彙題.stem: Out of ________ and consideration, I always write a thank-you note when someone sends me a gift.
詞彙題.stemZh: 出於禮貌與體貼，每當有人送我禮物時，我都會寫一張感謝卡。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 禮貌, 禮節, 謙恭, 好意；搭配：Out of ___ and consideration；out of courtesy（出於禮貌，不用 from）

詞彙題.stem: The boy ________ to the teacher for his improper behavior.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個男孩為自己不當的行為向老師道歉。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 道歉（apologize 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：___ to the teacher for his improper behavior；apologize to sb for + N（向某人道歉）

詞彙題.stem: The problem with Jane is that she tends to take criticism too ________ and gets angry easily.
詞彙題.stemZh: 珍的問題在於她常把批評看得太針對個人，容易因此生氣。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 針對個人地, 親自, 就個人而言, 當面；搭配：take criticism too ___；take sth personally（對號入座、把話當成在說自己）

詞彙題.stem: Almost everybody is a ________ of many different personalities; we show different faces to different people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 幾乎每個人都是多種不同性格的綜合體；我們對不同的人會展現不同的樣貌。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 結合, 組合, 綜合體, 混合

詞彙題.stem: John has been working at the computer for twenty-four hours. He ________ needs a good rest.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰已經在電腦前工作了 24 小時，他絕對需要好好休息一下。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 顯然, 明顯地, 顯而易見地

詞彙題.stem: Nowadays students can ________ information from a variety of sources, such as computers, television, and compact discs.
詞彙題.stemZh: 現今學生可以從電腦、電視、光碟等各種來源取得資訊。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 取得, 存取, 進入, 到達；n. 通道, 進入的權利, 使用權；搭配：students can ___ information；access + N（取得…，當動詞時不加 to）

詞彙題.stem: Sorry for being late. Someone gave me ________ directions and I got totally lost.
詞彙題.stemZh: 抱歉遲到了。有人給了我錯誤的指路方向，害我完全迷路了。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有缺陷的, 錯誤的, 有瑕疵的, 不完美的

詞彙題.stem: Doctors have repeatedly warned people of the serious @@effect@@ of noise on their hearing.
詞彙題.stemZh: 醫生一再警告大眾，噪音對聽力有嚴重的影響。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 影響, 衝擊, 撞擊；v. 對…產生影響；搭配：effect of noise on their hearing；have an impact on + N（對…造成影響）

詞彙題.stem: People who are @@determined@@ cannot be easily stopped from doing what they want to do.
詞彙題.stemZh: 意志堅定的人不會輕易被阻止去做他們想做的事。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 意志堅強的；搭配：People who are determined；be determined to + V（決心要做…）

詞彙題.stem: The bridge @@collapsed@@ under the weight of the heavy truck.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這座橋在重型卡車的重量下倒塌了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　倒塌，屈服，讓步（give in 的過去式）；搭配：collapsed under the weight；give in to + N（屈服於…、讓步）

詞彙題.stem: My @@initial@@ offer was turned down politely. But when I tried again in my most sincere tone, it was gladly accepted.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我一開始的提議被有禮貌地回絕了。但當我用最誠懇的語氣再次提出時，對方欣然接受了。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 最初的, 原始的, 有創意的；搭配：initial offer was turned down；turn down an offer（婉拒提議）

詞彙題.stem: The outdoor concert was @@canceled@@ because of rain.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這場戶外音樂會因下雨而取消了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　取消（call off 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：outdoor concert was canceled；call off a concert／a game（取消演唱會／比賽）

詞彙題.stem: It's @@next to@@ impossible for me to finish the homework in three days.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我幾乎不可能在三天內完成這份作業。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 幾乎, 差不多；搭配：next to impossible for me；next to nothing（幾乎沒有）

詞彙題.stem: @@Every now and then@@ they go to a movie together.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他們偶爾會一起去看電影。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 偶爾, 有時候, 間或；搭配：Every now and then they go to a movie；every now and then（偶爾、時不時）

詞彙題.stem: I was @@held up@@ by a traffic jam on the freeway for about an hour.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我在高速公路上被塞車耽擱了大約一個小時。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 耽擱, 延遲, 延誤（delay 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 延誤的, 延遲的；搭配：was held up by a traffic jam；be held up by + N（被…耽擱住）

詞彙題.stem: I tell you @@once and for all@@ that you must not do such a stupid thing again.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我把話說一次講清楚：你絕對不可以再做這種蠢事了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　最後一次；搭配：I tell you once and for all；once and for all（一勞永逸、把話講到最後一次）

詞彙題.stem: I am curious about how John @@came by@@ such a large sum of money.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我很好奇約翰是怎麼得到這麼大一筆錢的。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 獲得, 得到（obtain 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：came by such a large sum of money；come by + N（設法取得、弄到）

詞彙題.stem: The functions of this machine are described ______ in the handbook.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這台機器的功能在手冊中被____描述。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 精確地, 準確地, 明確地, 恰好, 正是

詞彙題.stem: His ______ for power led him into a tragedy.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他對權力的____使他陷入悲劇。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 貪婪, 貪慾；搭配：His ___ for power led him into a tragedy；greed for power／money（對權力／金錢的貪婪，不加 of）

詞彙題.stem: The candidate found every way to ______ her election materials to the voters.
詞彙題.stemZh: 候選人想盡一切辦法將她的選舉資料____給選民。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 分發, 散發, 分配；搭配：to ___ her election materials to the voters；distribute sth to sb（把某物分發給某人）

詞彙題.stem: John is so ______ that he does not accept others' opinions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰如此____，以致他不接受別人的意見。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 倔強的, 頑固的, 不讓步的；搭配：John is so ___ that he does not accept others' opinions；an obstinate refusal／resistance（頑抗）

詞彙題.stem: Every country needs strong national ______ against enemy invasions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 每個國家都需要強大的國家____來對抗敵人的入侵。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 防衛, 國防, 防禦, 辯護, 防守；搭配：needs strong national ___ against enemy invasions；defense against + N（抵禦…的防衛）

詞彙題.stem: At the finish, the winner of the race raised her arms ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在終點，比賽的獲勝者____地舉起了雙臂。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 得意洋洋地, 興高采烈地, 耀武揚威地

詞彙題.stem: He can ______ a motorcycle if he is given all the parts.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果給他所有零件，他就能____一輛摩托車。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 組裝, 裝配, 集合, 聚集；搭配：He can ___ a motorcycle if he is given all the parts；assemble the parts／a team（把零件組裝起來／把團隊組起來）

詞彙題.stem: He told me in ______ that he would do everything to help me.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他____地告訴我他會盡一切努力幫助我。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 認真, 誠摯；adj. 認真的, 誠摯的, 鄭重的

詞彙題.stem: This exhibition of Chinese paintings is ______. Indeed, it's the best in ten years.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這次中國畫展覽是____的。的確，這是十年來最好的。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 了不起的, 絕妙的, 非凡的, 令人驚異的；搭配：This exhibition of Chinese paintings is ___；equally marvelous（同樣了不起）

詞彙題.stem: Each of these bottles ______ 1,000 cc of mineral water, and it sells for NT$50.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些瓶子每瓶____ 1,000 cc 的礦泉水，售價為新台幣 50 元。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 包含, 裝有, 容納, 控制（contain 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：Each of these bottles ___ 1,000 cc of mineral water；contain a disease／an outbreak（把疫情控制住不讓它擴散，這是 contain 在新聞裡的常用意思）

詞彙題.stem: What a small computer! Does it really ________?
詞彙題.stemZh: 好小的電腦啊！它真的能用嗎？
詞彙題.explanation: v. 運作, 運轉, 有效, 工作；n. 工作, 作品, 著作；搭配：Does it really ___；sth works（機器、辦法管用、行得通）

詞彙題.stem: For your own ________, please don't open the door until the train fully stops.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了您的安全，請等火車完全停妥後再開門。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 安全, 保險, 平安, 保安裝置；搭配：For your own ___；for one's own safety（為了自身安全，不用 safe）

詞彙題.stem: Peter told Marie that he couldn't attend her birthday party because he had been ________ engaged.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彼得告訴瑪麗，他之前已經有約了，所以無法參加她的生日派對。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 先前, 以前

詞彙題.stem: For hours, we have heard nothing but negative criticism. Why can't you say something more ________?
詞彙題.stemZh: 這幾個小時以來我們聽到的都是負面的批評。你為什麼不能說些更有建設性的話呢？
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 建設性的, 有益的, 積極的；搭配：say something more ___；constructive criticism／advice（有建設性的批評／建議）

詞彙題.stem: This library is famous for its wide ________ of books. You can find books on any topic you are interested in.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這間圖書館以藏書種類豐富聞名，你可以在這裡找到任何你感興趣主題的書。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 多樣, 種類, 變種, 雜耍；搭配：its wide ___ of books；a wide variety of + N（各式各樣的…，後面接複數名詞）

詞彙題.stem: The child was ________ . He just sat there and waited for something to happen.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個孩子很被動，他只是坐在那裡等事情發生。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 被動的, 消極的, 順從的；搭配：The child was ___；passive smoking（二手菸，被迫吸到別人的菸）

詞彙題.stem: After dinner, Richard offered to pay the bill, but May insisted that they do it ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 晚餐後，理查提議由他付帳，但梅堅持要各付各的。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 分開地, 分別地, 各自地；搭配：insisted that they do it ___；pay separately／split the bill（各付各的）

詞彙題.stem: This TV program will ________ young viewers' understanding of the changing world.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個電視節目將拓展年輕觀眾對這個變動世界的理解。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 拓展, 擴大, 變寬；搭配：___ young viewers' understanding；broaden one's horizons／knowledge（拓展視野、增廣見聞）

詞彙題.stem: I like everything about the apartment ________ the rent. It is too expensive.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我喜歡這間公寓的一切，除了租金太貴之外。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　除了...之外；搭配：everything about the apartment ___ the rent；except for + N（除了…之外）

詞彙題.stem: ________ all the newspaper and television attention, the problem of child abuse has become well-known.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於媒體（報紙與電視）大量的關注報導，兒童虐待的問題已經廣為人知。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　由於，作為...的結果；搭配：___ all the newspaper and television attention；as a result of + N（由於…）

詞彙題.stem: Tim: Someone left a schoolbag on the bus. Sam: See if ________ a name inside the bag.
詞彙題.stemZh: 提姆：有人把書包忘在公車上了。山姆：看看包包裡有沒有名字。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　有（依句意，文法測驗）

詞彙題.stem: Joe: ________ you come to our party tonight? Sue: No, but I wish I could.
詞彙題.stemZh: 喬：你今晚能來我們的派對嗎？蘇：不行，但我真希望我可以。
詞彙題.explanation: aux. 能, 可以

詞彙題.stem: Jack: I wish I were a millionaire. I could buy whatever I want. Jane: Well, it may be true. ________ we must bear in mind that the love of money is also the root of all evil.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克：我真希望我是百萬富翁，這樣我就能買任何我想要的東西。珍：這也許沒錯，但我們得記住，貪財也是萬惡之源。
詞彙題.explanation: conj. 但是

詞彙題.stem: Tony: May I have some more coffee, please? Anne: I'm sorry, but there doesn't seem to be ________ .
詞彙題.stemZh: 東尼：可以再給我一些咖啡嗎？安：不好意思，好像已經沒有剩的了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　剩下的任何（依句意，文法測驗）

詞彙題.stem: Tom: I was looking for John all afternoon. Where was he? Pete: I don't know. He ________ to a movie.
詞彙題.stemZh: 湯姆：我整個下午都在找約翰，他跑去哪了？彼得：我不知道，他可能去看電影了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　可能已經去了（依句意，文法測驗）

詞彙題.stem: Do you think Teresa asked that question @@on purpose@@?
詞彙題.stemZh: 你覺得泰瑞莎是故意問那個問題的嗎？
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 故意地, 有意地；搭配：asked that question on purpose；intentionally vague／ambiguous（同樣配「刻意做出來的不明確」那一類形容詞，deliberately 的名單見 83 推薦甄選第 6 題）

詞彙題.stem: Every Taiwanese student should know what ‘M.I.T.’ @@stands for@@.
詞彙題.stemZh: 每個台灣學生都應該知道 M.I.T. 代表什麼意思。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 代表, 表現（represent 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：what ‘M.I.T.’ stands for；stand for + N（代表、是…的縮寫）

詞彙題.stem: John’s reckless behavior @@gave rise to@@ endless trouble for his parents.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰魯莽的行為為他的父母帶來了無窮的麻煩。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 造成, 引起, 導致（cause 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：gave rise to endless trouble；give rise to concerns／problems（引發疑慮／問題）

詞彙題.stem: The idea of becoming famous @@appeals to@@ many people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 成名的念頭吸引著許多人。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 吸引（attract 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：appeals to many people；appeal to + sb（引起某人興趣、吸引某人）

詞彙題.stem: Mike fainted under the hot sun in his rice field. When he @@came to@@, he saw a stranger beside him.
詞彙題.stemZh: 麥克在稻田裡被烈日曬到暈倒。當他甦醒過來時，看到一個陌生人在他身旁。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 醒來, 喚醒（awake 的過去式）；搭配：When he came to；come to（甦醒過來，後面不接受詞）

詞彙題.stem: ______, the drowning boy was saved from the river by a soldier.
詞彙題.stemZh: ____，溺水的男孩被一名士兵從河中救了出來。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 幸運地, 幸虧

詞彙題.stem: Many businessmen are under great ______ to gain the largest market share possible.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多商人為了獲得盡可能大的市占率而承受著巨大的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 壓力, 壓迫, 催促；v. 施壓, 強迫；搭配：are under great ___ to gain the largest market share；be under pressure to + V（承受壓力去做某事，不是 have big pressure。另有 high blood pressure 高血壓）

詞彙題.stem: I know you've been waiting for a long time. Don't be ______. The train will arrive on time.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我知道你等了很久。別____。火車會準時到達。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 不耐煩的, 著急的, 急切的；搭配：Don't be ___；be impatient with sb（對某人不耐煩，不加 to）

詞彙題.stem: The performance of the musicians has really ______ all of us.
詞彙題.stemZh: 音樂家們的表演真的____了我們所有人。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 高興的, 欣喜的；v. 使高興, 使愉快（delight 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：The performance of the musicians has really ___ all of us；be delighted with／at + N（人的情緒是被影響的，所以用過去分詞 delighted，事物令人愉快才用 delightful，pleased 和 pleasant 同型）

詞彙題.stem: The ______ of this empire led to many wars with its neighboring countries.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個帝國的____導致了與鄰國的多次戰爭。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 擴張, 擴大, 擴展, 擴充, 膨脹；搭配：The ___ of this empire led to many wars；rapid expansion（快速擴張，不用 fast）

詞彙題.stem: Susan has ______ canceled her plan to study abroad, because she is now preparing for the college entrance exam.
詞彙題.stemZh: 蘇珊____取消了她的留學計畫，因為她現在正在準備大學入學考試。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 顯然, 看來, 似乎

詞彙題.stem: His personality makes it very difficult to ______ and reach an agreement with him.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他的個性使得很難與他____並達成協議。
詞彙題.explanation: vi. 商議, 談判, 交涉；搭配：very difficult to ___ and reach an agreement with him；negotiate a contract／a treaty（談定合約／條約）

詞彙題.stem: If you want to speak English without a foreigner's accent, you have to learn correct ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你想說英語沒有外國口音，你必須學習正確的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 語調, 聲調, 音準

詞彙題.stem: A ______ person usually can get along with other people well, because he does not insist on his own opinion.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一個____的人通常能和別人相處得很好，因為他不堅持自己的意見。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 靈活的, 可變通的, 可彎曲的, 柔韌的；搭配：A ___ person usually can get along with other people well；flexible working hours／schedule（彈性工時／可調整的行程。這一題的 flexible 指人隨和好商量）

詞彙題.stem: In a democratic society, we have to ______ different opinions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在民主社會中，我們必須____不同的意見。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 容忍, 忍受, 寬容, 容許；搭配：we have to ___ different opinions；tolerate + N／V-ing（容忍…，不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: Follow the ____ closely, and you will find it easy to assemble the bicycle.
詞彙題.stemZh: 仔細按照說明操作，你會發現組裝這台腳踏車很容易。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 說明, 指示, 使用說明（instruction 的複數）；搭配：Follow the ___；follow the instructions（照說明做，習慣用複數）

詞彙題.stem: If I can help you with the project, don’t ________ to call me.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果我能幫上你這個專案的忙，別猶豫，儘管打給我。
詞彙題.explanation: vi. 猶豫, 遲疑, 躊躇, 支吾, 停頓；搭配：don’t ___；hesitate to + V（猶豫著要不要做…，不接 V-ing）

詞彙題.stem: ________ between good friends should be resolved, not ignored.
詞彙題.stemZh: 好朋友之間的衝突應該被解決，而不是被忽略。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 衝突, 分歧, 爭論, 戰鬥（conflict 的複數）

詞彙題.stem: Group registrations are not allowed. Each member must register for the conference ________ .
詞彙題.stemZh: 不接受團體報名，每位成員都必須個別報名參加這場會議。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 個別地, 分別地, 以個人身分, 獨特地

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Wang’s arguments were very ________, and the committee finally accepted his proposal.
詞彙題.stemZh: 王先生的論點很有說服力，委員會最終接受了他的提案。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有說服力的, 令人信服的；搭配：arguments were very ___；a persuasive argument／salesperson（有說服力的論點／業務員）

詞彙題.stem: The woman is so ________ that she cries every time she hears a sad story.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位女士非常多愁善感，每次聽到悲傷的故事都會哭。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 多愁善感的, 感情用事的, 過於傷感的；搭配：so ___ that she cries；sentimental value（紀念價值，不是金錢上的價值）

詞彙題.stem: We ________ believe that with your intelligence and hard work, you will pass the exam without any difficulty.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們堅信憑藉你的聰明才智與努力，你一定能輕鬆通過這場考試。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 堅定地, 堅決地, 牢固地, 堅固地；搭配：We ___ believe；firmly／strongly believe（堅信）

詞彙題.stem: If we walk at this slow ________, we’ll never get to our destination on time.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果我們用這種慢速前進，絕對無法準時到達目的地。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 速度, 步調, 步法；搭配：walk at this slow ___；at a slow／fast pace（以…的步調，介系詞用 at）

詞彙題.stem: The territorial dispute can be ________ back to the year 1917, when the two countries were at war.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這場領土爭議可以追溯到 1917 年，也就是這兩國交戰的那一年。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 追溯, 追查, 找到, 描摹（trace 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：can be ___ back to；be traced back to + 時間（追溯到…）

詞彙題.stem: One key factor to success is to have a definite goal first and then do your best to ________ the goal.
詞彙題.stemZh: 成功的一個關鍵因素是先設定明確的目標，然後盡全力去達成它。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 達到, 獲得；搭配：do your best to ___ the goal；attain／achieve a goal（達成目標）

詞彙題.stem: Jane and Sue are twins, but they seem to have nothing ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 珍和蘇是雙胞胎，但她們似乎毫無共通之處。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　共有，有共同之處；搭配：seem to have nothing ___；have sth in common with sb（與某人有共通之處）

詞彙題.stem: How did the traffic accident ________?
詞彙題.stemZh: 這場車禍是怎麼發生的？
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　發生

詞彙題.stem: During the lunch hour, Jane ________ her notes so she would remember them for the test.
詞彙題.stemZh: 午休時間，珍把筆記又快速看過一遍，好讓自己記住考試內容。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　快速看過，匆匆練習，查看，輾過，溢出（run over 的過去式）；搭配：Jane ___ her notes so she would remember them；run over one’s notes（快速看過、複習。這裡不是「輾過」的意思）

詞彙題.stem: We shall expect you at eight o’clock; ________, it’s an informal dinner.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們八點恭候你的到來；順帶一提，這是一場非正式的晚宴。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　順帶一提

詞彙題.stem: Stricter measures have been taken to ________ potential dangers concerning cigarette-smoking.
詞彙題.stemZh: 已經採取更嚴格的措施，以防範吸菸可能帶來的危害。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　擋開，避開；搭配：to ___ potential dangers；ward off + N（防範、擋開危險或疾病）

詞彙題.stem: This hotel is quite reasonable. It ______ only NT$800 for single room per night.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這家旅館相當合理。單人房每晚只____新台幣 800 元。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 收費, 要價, 控告, 充電（charge 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：It ___ only NT$800 for single room per night；charge sb + 金額 + for + N（向某人收取…的費用）／charge sth to a credit card（記在信用卡上）

詞彙題.stem: An average person ______ sleeps eight hours a day.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一個普通人____每天睡八個小時。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 通常, 一般, 正常地

詞彙題.stem: Our country has become hi-tech by ______ heavily in electronic industry.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們的國家藉由在電子工業上大量____而變得高科技。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 投資, 投入（invest 的現在分詞）；搭配：by ___ heavily in electronic industry；invest in + N（投資於…）／invest heavily in + N（大筆投資於…）／invest overseas（投資海外）

詞彙題.stem: History has had many surprises for us. How events will turn out is often not ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 歷史給了我們許多驚喜。事情將如何發展通常是無法____的。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 可預測的, 可預料的, 意料之中的, 老套的；搭配：How events will turn out is often not ___；highly／perfectly predictable（完全可以預料的）／a predictable outcome（可預料的結果）

詞彙題.stem: The economic crisis we having in Asia now is certainly very ______ to many of us.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們現在在亞洲經歷的經濟危機對我們許多人來說當然非常____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 引起煩惱的, 令人不安的；搭配：is certainly very ___ to many of us；be disturbing to sb（令某人不安）／deeply disturbing（極為令人不安）

詞彙題.stem: A doctor has to ______ your illness before giving you a prescription.
詞彙題.stemZh: 醫生在給你開處方之前必須____你的疾病。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 診斷；搭配：has to ___ your illness；diagnose a disease／an illness（診斷疾病）／be diagnosed with + 疾病（被診斷出罹患…）

詞彙題.stem: We are grateful for his ______ in giving a large contribution to our educational foundation.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們感謝他對我們的教育基金會做出巨大貢獻的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 慷慨, 寬大；搭配：grateful for his ___ in giving a large contribution；generosity in + V-ing（在…方面的慷慨）／thank sb for their generosity（感謝某人的慷慨）

詞彙題.stem: At this historic site, you can see some ______ magnificent palaces.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在這個歷史遺址，你可以看到一些____宏偉的宮殿。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 非常, 極其, 極大地；搭配：you can see some ___ magnificent palaces；immensely popular／successful／grateful（極為受歡迎、成功、感激）

詞彙題.stem: He has made a good plan in ______ with marketing strategies.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他制定了一個與行銷策略____的好計劃。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 關聯, 聯繫, 連接；搭配：has made a good plan in ___ with marketing strategies；in connection with + N（與…有關聯）／have a connection with + N（與…有關係）

詞彙題.stem: All of us should be concerned with public ______ to make our society a better place.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們所有人都應該關心公共____，使我們的社會成為一個更好的地方。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 事務, 事件, 婚外情（affair 的複數）；搭配：should be concerned with public ___；public／current／foreign affairs（公共事務、時事、外交事務）

詞彙題.stem: The sentence written on the board is ________. It has more than one meaning.
詞彙題.stemZh: 寫在黑板上的這句話含意模糊，可以有不只一種解讀。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 不明確的, 模稜兩可的；搭配：written on the board is ___；an ambiguous statement／answer（模稜兩可的說法、回答）

詞彙題.stem: Because Mr. Wang changes his mind ________, it’s very difficult to predict what he will do next.
詞彙題.stemZh: 因為王先生總是不停改變心意，很難預測他接下來會怎麼做。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 不斷地, 經常地, 總是；搭配：Mr. Wang changes his mind ___；change one's mind（改變心意，mind 用單數加所有格）

詞彙題.stem: Many students find it hard to focus on their studies when holidays are ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多學生發現當假期將近時，很難專心讀書。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 接近, 靠近, 接洽（approach 的現在分詞）；搭配：when holidays are ___；approach + N（接近…，當動詞時不加 to）

詞彙題.stem: During the process of evolution, man has shown remarkable ability to ________ to the environment.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在演化的過程中，人類展現出令人驚豔的環境適應能力。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 適應, 使適應, 改編；搭配：ability to ___ to the environment；adapt to + N（適應…，不可漏掉 to）

詞彙題.stem: The young scientist showed great ________ for his success. He said that it was as much the result of good luck as his own talent.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位年輕科學家對自己的成就表現得非常謙虛，他說這份成功既是運氣、也是他自己天賦的結果。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 謙遜, 質樸, 羞怯；搭配：showed great ___ for his success；show great modesty（十分謙虛，modesty 不可數、不加 a）

詞彙題.stem: Ladies and gentlemen, it is my ________ to speak to you all on this special occasion.
詞彙題.stemZh: 各位女士先生，能在這個特別的場合對大家致詞，是我的榮幸。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 特權, 特別待遇, 榮幸；搭配：it is my ___ to speak to you all；have the privilege of + V-ing（有幸做…）

詞彙題.stem: It was a great ________ for his family that he had survived the cold weather in the mountain.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他在山上寒冷的天氣中倖存下來，這讓他的家人鬆了一大口氣。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 寬慰, 鬆一口氣, 減輕, 解除, 救濟, 浮雕；搭配：It was a great ___ for his family；It is a great relief that + 子句（…讓人鬆了一口氣）

詞彙題.stem: The landslide after the typhoon signals that environmental protection ________ our attention.
詞彙題.stemZh: 颱風過後發生的土石流顯示，環境保護值得我們重視。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 值得, 應得, 應受（deserve 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：protection ___ our attention；deserve our attention（值得我們重視，後面直接接受詞）

詞彙題.stem: Cars in the future will be characterized by their ________ use of gasoline.
詞彙題.stemZh: 未來的汽車將以有效率地使用汽油為特色。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有效率的, 能幹的；搭配：their ___ use of gasoline；the efficient use of + N（有效率地使用…）

詞彙題.stem: Physically, Peter is well-built, yet ________, he is very weak and dependent.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彼得的體格健壯，但在情感上卻十分脆弱、依賴他人。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 在情緒上, 在情感上, 激動地；搭配：___, he is very weak and dependent；be emotionally dependent on sb（在情感上依賴某人）

詞彙題.stem: Kevin is ________ , because he broke the living room window this afternoon.
詞彙題.stemZh: 凱文惹上麻煩了，因為他今天下午打破了客廳的窗戶。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　陷入麻煩

詞彙題.stem: If all the manufacturers can ________ during this financial crisis, the economy may get better next quarter.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果所有製造商都能在這場金融危機中撐過去，下一季經濟可能會好轉。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　堅持下去，稍等，緊握；搭配：can ___ during this financial crisis；hang on（撐住、堅持下去，後面不接受詞）

詞彙題.stem: Don’t worry about your grades. Just concentrate on your studies. Hard work often ________ the best in you.
詞彙題.stemZh: 別擔心成績，專心讀書就好。努力用功常常能激發出你最好的一面。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　激發出，使顯現出，推出（產品）；搭配：Hard work often ___ the best in you；bring out the best in sb（激發出某人最好的一面）

詞彙題.stem: The young man owes his success to many people, his parents ________ .
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位年輕人的成功歸功於許多人，尤其是他的父母。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　尤其，特別是；搭配：his parents ___；N + in particular（尤其是…，放在名詞後面）

詞彙題.stem: He was late for the meeting ________ the heavy rain.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於大雨，他開會遲到了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　由於，作為...的結果；搭配：late for the meeting ___ the heavy rain；as a result of + N（由於…）

詞彙題.stem: A person of great ______ usually can achieve his goal.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一個有偉大____的人通常能實現他的目標。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 決心, 果斷；搭配：A person of great ___；a person of great determination（意志堅定的人）／determination to + V（做某事的決心）

詞彙題.stem: I am in a hurry, so I can only discuss this matter with you ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我很著急，所以我只能____地和你討論這件事。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 簡短地, 短暫地, 簡言之；搭配：discuss this matter with you ___；briefly discuss／explain／describe／mention／summarize（用少少的話講完的動作。另有短暫地的意思，配 pause／appear）

詞彙題.stem: We need your help in order to have ______ funds to promote this social welfare program.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們需要您的幫助，以便有____的資金來推廣這個社會福利計畫。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 充分的, 足夠的；搭配：to have ___ funds to promote this social welfare program；sufficient funds／evidence／time（足夠的資金、證據、時間）／be sufficient for + N（對…而言足夠）

詞彙題.stem: These questions are ______ easy. I am sure you can answer them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些問題____容易。我相信你能回答它們。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 相對地, 比較地, 相當地；搭配：These questions are ___ easy；relatively + Adj（相對地…，如 relatively easy／small）／relatively speaking（相對來說）

詞彙題.stem: Recent studies on whales have ______ that, they, like humans, also have emotions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 最近對鯨魚的研究____，牠們和人類一樣，也有情緒。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 揭露, 顯示, 透露, 洩露（reveal 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Recent studies on whales have ___ that；Research reveals／demonstrates／shows／indicates／suggests that + 子句（研究顯示…）／reveal the truth／a secret（揭露真相、洩漏祕密）

詞彙題.stem: Discrimination against women is a ______ of human rights.
詞彙題.stemZh: 對女性的歧視是對人權的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 違反, 侵犯, 違背；搭配：is a ___ of human rights；a violation of human rights／of the law（侵犯人權、違法）／in violation of + N（違反…）

詞彙題.stem: For our family to make both ends meet, it is important to ______ living expenses.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了我們家收支平衡，____生活開支很重要。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 將...減到最少；搭配：it is important to ___ living expenses；minimize costs／risks／damage（把成本、風險、損害降到最低）

詞彙題.stem: This couple went to Paris to celebrate their tenth wedding ______ last month.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這對夫婦上個月去巴黎慶祝他們的第十個結婚____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 週年紀念；搭配：celebrate their tenth wedding ___；a wedding anniversary（結婚週年）／an anniversary sale（週年慶）／celebrate the anniversary of + N（慶祝…的週年）

詞彙題.stem: John is a very ______ person. He often tries to give others the impression that he is a VIP.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰是個非常____的人。他常試圖給人留下他是重要人物的印象。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 自負的, 自命不凡的, 誇耀的

詞彙題.stem: This scientist is very ______. His original experiments are widely admired.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位科學家非常____。他獨創的實驗受到廣泛欽佩。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 富有想像力的, 有創意的, 新穎的；搭配：This scientist is very ___；highly imaginative（極富想像力的）／an imaginative solution／approach（有創意的解法、做法）

詞彙題.stem: Jack is a ______ person: he is polite, kind, and always shows respect for others.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克是個彬彬有禮的人：他既有禮貌又善良，總是尊重他人。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有禮貌的, 彬彬有禮的, 謙恭有禮的；搭配：Jack is a ___ person；be courteous to sb（對某人以禮相待）

詞彙題.stem: The traffic in the city was ______ today, so Jane got home earlier than usual.
詞彙題.stemZh: 今天市區的交通很順暢，所以珍比平常更早到家。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 輕的, 少量的, 輕微的, 輕快的, 輕浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的；搭配：The traffic in the city was ___ today；heavy／light traffic（交通壅塞／順暢）

詞彙題.stem: Jonathan had qualified as a doctor but later gave up the ______ of medicine for full-time writing.
詞彙題.stemZh: 強納森取得了醫師資格，但後來放棄行醫，全職投入寫作。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 執業, 業務, 實踐, 練習, 慣例, 習慣；v. 練習, 實踐, 執業；搭配：gave up the ___ of medicine；the practice of medicine／law（行醫／執業當律師）

詞彙題.stem: Bill was severely punished because he ______ lied to his mother.
詞彙題.stemZh: 比爾因為故意對母親說謊而受到嚴厲的處罰。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 故意地, 有目的地；搭配：he ___ lied to his mother；lie to sb（對某人說謊，不可省略 to）

詞彙題.stem: The two security guards will be ______ from all their duties until further investigation is completed.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這兩名保全人員將被暫停所有職務，直到進一步調查完成為止。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 使停職, 暫停, 中止, 懸掛, 懸浮（suspend 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：will be ___ from all their duties；be suspended from + N（被停職、被停學）

詞彙題.stem: He made his instruction ______ and direct so that everyone could follow easily.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他把指示說得明確又直接，好讓每個人都能輕易理解遵循。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 明確的, 清楚的, 詳盡的, 露骨的；搭配：made his instruction ___ and direct；be explicit about + N（把…講清楚）

詞彙題.stem: In order for a new product to sell well, manufacturers often invest a large sum of money on its ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了讓新產品暢銷，製造商常常投入大筆資金在推廣宣傳上。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 促銷, 宣傳, 推廣, 晉升, 升遷；搭配：invest a large sum of money on its ___；sales promotion（促銷、產品宣傳）

詞彙題.stem: The soldier was put on trial for ______ to obey his commanding officer’s order.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這名士兵因拒絕服從指揮官的命令而被送上軍事審判。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 拒絕, 回絕（refuse 的現在分詞）；搭配：put on trial for ___ to obey；refuse to V（拒絕做…，不接 V-ing）。其中 refuse to V 這一組考過 3 個年度，學測克漏字 105 年第 19 題、105 年第 20 題、108 年第 17 題都出現過。

詞彙題.stem: Since Michael was the best candidate, the committee voted ______ for him to take charge of the company’s sales department.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於麥可是最佳人選，委員會一致投票通過由他負責公司的業務部門。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 一致地, 全體一致地, 無異議地；搭配：the committee voted ___ for him；a unanimous decision（全體一致的決議）

詞彙題.stem: After hiking all day without drinking any water, the students sat down by the stream to quench their ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 學生們健行一整天都沒喝水，於是坐在小溪邊解渴。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 口渴, 渴望；搭配：to quench their ___；quench one's thirst（解渴）

詞彙題.stem: The more one is ______ the English-speaking environment, the better he or she will learn the language.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一個人越常暴露在英語環境中，就越能學好這個語言。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　暴露於，接觸到；搭配：one is ___ the English-speaking environment；be exposed to + N（接觸到、暴露在…之中）

詞彙題.stem: Peter’s sudden death was a great blow to Jane and it took her a long time to ______ the grief.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彼得的驟逝對珍是一大打擊，她花了很長時間才走出悲傷。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　克服，從...恢復；搭配：took her a long time to ___ the grief；get over the grief／an illness／a shock（走出、熬過，接的是傷痛或病痛這一類）

詞彙題.stem: A person who likes to ______ others is definitely not easy to get along with.
詞彙題.stemZh: 喜歡找別人麻煩的人，絕對不好相處。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　找...麻煩，欺負；搭配：A person who likes to ___ others；pick on sb（找某人麻煩，pick sb 是挑人）

詞彙題.stem: The old houses will soon be ______ and rebuilt because of the severe damage caused by the earthquake.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些老舊房屋因地震造成的嚴重損害，很快就會被拆除重建。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　拆除，拆毀，使萎靡（pull down 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：The old houses will soon be ___ and rebuilt；pull down and rebuild a house／an old building（拆除重建，講災後重建或都市更新）

詞彙題.stem: I’d like to thank you for your hospitality ______ our group.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我想代表我們這個團體，感謝您的盛情款待。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　代表；搭配：your hospitality ___ our group；on behalf of + N（代表…）

詞彙題.stem: It was obvious that this young artist's latest work was ______ much better than any other work in the exhibition.
詞彙題.stemZh: 很明顯，這位年輕藝術家最新的作品____比展覽中任何其他作品都好得多。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 肯定, 毫無疑問地, 當然, 明確地

詞彙題.stem: After a lengthy discussion, the experts finally ______ with suggestions for resolving the economic crisis.
詞彙題.stemZh: 經過長時間的討論，專家們終於____了解決經濟危機的建議。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　想出，提出，出現（come up 的過去式）；搭配：the experts finally ___ with suggestions；come up with an idea／a suggestion／a solution（想出點子、建議、辦法）／come up with + N（後面直接接名詞，不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: Although Martha had been away from home for a long time, when she came near her house, everything suddenly became ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然瑪莎離家很久了，但當她走近她的房子時，一切突然變得____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 熟悉的, 常見的, 親密的；搭配：everything suddenly became ___；be／become familiar with + N（人熟悉某事物）／be familiar to sb（某事物為某人所熟悉）／a familiar face／sight／voice（熟悉的面孔、景象、聲音）

詞彙題.stem: The owner was demanding. He expected nothing but ______ from his employees.
詞彙題.stemZh: 老闆要求很高。他對員工的期望除了____之外別無他物。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 完美, 完善, 盡善盡美；搭配：expected nothing but ___ from his employees；expect／demand nothing but perfection（只接受完美）／strive for perfection（追求完美）／to perfection（做到完美的程度，放在動詞後）

詞彙題.stem: Einstein was considered one of the greatest scientists of the 20th century ______ his influence on the study of physics.
詞彙題.stemZh: 愛因斯坦被認為是 20 世紀最偉大的科學家之一，____他在物理學研究上的影響。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　就...而言，從...角度看；搭配：one of the greatest scientists ___ his influence on physics；in terms of + N（就…而言，後面接名詞不接子句）／in terms of cost／quality／influence（就成本、品質、影響而言）

詞彙題.stem: The company decided to put the plan into operation because it was the most ______ one.
詞彙題.stemZh: 公司決定將該計劃付諸實施，因為它是最____的方案。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 能實行的, 可行的, 適宜的；搭配：it was the most ___ one；a feasible plan／solution／option（可行的計畫、辦法、選項）／technically／economically feasible（技術上、經濟上可行）

詞彙題.stem: Among the high-risk group of heart disease are people with a ______ for fat-rich foods.
詞彙題.stemZh: 心臟病的高風險群體中包括對富含脂肪的食物有____的人。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 偏好, 偏愛, 喜愛, 優先；搭配：people with a ___ for fat-rich foods；have／show a preference for + N（對…有偏好，介系詞用 for 不用 to）／in order of preference／priority（依偏好順序、依優先順序）／seat preference（劃位時的座位偏好，指靠窗或靠走道）

詞彙題.stem: In many novels and films, step-mothers are often ______ as wicked women.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在許多小說和電影中，繼母常被____為邪惡的女人。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 對…形成刻板印象, 對…有成見（stereotype 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：step-mothers are often ___ as wicked women；stereotype sb as + N（把某人定型為…，介系詞用 as）／be stereotyped as（慣用被動）／a stereotyped image（定型化的形象）

詞彙題.stem: Technological changes will ______ lead to a change in human relationships.
詞彙題.stemZh: 技術變革將____導致人際關係的改變。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 不可避免地；搭配：Technological changes will ___ lead to a change；inevitably lead to／result in + N（無可避免地導致…）／will inevitably V（放在助動詞與主要動詞之間）

詞彙題.stem: The sale of the company's new product is overwhelmingly good. It has ______ two million dollars so far.
詞彙題.stemZh: 公司新產品的銷售非常好。到目前為止，它已經____了兩百萬美元。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　賺進，引進，帶入（bring in 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：It has ___ two million dollars so far；bring in + 金額／revenue／profit（賺進收入、利潤）／bring in an expert／new blood（引進專家、新血）

詞彙題.stem: These batteries are not good. ______ they will last only for two months.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些電池不好。____它們只能用兩個月。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　充其量，最多

詞彙題.stem: When the landlord opened the door, he looked me ______ before asking who I was.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當房東打開門時，他在問我是誰之前____打量了我一番。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　上上下下，上下打量，來回地，時好時壞的；搭配：he looked me ___ before asking who I was；look sb up and down（上下打量某人，受詞放在動詞與片語中間）／walk／pace up and down（來回踱步）

詞彙題.stem: Since the contestants were all very good, the competition for the first prize was ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於參賽者都非常優秀，爭奪一等獎的競爭非常____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 激烈的, 兇猛的, 猛烈的, 強烈的；搭配：the competition for the first prize was ___；fierce competition／rivalry（激烈的競爭、對抗）／fierce debate／opposition／criticism（激烈的辯論、反對、批評）

詞彙題.stem: The reason for designing the special bus lane is to ______ the traffic flow, not to slow it down.
詞彙題.stemZh: 設計公車專用道的原因是為了____交通流量，而不是減慢它。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 使容易, 促進, 幫助；搭配：to ___ the traffic flow, not to slow it down；facilitate the flow／the process（使流動、流程更順暢）／facilitate communication／learning／trade（促進溝通、學習、貿易）／facilitate + N（後面直接接名詞，不接 sb to V）

詞彙題.stem: The ballet dancers’ ______ movements delighted all the audience.
詞彙題.stemZh: 芭蕾舞者優雅的動作讓所有觀眾都感到欣喜。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 優雅的, 優美的, 得體的

詞彙題.stem: At the closing ceremony of the Olympic Games, all the athletes ______ good-bye to the audience.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在奧運閉幕典禮上，所有選手都向觀眾揮手道別。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 揮手, 揮動, 揮手示意, 飄動（wave 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：athletes ___ good-bye to the audience；wave good-bye to sb（向某人揮手道別）

詞彙題.stem: The drug problem is universal. It is not ______ to one country.
詞彙題.stemZh: 毒品問題是全球性的，並不侷限於某一個國家。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 受限制的, 有限的；搭配：It is not ___ to one country；be restricted to + N（侷限於…）

詞彙題.stem: I think that this new program will be ______ of your effort.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我認為這個新方案值得你付出努力。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 值得的, 值得尊敬的, 有價值的；搭配：will be ___ of your effort；be worthy of + N（值得…）

詞彙題.stem: This textbook is ______ more difficult to read than the other one.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這本教科書讀起來比另一本困難得多。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 相當地, 大大地, 非常；搭配：is ___ more difficult to read；considerably／much + 比較級（…得多，very 不能修飾比較級）

詞彙題.stem: The ______ of Linda’s love for music made her fly to Vienna to enter a music school.
詞彙題.stemZh: 琳達對音樂的熱愛之強烈，使她飛往維也納進入一所音樂學校就讀。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 強烈, 緊張, 強度

詞彙題.stem: E-mail plays a ______ role in modern communication.
詞彙題.stemZh: 電子郵件在現代通訊中扮演著至關重要的角色。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 極其重要的, 必不可少的, 充滿生氣的, 生命的；搭配：plays a ___ role in modern communication；play a vital role in + N（在…扮演關鍵角色）

詞彙題.stem: I ______ accept your plan, but I think it should be somewhat reworded.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我基本上接受你的計畫，但我認為措辭應該稍作修改。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 基本上, 主要地

詞彙題.stem: This poem may be ______ in several different ways and each of them makes sense.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這首詩可以有好幾種不同的解讀方式，而且每一種都說得通。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 解釋, 詮釋, 理解（interpret 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：may be ___ in several different ways；interpret sth as + N（把…解讀成…）

詞彙題.stem: The ______ of this piece of cloth is too coarse. Do you have a finer one?
詞彙題.stemZh: 這塊布的質地太粗糙了，你有比較細緻的嗎？
詞彙題.explanation: n. 質地, 質感, 手感, 紋理, 口感；搭配：The ___ of this piece of cloth；the texture of skin／soil（膚質、土質，不限於布料）

詞彙題.stem: His plan ______ in failure though it had been supported by many people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管他的計畫得到許多人的支持，最終還是以失敗收場。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　最終落得，結果是，以…告終（end up 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：His plan ___ in failure；end up + V-ing（最後落得…，不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: Sara enjoys amusing her friends by ______ stories.
詞彙題.stemZh: 莎拉喜歡編故事來逗朋友開心。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　編造，彌補，和好，化妝（make up 的現在分詞）；搭配：amusing her friends by ___ stories；make up a story／an excuse（編故事、編藉口）

詞彙題.stem: As the applause ______, the curtain on the stage dropped slowly.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著掌聲漸漸平息，舞台上的布幕緩緩落下。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　逐漸平息，漸漸減弱（die down 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：As the applause ___；noise／wind dies down（噪音、風勢漸漸平息）

詞彙題.stem: No one can possibly know ______ when an earthquake will strike.
詞彙題.stemZh: 沒有人能事先知道地震何時會發生。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　事先；搭配：can possibly know ___；know sth in advance／ahead of time（事先知道，也說 beforehand）

詞彙題.stem: The scientist’s project to build a modern laboratory was ______ on account of its huge budget.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位科學家興建現代化實驗室的計畫，因為預算龐大而遭到質疑。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　使受到質疑（call into question 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：to build a modern laboratory was ___；call sth into question（對…提出質疑）

詞彙題.stem: Many students like to watch that talk show because the ______ is brilliant at entertaining young people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多學生喜歡看那個脫口秀，因為____非常擅長娛樂年輕人。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 主持人, 主人, 東道主, 主辦方；v. 主辦, 主持；搭配：the ___ is brilliant at entertaining young people；a talk show host／a game show host（脫口秀主持人、遊戲節目主持人）／host a program／a party（主持節目、辦派對，當動詞用）

詞彙題.stem: When he took office, the president ______ swore to protect the country and work for peace.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當他上任時，總統____宣誓保護國家並為和平而努力。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 莊嚴地, 嚴肅地；搭配：the president ___ swore to protect the country；solemnly swear／declare／promise（莊嚴宣誓、宣告、承諾）／a solemn oath／occasion（莊嚴的誓言、場合）

詞彙題.stem: You will have to ______ if you want to swim faster than other swimmers in our country.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你想游得比我們國家其他游泳選手快，你將必須____。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　繼續保持努力；搭配：You will have to ___ if you want to swim faster；keep it up（繼續保持，受詞 it 固定放中間，不說 keep up it）／keep up with sb（跟上某人的進度）

詞彙題.stem: After years of hard work, Mandy finally became the first female ______ on the staff of the City Hospital.
詞彙題.stemZh: 經過多年努力，曼蒂終於成為市立醫院員工中的第一位女性____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 顧問, 會診醫師, 諮詢師；搭配：the first female ___ on the staff of the City Hospital；a financial／legal／management consultant（財務、法律、管理顧問）／consult sb about + N（就某事請教某人）

詞彙題.stem: A person who hesitates a lot cannot make ______ even about trivial matters.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一個經常猶豫的人即使對瑣碎的事情也無法做出____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 決定, 決心, 決議, 解決, 解析度（resolution 的複數）；搭配：cannot make ___ even about trivial matters；make／keep a resolution（下定決心、守住決心）／New Year's resolutions（新年新希望）

詞彙題.stem: The goals of our educational system are ______ the development of our society.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們教育體系的目標與我們社會的發展____。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　與...一致，符合；搭配：The goals of our educational system are ___ the development of our society；in keeping with + N（與…一致、符合）／out of keeping with + N（與…不搭調，反義說法）

詞彙題.stem: If you climb up to the peak of Mt. Jade, you will find a ______ view up there.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你爬到玉山頂，你會在那裡發現一個____的景色。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 壯觀的, 壯麗的, 驚人的；n. 壯觀場面, 盛大演出；搭配：you will find a ___ view up there；a spectacular view／sight／performance（壯觀的景色、景象、精彩的演出）／spectacular growth／success（驚人的成長、成功）

詞彙題.stem: If you can ______ this crisis, you will have a good chance of success.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你能____這次危機，你將有很好的成功機會。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　安然度過，平安度過（危機、風暴等）；搭配：If you can ___ this crisis；ride out a crisis／a storm／a recession（安然度過危機、風暴、不景氣）／ride out + N（後面接的是難關這一類）

詞彙題.stem: Jenny ______ when she was praised by her teacher for writing an excellent English composition.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當珍妮因寫了一篇優秀的英語作文而被老師稱讚時，她____了。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 臉紅（blush 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Jenny ___ when she was praised by her teacher；blush with embarrassment／blush at a compliment（因…而臉紅，不接受詞）／turn red in the face（同義說法）

詞彙題.stem: At this meeting, we shall focus ______ on the profits our company has made this year.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在這次會議上，我們將____關注我們公司今年的利潤。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 主要地

詞彙題.stem: This TV program, ______, will introduce you to different species of animals in Africa.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個電視節目，____，將向您介紹非洲不同的動物物種。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　大體上，整體而言；搭配：This TV program, ___, will introduce you to different species；by and large（整體而言、大體上，中間不加冠詞，也不寫成 by and largely）／on the whole／in general（同義的插入語）

詞彙題.stem: Faced with a problem, you have to ______ it first, and then try to find a solution.
詞彙題.stemZh: 面對問題，你必須先____它，然後再嘗試找到解決方案。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 分析, 細察, 分解；搭配：you have to ___ it first, and then try to find a solution；analyze data／a problem／the results（分析數據、問題、結果）／analysis（名詞形，複數是 analyses）

詞彙題.stem: What the elderly people need is ______ exercise, not those sports requiring great physical effort.
詞彙題.stemZh: 老年人需要的是____的運動，而不是那些需要巨大體力的運動。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 適度的, 穩健的, 中等的, 節制的；搭配：What the elderly people need is ___ exercise；moderate exercise／drinking／temperature（適度的運動、節制的飲酒、溫和的氣溫）／in moderation（適量地，名詞用法）

詞彙題.stem: The environmentalist ______ the whole world to protect that ozone layer.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位環保主義者____全世界保護臭氧層。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　呼籲，號召，拜訪（call on 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：The environmentalist ___ the whole world to protect that ozone layer；call on sb to V（呼籲某人做某事）／call on sb（拜訪某人，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: The study of characteristics of these two plants shows that they are ______ only in appearance.
詞彙題.stemZh: 對這兩種植物特性的研究表明，它們僅在外觀上是____的。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 完全相同的, 極為相似的, 同一的；搭配：they are ___ only in appearance；be identical to／with + N（與…完全相同）／identical twins（同卵雙胞胎）

詞彙題.stem: With her teachers' and parents' ______, Jane regained her confidence and has made great progress.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在老師和父母的____下，珍恢復了自信並取得了巨大進步。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 鼓勵, 激勵, 獎勵；搭配：With her teachers' and parents' ___, Jane regained her confidence；with the encouragement of sb（在某人的鼓勵之下）／give／offer encouragement（給予鼓勵）／words of encouragement（鼓勵的話）

詞彙題.stem: One of Jane's finest qualities is that she takes the ______. She always takes the necessary action and does not wait for orders.
詞彙題.stemZh: 珍最優秀的品質之一是她會採取____。她總是採取必要的行動，而不是等待命令。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 主動行動, 首創精神, 主動權；搭配：she takes the ___；take the initiative（主動採取行動）

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Li is a senior ______ at a local bank. He keeps and examines financial records of people and companies.
詞彙題.stemZh: 李先生是當地一家銀行的高級____。他保管並檢查個人和公司的財務記錄。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 會計人員, 會計師；搭配：Mr. Li is a senior ___ at a local bank；a certified public accountant（美式說法的會計師，縮寫 CPA）／a chartered accountant（英式說法的會計師）／a qualified accountant（有執照的會計人員）

詞彙題.stem: Jack doesn't look ______, but he is, in fact, excellent at sports, especially baseball.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克看起來不____，但事實上，他非常擅長運動，尤其是棒球。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 健壯的, 擅長運動的, 運動的, 田徑運動的；搭配：Jack doesn't look ___；look／be athletic（看起來體格好、擅長運動）／athletic ability（運動能力）／an athletic build（結實的體格）

詞彙題.stem: The jury spent over five hours trying to decide whether the defendant is ______ or guilty.
詞彙題.stemZh: 陪審團花了五個多小時來決定被告是____還是有罪。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 無罪的, 清白的, 無辜的, 天真的；搭配：trying to decide whether the defendant is ___ or guilty；innocent or guilty（法庭上判有罪無罪的固定說法）／be innocent of + 罪名（對某罪是清白的）／an innocent victim／bystander（無辜的受害者、路人）

詞彙題.stem: Now that my computer is connected to the Internet, I can browse e-papers, send and receive e-mail, and ______ software.
詞彙題.stemZh: 既然我的電腦連接到網路，我可以瀏覽電子報、收發電子郵件和____軟體。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 下載；搭配：browse e-papers, send and receive e-mail, and ___ software；download software／a file／an app（下載軟體、檔案、應用程式）／download sth from the Internet（從網路下載，與 upload 上傳相對）

詞彙題.stem: The traffic on Main Street was ______ for several hours due to a car accident in which six people were injured.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於一場造成六人受傷的車禍，主街的交通被____了好幾個小時。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 阻塞, 堵塞, 阻擋, 妨礙（obstruct 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：The traffic on Main Street was ___ for several hours；obstruct traffic／the view／a road（阻礙交通、擋住視線、堵住道路）／obstruct justice（妨害司法）

詞彙題.stem: Hundreds of people ______ in the desert storm and many more were left homeless.
詞彙題.stemZh: 數百人在沙漠風暴中____，還有更多人無家可歸。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 喪生, 死亡, 消亡（perish 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：people ___ in the desert storm；perish in a storm／a fire（在風災／火災中喪生）

詞彙題.stem: Mike arrived at the meeting ______ at ten o'clock—as it was scheduled—not a minute early or late.
詞彙題.stemZh: 麥克____在十點鐘到達會議—正如預定的那樣—一分鐘不早也不晚。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 準時地, 守時地, 按時地；搭配：arrived at the meeting ___ at ten o'clock；arrive punctually（準時抵達）

詞彙題.stem: A power failure ______ darkened the whole city, and it was not until two hours later that electricity was restored.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一次停電____使整個城市變暗，直到兩小時後電力才恢復。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 暫時, 一時, 臨時；搭配：A power failure ___ darkened the whole city；temporarily closed／suspended／unavailable（暫停營業、暫時中止、暫時無法使用）／temporarily out of order（暫時故障）

詞彙題.stem: In the keen competition of this international tennis tournament, she ______ won the championship.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在這場競爭激烈的國際網球錦標賽中，她驚險地贏得了冠軍。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 勉強地, 差一點, 僥倖地, 狹義地, 仔細地；搭配：___ won the championship；narrowly win（險勝）

詞彙題.stem: This company, with its serious financial problems, is no longer ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這間公司財務問題嚴重，已經到了無法掌控的地步。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 易辦的, 易管理的, 易控制的；搭配：is no longer ___；manage to V（設法做到…，不接 V-ing）。其中 manage to V 這一組考過 4 個年度，學測克漏字 86 年第 28 題、95 年第 16 題、99 年第 20 題都出現過。

詞彙題.stem: Your desk is crowded with too many unnecessary things. You have to ______ some of them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 你的書桌上堆滿了太多不必要的東西，你得移除一些才行。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 移除, 移開, 除去, 去除, 開除；搭配：You have to ___ some of them；remove sth from + N（把…從…移開）

詞彙題.stem: Most businessmen are more interested in the ______ success of their products than their educational values.
詞彙題.stemZh: 大多數商人對產品的商業成功更感興趣，而非其教育價值。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 商業的, 商用的, 商品化的；搭配：the ___ success of their products；commercial success（產品賣得好、賺到錢，business success 則是事業經營得成功）

詞彙題.stem: The postal special ______ service is very efficient. A package sent can be received in a couple of hours.
詞彙題.stemZh: 郵局的限時專送服務非常有效率，寄出的包裹幾個小時內就能收到。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 遞送, 運送, 交貨, 投遞, 分娩；搭配：The postal special ___ service；deliver a speech（發表演說，deliver 不只是送東西）

詞彙題.stem: Children don’t learn their native languages ______, but they become fluent in them within a few years.
詞彙題.stemZh: 孩子並不是刻意地學習母語，但他們在幾年內就能流利地使用。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 有意識地, 刻意地, 故意地；搭配：don’t learn their native languages ___；make a conscious effort（刻意去做某事）

詞彙題.stem: ______ to what you think, our TV program has been enjoyed by a large audience.
詞彙題.stemZh: 與你想的相反，我們的電視節目其實深受廣大觀眾的喜愛。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 相反的, 矛盾的, 對立的；搭配：___ to what you think；contrary to + N／wh- 子句（與…相反）

詞彙題.stem: There is a ______ to one’s capacity; one should not make oneself overtired.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一個人的能力是有限度的，不應該讓自己過度勞累。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 限制, 缺陷, 限額；搭配：a ___ to one’s capacity；a limitation to + N（…有其限度）

詞彙題.stem: It is necessary for you to ______ this point. We simply cannot understand it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 你有必要把這一點說清楚，我們實在無法理解。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 澄清, 闡明, 說清楚；搭配：necessary for you to ___ this point；clarify a point（把某一點講清楚）

詞彙題.stem: Our team will certainly win this baseball game, because all the players are highly ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們的球隊一定會贏得這場棒球賽，因為所有球員都幹勁十足。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 積極的, 幹勁十足的, 有動機的；搭配：are highly ___；highly motivated（動力強、積極進取）

詞彙題.stem: This story, ______, is very fascinating: there are many interesting characters in it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 整體而言，這個故事非常引人入勝：裡面有許多有趣的角色。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　整體而言；搭配：This story, ___, is very fascinating；on the whole（整體而言，等於 in general）。其中 on the whole 這一組考過 4 個年度，學測克漏字 83 年第 21 題、84 年第 21 題、本站 91 年學測補考第 12 題都出現過。

詞彙題.stem: Most of our classmates are ______ taking a trip to Kenting National Park.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們大多數同學都贊成去墾丁國家公園旅行。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　贊成，支持，有利於；搭配：classmates are ___ taking a trip；be in favor of + N／V-ing（贊成…，不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: We haven’t seen John for a long time. As a matter of fact, we have ______ him.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們已經很久沒見到約翰了，事實上我們已經跟他失去聯絡了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　和…失去聯絡，不再了解…的近況（lose track of 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：we have ___ him；lose／keep track of + N（失去聯絡／掌握…的動向）

詞彙題.stem: Recently in Taiwan, the manufacturing industry has ______ the information industry.
詞彙題.stemZh: 最近在台灣，製造業已經讓位給了資訊產業。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　讓位給，由…取代（give way to 的過去分詞）；搭配：has ___ the information industry；give way to + N（讓位給…、被…取代）

詞彙題.stem: His behavior at the party last night seemed rather ______. Many of us were quite surprised.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他昨晚在派對上的行為顯得相當不合時宜，讓我們許多人都很驚訝。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　不恰當，不合時宜；搭配：seemed rather ___；out of place（不得體、格格不入）

詞彙題.stem: The teacher loved to teach young students, ______ those who were smart.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位老師喜歡教年輕學生，尤其是那些聰明的學生。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 尤其, 特別, 格外

詞彙題.stem: Eating dessert before meals may kill your ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 飯前吃甜點可能會讓你沒有食慾。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 食慾, 胃口, 慾望；搭配：may kill your ___；kill／spoil one's appetite（讓人沒胃口，中文說沒食慾，不會想到用 kill 這個字）

詞彙題.stem: In Taiwan, some cable TV companies have up to 70 or 80 ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在台灣，有些有線電視公司多達 70、80 個頻道。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 頻道, 管道, 途徑（channel 的複數）

詞彙題.stem: It was fortunate that John ______ escaped being killed in a traffic accident.
詞彙題.stemZh: 幸運的是，約翰在一場車禍中僥倖逃過一劫。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 勉強地, 差一點, 僥倖地, 狹義地, 仔細地；搭配：John ___ escaped being killed；narrowly escape + V-ing（差一點就…，escape 後接動名詞不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: Since the typhoon, the basement has been filled with water. We have to ______ the water as soon as possible.
詞彙題.stemZh: 颱風過後，地下室就積滿了水，我們必須盡快把水排除。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 移除, 移開, 除去, 去除, 開除；搭配：have to ___ the water as soon as possible；remove sth from sth（把某物從某處清除，remove 本身已含移走的意思，不再加 away）

詞彙題.stem: Some waste from nuclear power plants is buried in ______ containers.
詞彙題.stemZh: 部分核電廠的廢棄物被埋在密封的容器中。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 密封的；搭配：buried in ___ containers；a sealed container（密封容器）

詞彙題.stem: A human body usually has a ______ temperature of about 37 degrees C.
詞彙題.stemZh: 人體通常維持在約攝氏 37 度的穩定體溫。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 穩定的, 不動搖的, 沉著的, 穩固的, 堅定的, 經常的；搭配：has a ___ temperature of about 37 degrees；a steady temperature（穩定的體溫）

詞彙題.stem: If you expect to have quick ______ of the goods, it is better to have them airmailed.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你希望貨物能快速送達，最好用空運寄送。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 遞送, 運送, 交貨, 投遞, 分娩；搭配：quick ___ of the goods；quick delivery of + N（…的快速配送）

詞彙題.stem: This project is mainly for scientific research. It doesn’t have any ______ value at all.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個專案主要是為了科學研究，完全沒有任何商業價值。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 商業的, 商用的, 商品化的；搭配：doesn’t have any ___ value at all；commercial value（商業價值）

詞彙題.stem: These two countries are trying to ______ trade and cultural exchanges between them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這兩個國家正試圖加強彼此間的貿易與文化交流。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 加強, 增強, 強化；搭配：___ trade and cultural exchanges；intensify efforts（加大努力）

詞彙題.stem: The manager must try to find out who is really ______ for this serious sales problem.
詞彙題.stemZh: 經理必須設法查明，這個嚴重的銷售問題究竟是誰的錯。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　有過錯的；搭配：who is really ___ for this serious sales problem；be at fault for + N（在…上有過錯、該負責）

詞彙題.stem: This talk show, ______, is quite popular with the audience.
詞彙題.stemZh: 整體而言，這個談話性節目相當受觀眾歡迎。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　整體而言；搭配：This talk show, ___, is quite popular；on the whole（整體而言、大體上，as a whole 則是把某物當成一個整體來看）。其中 on the whole 這一組考過 4 個年度，學測克漏字 83 年第 21 題、84 年第 21 題、本站 91 年學測第 11 題都出現過。

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Brown suggested that Mary stay with the company, ______, because the company needed her.
詞彙題.stemZh: 布朗先生建議瑪麗不論好壞都留在公司，因為公司需要她。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　無論好壞；搭配：stay with the company, ___, because；for better or worse（無論結果是好是壞，中間不加冠詞 the）

詞彙題.stem: How did you talk your sister ______ the chores for you? She normally avoids them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 你是怎麼說服你妹妹幫你做家事的？她平常都會躲避這些事。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　進入做...的狀態（依句意，文法測驗）；搭配：talk your sister ___ the chores；talk sb into + V-ing（說服某人做…）

詞彙題.stem: In modern times, many traditional concepts have ______ new ideas.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在現代，許多傳統觀念已經讓位給了新的想法。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　讓位給，由…取代（give way to 的過去分詞）；搭配：many traditional concepts have ___ new ideas；give way to + N（被…取代）

詞彙題.stem: Chinese parents are usually very ______ of their children. They want to make sure their children are safe and well taken care of all the time.
詞彙題.stemZh: 華人父母通常對他們的孩子非常____。他們希望確保孩子們一直安全並得到良好照顧。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 保護的, 防護的, 愛護的；搭配：Chinese parents are usually very ___ of their children；be protective of／towards sb（保護、呵護某人，介系詞用 of 或 towards）／fiercely／overly protective（極力保護的、過度保護的）／a protective layer／cover（保護層、保護罩，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: On receiving my letter of complaint, the hotel manager sent me a written ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 收到我的投訴信後，飯店經理給我寄來了一份書面____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 道歉；搭配：the hotel manager sent me a written ___；make／offer sb an apology（向某人道歉）／owe sb an apology（欠某人一個道歉）／a written／public apology（書面道歉、公開道歉）

詞彙題.stem: Jordan's performance ______ his teammates and they finally beat their opponents to win the championship.
詞彙題.stemZh: 喬丹的表現____了他的隊友，他們最終擊敗對手贏得了冠軍。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 激勵, 鼓舞, 啟發, 賦予靈感（inspire 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 卓越的, 憑靈感創作的；搭配：Jordan's performance ___ his teammates；inspire sb to V（激勵某人去做…）／inspire confidence／hope／loyalty（激起信心、希望、忠誠）／be inspired by + N（受…啟發，介系詞用 by）

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Lin's comments were very difficult to follow because they were ______ related to the topic under discussion.
詞彙題.stemZh: 林先生的評論很難理解，因為它們與正在討論的主題____相關。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 鬆散地, 大致地, 寬鬆地, 不緊地；搭配：they were ___ related to the topic；be loosely related to + N（與…關聯鬆散）

詞彙題.stem: Jack came from a poor family, so his parents had to ______ many things to pay for his education.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克來自一個貧窮的家庭，所以他的父母不得不____很多東西來支付他的教育費用。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 犧牲, 獻出, 獻祭；n. 犧牲, 獻出, 祭品, 供品；搭配：his parents had to ___ many things to pay for his education；sacrifice sth for sb／sth（為某人、某事犧牲…，介系詞用 for）／sacrifice one's life（犧牲生命）／make a sacrifice（作出犧牲，作名詞）

詞彙題.stem: The ______ of SARS has caused great inconvenience to many families in Taiwan.
詞彙題.stemZh: SARS 的____給台灣許多家庭帶來了極大的不便。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 爆發, 突然發生；搭配：The ___ of SARS has caused great inconvenience；the outbreak of + N（…的爆發，介系詞用 of）／an outbreak of war／disease／violence（戰爭爆發、疫情爆發、暴力事件爆發）／a disease outbreak（疫情，名詞直接放在前面）

詞彙題.stem: Victor's classmates are very ______ of him because he has just received a new cell phone for his birthday.
詞彙題.stemZh: 維克多的同學非常____他，因為他剛收到一支新手機作為生日禮物。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 嫉妒的, 羨慕的；搭配：Victor's classmates are very ___ of him；be envious of sb／sth（羨慕、嫉妒某人或某事，介系詞用 of）／deeply／openly envious（深深嫉妒、毫不掩飾地羨慕）

詞彙題.stem: Some people still believe, quite ______, that one can get AIDS by shaking hands with homosexuals.
詞彙題.stemZh: 有些人仍然____地相信，與同性戀者握手會得愛滋病。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 錯誤地, 曲解地；搭配：Some people still believe, quite ___, that one can get AIDS；mistakenly believe／think／assume（誤以為）／be mistakenly identified as + N（被誤認為…）／mistakenly report（誤報）

詞彙題.stem: There are altogether 154 foreign students in this university, ______ a total of thirteen different countries.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這所大學總共有 154 名外國學生，____了總共十三個不同的國家。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 代表, 表示, 象徵, 描繪（represent 的現在分詞）；搭配：___ a total of thirteen different countries；represent a country（代表某國，不加 for）

詞彙題.stem: During a ______, many people become unemployed and very few new jobs are available.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在____期間，許多人失業，而且幾乎沒有新的工作機會。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 經濟衰退, 不景氣, 衰退期；搭配：During a ___, many people become unemployed；during／in a recession（在經濟衰退期間，介系詞用 during 或 in）／an economic／global recession（經濟衰退、全球性衰退）／slip／fall into recession（陷入衰退）

詞彙題.stem: All the flights to and from Kaohsiung were _____ because of the heavy thunderstorm.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於強烈雷雨，往返高雄的所有班機都取消了。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 取消, 終止, 撤銷（cancel 的過去式及過去分詞）

詞彙題.stem: The woman told the truth to her lawyer without ____ because he was the only person she could rely on.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這名女子毫無保留地向律師說出真相，因為他是她唯一能依靠的人。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 預訂, 保留, 保留意見, 預約, 保留地；搭配：told the truth to her lawyer without ___；without reservation（毫無保留地說，這個 reservation 是保留、疑慮的意思，不是訂位）

詞彙題.stem: The man was severely injured in last weekend’s tragic car accident and died _____ afterwards.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這名男子在上週末的悲慘車禍中身受重傷，不久後便過世了。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 不久, 很快, 立刻, 簡短地；搭配：died ___ afterwards；shortly after + N／shortly afterwards（不久之後，這裡的 shortly 指時間上很快，不是簡短地）

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Smith’s work in Taiwan is just _____. He will go back to the U.S. next month.
詞彙題.stemZh: 史密斯先生在台灣的工作只是暫時的，他下個月就會回美國。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 暫時的, 臨時的

詞彙題.stem: Helen _____ with anger when she saw her boyfriend kissing an attractive girl.
詞彙題.stemZh: 海倫看到男友親吻一位漂亮女孩時，勃然大怒。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 爆炸, 爆發, 突然發作, 激增（explode 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Helen ___ with anger；explode with anger（勃然大怒，人當主詞的比喻用法，介系詞用 with）

詞彙題.stem: Dr. Liu’s new book is a collection of his _____ of the daily life of tribal people in Africa.
詞彙題.stemZh: 劉博士的新書是他對非洲部落人民日常生活觀察的集結。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 觀察, 觀察結果（observation 的複數）；搭配：a collection of his ___ of the daily life；observations of + N（對…的觀察心得，指觀察所得時可數，多用複數）

詞彙題.stem: The young couple decided to ______ their wedding until all the details were well taken care of.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這對年輕夫婦決定將婚禮延後，直到所有細節都安排妥當。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 延後, 延期, 延緩；搭配：decided to ___ their wedding；postpone + N／V-ing（延後…）

詞彙題.stem: The conflicts between John and his teacher made it difficult for the teacher to judge his performance _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰與老師之間的衝突，讓老師難以客觀地評斷他的表現。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 客觀地

詞彙題.stem: Living in a highly _____ society, you definitely have to arm yourself with as much knowledge as possible.
詞彙題.stemZh: 生活在一個高度競爭的社會裡，你絕對需要盡可能地充實自己的知識。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 競爭激烈的, 競爭的, 有競爭力的, 好勝的；搭配：Living in a highly ___ society；a highly competitive society（競爭激烈的社會，中文的「競爭」是名詞，這裡要用形容詞）

詞彙題.stem: The 70-year-old professor sued the university for age _____, because his teaching contract had not been renewed.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位 70 歲的教授因教學合約未獲續聘，控告學校年齡歧視。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 歧視, 差別待遇, 辨別力；搭配：sued the university for age ___；age／racial discrimination（年齡／種族歧視）

詞彙題.stem: Kevin burst into tears _____ because his teacher punished him in front of the whole class.
詞彙題.stemZh: 凱文當場就哭了出來，因為老師在全班面前處罰他。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　當場；搭配：Kevin burst into tears ___；on the spot（當場、立刻，介系詞用 on 不用 at）

詞彙題.stem: As soon as the couple realized that they didn’t love each other anymore, they _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這對情侶一發現彼此已不再相愛，便分手了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　分手，解散，破裂（break up 的過去式）；搭配：they didn’t love each other anymore, they ___；break up with sb（分手，講到分手的對象時介系詞要加 with）

詞彙題.stem: The power workers had to work _____ to repair the power lines since the whole city was in the dark.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於全市陷入停電，電力工人必須日夜不停地搶修電線。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　全天候，不分晝夜；搭配：had to work ___ to repair the power lines；work around the clock（日夜不停，當形容詞時寫成 round-the-clock）

詞彙題.stem: After retirement, Mr. Wang _____ ice skating, which he had always loved but had not had time for.
詞彙題.stemZh: 退休後，王先生開始熱衷於溜冰，這是他一直喜愛卻始終沒時間從事的活動。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　開始喜歡，開始從事，養成…的習慣（take to 的過去式）；搭配：Mr. Wang ___ ice skating；take to + V-ing（喜歡上、開始迷上）

詞彙題.stem: Why do we have to _____ Sue’s selfish behavior? We have to teach her to care for others.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們為什麼要容忍蘇自私的行為？我們得教她多關心別人。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　忍受；搭配：___ Sue’s selfish behavior；put up with + N（忍受…）

詞彙題.stem: Jane felt ______ speaking in front of the class but was quite relaxed talking with her good friends.
詞彙題.stemZh: 珍在班上講話時感到很尷尬，但和好朋友聊天時卻相當自在。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 尷尬的, 不自在的, 棘手的, 笨拙的；搭配：Jane felt ___ speaking in front of the class；feel awkward + V-ing（做某事時覺得尷尬、不自在，不是笨拙，接動作用 V-ing 不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: Jack made a(n) ______ payment on the new computer because he did not have enough money for it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克為新電腦支付了部分款項，因為他的錢不夠。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 部分的, 偏袒的, 偏愛的；搭配：Jack made a(n) ___ payment on the new computer；make a partial payment（支付部分款項，中文的「部分」是名詞，這裡要用形容詞）

詞彙題.stem: Joseph’s behavior is so unpredictable that no one can ______ exactly what he will do.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約瑟夫的行為難以預測，沒有人能準確預料他會做什麼。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 預料, 預見, 期盼；搭配：no one can ___ exactly what he will do；anticipate + N／V-ing（預料、預期，接動作用 V-ing 不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: Strict ______ measures are a must when President Chen travels around the island.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當陳總統在全島各地出訪時，嚴格的維安措施是必要的。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 安全, 安全保障, 保護措施, 保全人員, 安全感, 抵押品；搭配：Strict ___ measures are a must；security measures（維安措施，中文的「安全」在這裡要用名詞 security 直接修飾，不用形容詞 secure）

詞彙題.stem: It is impolite to ______ when someone else is speaking. We should wait until the person finishes his turn.
詞彙題.stemZh: 打斷別人說話是不禮貌的，我們應該等對方講完再說。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 打斷, 插嘴, 中斷

詞彙題.stem: Sue would ______ have followed the majority if she didn’t want to get into an argument.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果蘇不想陷入爭執，她無疑會選擇跟隨多數人的意見。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 無疑, 必定, 確實地

詞彙題.stem: As the rumor of his scandal ______ quickly during the election campaign, more and more people began to question the honesty of the candidate.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著他的醜聞謠言在選戰期間迅速傳開，越來越多人開始質疑這位候選人的誠信。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 傳播, 擴散, 蔓延, 展開, 鋪開, 塗；n. 擴散, 蔓延, 範圍；搭配：the rumor of his scandal ___ quickly；a rumor spreads（謠言傳開）

詞彙題.stem: The many awards that Professor Wang has won over the years are clear ______ that he is a distinguished scholar.
詞彙題.stemZh: 王教授多年來獲得的眾多獎項，清楚證明了他是一位傑出的學者。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 證據, 證明, 跡象, 根據；搭配：are clear ___ that he is a distinguished scholar；clear evidence that + 子句（明確證明…，evidence 不可數，不加 s 也不加 a）

詞彙題.stem: Since we are short of manpower in the factory, it is very ______ we will hire some people next month.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於工廠人手不足，我們很可能下個月就會招募一些人員。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 很可能的, 可能發生的；adv. 可能地；搭配：it is very ___ we will hire some people next month；it is likely that + 子句（很可能…，likely 是形容詞，不是 -ly 副詞）

詞彙題.stem: The teacher showed ______ for the noise in the classroom and continued with his lecture as if he had not heard anything.
詞彙題.stemZh: 老師對教室裡的吵鬧聲展現了包容，繼續講課，彷彿什麼都沒聽到。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 寬容, 容忍, 忍受, 忍耐力, 耐受性；搭配：showed ___ for the noise；show tolerance for + N（對…表現寬容）

詞彙題.stem: I will only be away for a week ______-- probably only four or five days.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我最多只會離開一個星期——可能只有四、五天而已。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　至多

詞彙題.stem: During the discussion, all the students presented their ideas ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 討論過程中，所有學生都輪流提出了自己的想法。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　輪流，依次，反過來

詞彙題.stem: The proposal Mr. Lin ______ last week has very little chance of being accepted by the committee.
詞彙題.stemZh: 林先生上週提出的提案，幾乎不太可能被委員會接受。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　提出；搭配：The proposal Mr. Lin ___ last week；put forward a proposal／an idea／a suggestion（提出提案、想法、建議）

詞彙題.stem: The foreigner was speaking so fast that nobody was able to ______ what he was saying.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位外國人講話太快了，沒有人能聽懂他在說什麼。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　辨認出，理解，聽清；搭配：able to ___ what he was saying；make out what sb is saying（聽清楚某人說什麼）

詞彙題.stem: Don’t worry. It’s not the first time we’ve ______ this sort of problem. We’ll soon find a way out.
詞彙題.stemZh: 別擔心，這不是我們第一次遇到這種問題了，我們很快就會找到解決辦法。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　偶然遇到，碰見，給人…的印象；搭配：we’ve ___ this sort of problem；come across + N（偶然碰上…）

詞彙題.stem: The temple stages performances of Taiwanese opera every year as an expression of ______ to the Goddess of Mercy.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這座寺廟每年都上演台灣歌仔戲，以表達對觀音菩薩的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 感激之情；搭配：as an expression of ___ to the Goddess of Mercy；express gratitude to sb for + N（因某事向某人表達感激，to 配人、for 配事）／a debt of gratitude（一份還不了的人情）／in gratitude for + N（為感謝…而做某事）

詞彙題.stem: All the students are required to attend the two-day ______ program so that they can have a complete understanding of the university they are admitted to.
詞彙題.stemZh: 所有學生都必須參加為期兩天的____課程，以便他們能對所錄取的大學有全面的了解。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 培訓, 新生訓練, 方向, 取向；搭配：attend the two-day ___ program；an orientation program（新生訓練）

詞彙題.stem: The ______ of his new album has brought the pop singer a huge fortune as well as worldwide fame.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他新專輯的____為這位流行歌手帶來了巨大的財富和世界性的聲譽。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 發行, 發布, 釋放, 排放, 解脫；v. 釋放, 發行, 發布, 排放；搭配：The ___ of his new album；the release of an album／a film（專輯／電影的發行）

詞彙題.stem: One important purpose of the course is for the students to learn to make sound judgments so that they can ______ between fact and opinion without difficulty.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這門課程的一個重要目的是讓學生學會做出明智的判斷，這樣他們就能毫不困難地____事實和觀點。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 區別, 區分；搭配：___ between fact and opinion；differentiate between A and B（區分 A 與 B）

詞彙題.stem: In Taiwan, using electronic devices is prohibited on domestic flights because it ______ with the communication between the pilots and the control tower.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在台灣，國內航班禁止使用電子設備，因為它會____飛行員和控制塔之間的通訊。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 干擾, 妨礙, 干涉, 干預（interfere 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：it ___ with the communication between the pilots and the control tower；interfere with + N（干擾、妨礙，介系詞用 with）／interfere in + N（插手別人的事，介系詞換成 in 意思就變）／interference（名詞形）

詞彙題.stem: The famous actress decided to sue the magazine for purposely ______ what she actually said and did at the party.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位著名女演員決定起訴該雜誌，因為它故意____了她在派對上實際說的話和做的事。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 歪曲, 曲解, 扭曲, 使變形（distort 的現在分詞）；搭配：purposely ___ what she actually said；distort the facts（扭曲事實）

詞彙題.stem: The little boy is very ______: he is interested in a lot of different things and always wants to find out more about them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個小男孩非常____：他對很多不同的事物感興趣，並且總想了解更多。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 好問的, 想知道的, 好追根究底的；搭配：the little boy is very ___；an inquisitive child／mind（好問的孩子、愛追根究底的頭腦）／be inquisitive about + N（對…充滿好奇，介系詞用 about）

詞彙題.stem: The tourists enjoyed wholeheartedly the ______ scenery along the coast highway between Hualien and Ilan.
詞彙題.stemZh: 遊客們全心全意地享受著花蓮和宜蘭之間沿海公路的____景色。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 美得驚人的, 令人屏息的, 驚險的；搭配：enjoyed wholeheartedly the ___ scenery along the coast highway；breathtaking scenery／view／beauty（令人屏息的景色、景觀、美景）／take one's breath away（動詞說法，同一個意象）

詞彙題.stem: The major theme in the ______ issue of the best-selling monthly magazine will be "Love and Peace."
詞彙題.stemZh: 這本暢銷月刊____一期的主題將是「愛與和平」。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 即將來臨的；搭配：in the ___ issue；the forthcoming issue（即將出刊的一期）

詞彙題.stem: Our English teacher always emphasizes the importance of learning new words in context rather than learning each of them ______.
