詞彙題.stemZh: 我們的英語老師總是強調在上下文中學習新單詞的重要性，而不是____地學習每一個單詞。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 個別地, 分別地, 以個人身分, 獨特地

詞彙題.stem: The old woman at the street corner must be lost. She is looking around ______ for someone to help her.
詞彙題.stemZh: 街角的老太太一定迷路了。她正____地四處尋找人幫助她。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 拚命地, 絕望地, 極度地, 非常；搭配：she is looking around ___ for someone to help her；look／search desperately for + N（拼命尋找，介系詞用 for）／desperately need／want（急需、極想要）／be desperate for + N（形容詞形，介系詞同樣用 for）

詞彙題.stem: John is an experienced salesperson. Just observe closely how he interacts with customers and do ______. Then you will become an expert yourself.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰是一位經驗豐富的銷售員。只要仔細觀察他如何與顧客互動並____做。那麼你就會成為專家。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 同樣地, 照樣, 也；搭配：observe closely how he interacts with customers and do ___；do likewise（照著做、比照辦理，動詞固定用 do）／and likewise（也、同樣地，用來承接前一句）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: Ms. Lin is a loving and caring teacher, but so far her students have shown little ____ for what she has done for them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 林老師是一位有愛心和關懷的老師，但到目前為止，她的學生對她為他們所做的一切幾乎沒有表現出____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 感激, 賞識, 鑑別；搭配：her students have shown little ___ for what she has done for them；show appreciation for + N（對某事表示感謝，介系詞用 for）／in appreciation of + N（為表達對…的感謝）／appreciate + N（動詞形，後面直接接名詞）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: The university Susan is admitted to has been noted for making research in science and technology a high ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 蘇珊被錄取的大學以將科技研究列為高度____而聞名。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 優先事項, 優先順序, 優先權；搭配：making research in science and technology a high ___；make sth a high／top priority（把某事列為第一優先）／give priority to + N（優先處理…，介系詞用 to）／set priorities（排定優先順序，慣用複數）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: Many countries have been in recession for a long time; therefore, a lot of people look forward to economic ________ in the coming year.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多國家長期處於衰退之中；因此，很多人期盼來年經濟____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 繁榮, 茂盛, 成功；搭配：a lot of people look forward to economic ___ in the coming year；economic prosperity（經濟繁榮）／bring／achieve prosperity（帶來、達成繁榮）／peace and prosperity（國泰民安，並列順序固定）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: The coast guard last night successfully ________ boats which were trying to smuggle drugs and other illegal items from a neighboring country.
詞彙題.stemZh: 海岸警衛隊昨晚成功____了試圖從鄰國走私毒品和其他非法物品的船隻。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 攔截, 截住（intercept 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：the coast guard last night successfully ___ boats；intercept a shipment／a message／a phone call（攔截貨運、訊息、電話）／be intercepted by + N（被…攔下，慣用被動）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: The scientists have focused all their attention on _____ industrial waste into valuable materials.
詞彙題.stemZh: 科學家們將所有注意力都集中在將工業廢料____成有價值的材料上。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 轉換, 轉化, 改變, 改信（宗教）（convert 的現在分詞）；搭配：focused all their attention on ___ industrial waste into valuable materials；convert A into B（把 A 轉換成 B，介系詞用 into）／convert to + N（改信、改用，另一個意思）／conversion（名詞形）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: Because of the tragic accident, traffic on the highway was ________ for over two hours.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於這起悲慘的事故，高速公路上的交通被____了兩個多小時。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 中斷, 擾亂, 打斷（disrupt 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：traffic on the highway was ___ for over two hours；disrupt traffic／a meeting／supply chains（中斷交通、打斷會議、擾亂供應鏈）／be disrupted by + N（因…而中斷，慣用被動）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: This new type of surgery is popular because the recovery time is much shorter than that required in _____ surgeries.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這種新型手術之所以受歡迎，是因為其恢復時間比____手術所需的時間短得多。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 傳統的, 常規的, 慣例的；搭配：that required in ___ surgeries；conventional methods／wisdom（傳統方法／世俗看法）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: With the pale-white walls and bed sheets, hospitals always look very ___ to me.
詞彙題.stemZh: 有著蒼白的牆壁和床單，醫院對我來說總是看起來很____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 沒有人情味的, 冷淡的, 客觀的, 非個人的

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: I just cannot figure out why John did such a stupid thing! He must have gone totally ________.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我就是想不通約翰為什麼會做這麼蠢的事！他一定是完全____了。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 瘋狂的, 精神失常的, 荒唐的；搭配：he must have gone totally ___；go insane／mad／crazy（發瘋，動詞固定用 go，不用 become）／drive sb insane（把某人逼瘋）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: Smoking, as proven in many medical studies, is likely to damage the human body _____ .
詞彙題.stemZh: 正如許多醫學研究所證明的，吸菸很可能____損害人體。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 永久地, 持久地, 長久地；搭配：smoking is likely to damage the human body ___；permanently damage／disable／close（永久損害、致殘、永久歇業）／permanent damage／residence（形容詞形，永久性傷害、永久居留權）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: We must be extremely careful about what we read in the newspaper because the reports are not ________ true and accurate.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們必須對報紙上讀到的內容極其小心，因為報導不____真實和準確。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 必然地, 必定, 不可避免地；搭配：the reports are not ___ true and accurate；not necessarily true／wrong／equal（未必是真的、未必是錯的、未必相等）／not necessarily indicative of + N（未必代表…）／therefore／thus necessarily（因此必然，肯定句的用法）

詞彙題.exam: 敏督利颱風受災地區考生補救考試
詞彙題.stem: After graduation, Mr. Chang worked very hard and won several cases. He ________ built up a reputation as a successful lawyer.
詞彙題.stemZh: 畢業後，張先生非常努力工作並贏得了幾起案件。他____建立起作為一名成功律師的聲譽。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 逐漸地；搭配：He ___ built up a reputation；gradually build up a reputation（漸漸打響名號）

詞彙題.stem: I called the airline to ______ my flight reservation a week before I left for Canada.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我在前往加拿大的一週前，打電話給航空公司確認我的機票訂位。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 確認, 證實, 確定

詞彙題.stem: In order to write a report on stars, we decided to ______ the stars in the sky every night.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了寫一篇關於星星的報告，我們決定每晚觀察天上的星星。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 觀察, 觀測, 注意到, 察覺到, 遵守, 評論；搭配：we decided to ___ the stars in the sky；observe + N（觀察，另有兩個搭配，observe the rules 遵守規則、observe a holiday 過節，都直接接受詞）

詞彙題.stem: Julie wants to buy a ______ computer so that she can carry it around when she travels.
詞彙題.stemZh: 茱莉想買一台可攜式電腦，這樣她旅行時就能隨身攜帶。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 可攜帶的, 可搬運的, 可移動的；搭配：Julie wants to buy a ___ computer；a portable computer／radio／charger（可攜式的、手提的，中文的「攜帶」會讓人只想到 carry，形容詞要用 portable）

詞彙題.stem: My grandmother likes to surprise people. She never calls ______ to inform us of her visits.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我奶奶喜歡給人驚喜，她從不事先打電話通知我們她要來訪。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 事先, 預先

詞彙題.stem: As the tallest building in the world, Taipei 101 has become a new ______ of Taipei City.
詞彙題.stemZh: 身為世界最高的建築，台北 101 已成為台北市的新地標。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 地標, 標誌性建築, 里程碑；搭配：has become a new ___ of Taipei City；a landmark of + 地方（…的地標，用 of 不用 in，另有 a landmark decision 是劃時代的決定）

詞彙題.stem: Many scholars and experts from all over the world will be invited to attend this yearly ______ on drug control.
詞彙題.stemZh: 世界各地許多學者專家將受邀出席這場關於毒品管制的年度會議。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 會議, 研討會；搭配：this yearly ___ on drug control；a conference on + 主題（關於…的會議，主題用 on 不用 about）

詞彙題.stem: John had failed to pay his phone bills for months, so his telephone was ______ last week.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰好幾個月沒繳電話費，所以他的電話上週被停話了。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 切斷, 停止供應, 使分離（disconnect 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 不連貫的；搭配：his telephone was ___ last week；disconnect the phone／the power（停話、斷電，指切斷線路或供應）

詞彙題.stem: The organic food products are made of natural ingredients, with no ______ flavors added.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些有機食品是用天然原料製成的，沒有添加任何人工香料。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 人工的, 人造的, 假的, 不自然的；搭配：with no ___ flavors added；artificial flavors／colors（人工香料、人工色素，食品標示上習慣用複數）

詞彙題.stem: Jessica is a very religious girl; she believes that she is always ______ supported by her god.
詞彙題.stemZh: 潔西卡是個非常虔誠的女孩；她相信自己在心靈上總是受到神的支持。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 精神上, 心靈上, 在宗教上

詞彙題.stem: Jane usually buys things on ______. Her purchases seem to be driven by some sudden force or desire.
詞彙題.stemZh: 珍通常都是一時衝動購物，她的購買行為似乎是受某種突然的衝動驅使。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 衝動, 一時的念頭, 動力, 刺激, 脈衝；搭配：Jane usually buys things on ___；buy sth on impulse（一時衝動買東西，impulse 這個意思固定配 on）

詞彙題.stem: The week-long rainfall has ______ landslides and flooding in the mountain areas.
詞彙題.stemZh: 長達一週的降雨已在山區引發了土石流與淹水。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　造成，引起（bring about 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：has ___ landslides and flooding；bring about change／damage／landslides（造成、導致，接的是變化或災害這一類的結果）

詞彙題.stem: In the cross-lake swimming race, a boat will be _____ in case of an emergency.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在橫渡湖泊的游泳比賽中，將有一艘船隨時待命，以防發生緊急狀況。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　待命，做好準備，支持，袖手旁觀（stand by 的現在分詞）

詞彙題.stem: The ground is slippery. Hold onto the rope and don’t ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 地面很滑，抓緊繩子，不要放手。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　放手，釋放；搭配：Hold onto the rope and don’t ___；let go of + N（放開…）

詞彙題.stem: ______ the weather, the athletic meetings will be held on time.
詞彙題.stemZh: 不論天氣如何，運動會都將如期舉行。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　不論，不顧；搭配：___ the weather, the athletic meetings will be held on time；regardless of + N（不論…，後面接名詞）

詞彙題.stem: If people keep polluting the rivers, no fish there will survive ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果人們持續污染河川，長遠來看那裡的魚都無法存活。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　長遠來看

詞彙題.stem: We have had plenty of rain so far this year, so there should be an ______ supply of fresh water this summer.
詞彙題.stemZh: 今年到目前為止雨水充沛，所以今年夏天應該有____的淡水供應。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 豐富的, 充分的, 大量的；搭配：there should be an ___ supply of fresh water；an abundant supply of + N（充足的…供應）／abundant resources／rainfall／evidence（豐富的資源、充沛的雨量、大量的證據）／be abundant in + N（富含…，介系詞用 in）

詞彙題.stem: I don't know for sure what I am going to do this weekend, but ______ I plan to visit an old friend of mine in southern Taiwan.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我不確定這個週末要做什麼，但我____計劃去南台灣拜訪一位老朋友。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 暫時地, 試探性地, 猶豫地, 遲疑不決地；搭配：but ___ I plan to visit an old friend；tentatively scheduled（暫定於）

詞彙題.stem: Our chemistry teacher was on a one-month sick leave, so the principal had to find a teacher to ______ for her.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們的化學老師請了一個月的病假，所以校長必須找一位老師來____她。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 代替, 取代, 用…代替；n. 替代品, 代替物, 代課教師, 替補隊員；搭配：the principal had to find a teacher to ___ for her；substitute for sb（代替某人，介系詞用 for）／substitute A for B（用 A 代替 B，被換掉的那一個放在 for 後面，replace A with B 正好相反，見 94 學測第 11 題）／a substitute for + N（…的替代品）

詞彙題.stem: The gym is closed on Monday for routine ______ work. The facilities are kept in good condition by the regular checking and repairing.
詞彙題.stemZh: 健身房週一因例行____工作而關閉。設施藉由定期檢查和維修保持良好狀態。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 維護, 保養, 維修, 維持, 撫養費；搭配：The gym is closed on Monday for routine ___ work；routine／regular maintenance（例行維修、定期保養）／maintenance work／costs（維修工作、維護費用）／carry out maintenance on + N（對…進行維修）

詞彙題.stem: If you exercise regularly, your blood ______ will be improved, and you will feel more energetic.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你定期運動，你的血液____會得到改善，你會感覺更有活力。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 流通, 循環, 發行量；搭配：your blood ___ will be improved；blood circulation（血液循環）／improve／promote circulation（改善、促進循環）／poor circulation（循環不良）／in circulation（流通中，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Nowadays people have to pass various tests for professional ______ so that they can be qualified for a well-paying job.
詞彙題.stemZh: 現在人們必須通過各種專業____考試，才能有資格獲得一份高薪工作。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 證書, 證明, 執照（certificate 的複數）；搭配：pass various tests for professional ___；a professional certificate（專業證照）

詞彙題.stem: Though Dr. Wang has been away from his hometown for over ten years, he can still ______ his old house clearly.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然王博士離開家鄉十多年了，他仍然能清晰地____他舊家的樣子。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 想像, 設想, 使形象化, 視覺化；搭配：can still ___ his old house clearly；visualize a scene（想像出某個畫面）

詞彙題.stem: The speaker spent twenty minutes on one simple question. The explanation was so ______ that we could not see the point clearly.
詞彙題.stemZh: 演講者花二十分鐘講一個簡單的問題。解釋太____了，以致我們無法清楚地看到要點。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 冗長的, 漫長的；搭配：The explanation was so ___ that we could not see the point clearly；a lengthy discussion／explanation／process（冗長的討論、說明、過程，含「太長而讓人不耐」的評價，不等於中性的 long）／a lengthy delay（久候的延誤）

詞彙題.stem: The new tax policy proposed for the next fiscal year has been severely criticized by the ______ party leaders.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為下一個會計年度提出的新稅收政策受到了____黨領導人的嚴厲批評。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 反對, 反抗, 對手, 在野黨, 反對黨；搭配：criticized by the ___ party leaders；the opposition party／leader（在野黨、在野黨領袖）／strong／fierce opposition to + N（對…的強烈反對，介系詞用 to，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Thousands of people flooded into the city to join the demonstration; as a result, the city's transportation system was almost ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 成千上萬的人湧入城市參加示威；結果，該市的交通系統幾乎____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 癱瘓的, 麻痺的, 停擺的；搭配：transportation system was almost ___；be paralyzed by a strike（因罷工而癱瘓）

詞彙題.stem: As computers are getting less expensive, they are _______ used in schools and offices today.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著電腦價格越來越便宜，如今學校和辦公室都廣泛使用電腦。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 廣泛地；搭配：they are ___ used in schools and offices；be widely used／known／accepted（廣泛地被使用／被知道／被接受，widely 慣常搭配過去分詞）

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Chang always tries to answer all questions from his students. He will not _____ any of them even if they may sound stupid.
詞彙題.stemZh: 張老師總是盡力回答學生所有的問題，即使問題聽起來很蠢，他也不會忽視。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 忽視, 不理睬, 忽略

詞彙題.stem: Irene does not throw away used envelopes. She ____ them by using them for taking telephone messages.
詞彙題.stemZh: 艾琳不會丟棄用過的信封，她會回收利用來記錄電話留言。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 回收利用, 再利用, 重新使用（recycle 的第三人稱單數）

詞彙題.stem: Cheese, powdered milk, and yogurt are common milk ____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 起司、奶粉和優格都是常見的乳製品。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 產品, 製品, 產物（product 的複數）；搭配：are common milk ___；milk／dairy／agricultural products（乳製品／農產品，前面直接擺名詞當修飾語，不用 of）

詞彙題.stem: Although he is a chef, Roberto _____ cooks his own meals.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然羅伯托是一名廚師，但他很少自己下廚做飯。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 很少地, 罕有地

詞彙題.stem: Due to the yearly bonus system, the 100 ________ positions in this high-tech company have attracted many applicants from around the island.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於年終獎金制度，這家高科技公司的 100 個職缺吸引了全島各地許多應徵者。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 空的, 空缺的, 閒置的, 茫然的；搭配：the 100 ___ positions；a vacant position／seat（沒人占用的職位／座位，empty 講的是容器裡面空的）

詞彙題.stem: If you want to borrow magazines, tapes, or CDs, you can visit the library. They are all ______ there.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你想借雜誌、錄音帶或光碟，可以去圖書館，那裡都有。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 可獲得的, 可利用的, 有空的；搭配：They are all ___ there；be available to + 人／available for + 用途（開放給某人／供某用途使用）

詞彙題.stem: The fire in the fireworks factory in Changhua set off a series of powerful  _________ and killed four people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彰化一間煙火工廠發生火災，引發一連串猛烈爆炸，造成四人死亡。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 爆炸, 爆發, 激增（explosion 的複數）；搭配：set off a series of powerful ___；set off／cause an explosion（引發爆炸，中文說「引發」而英文不用 make）

詞彙題.stem: A good government official has to ________ the temptation of money and make the right decision.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一位優秀的政府官員必須抵抗金錢的誘惑，做出正確的決定。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 抵抗, 抗拒, 忍住, 抵制, 反抗；搭配：___ the temptation of money；resist temptation（抵擋誘惑）

詞彙題.stem: The drug dealer was ________ by the police while he was selling cocaine to a high school student.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這名毒販在向一名高中生販賣古柯鹼時被警方逮捕。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 逮捕, 拘留, 阻止, 吸引（注意）（arrest 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：The drug dealer was ___ by the police；be arrested for + 罪名（因某罪名被逮捕，by 後面帶的是執法的一方）

詞彙題.stem: The rise of oil prices made scientists search for new energy resources to ______ oil.
詞彙題.stemZh: 油價上漲促使科學家尋找能取代石油的新能源。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 取代, 代替, 替換, 更換, 放回；搭配：new energy resources to ___ oil；replace A with B（用 B 取代 A，中文先講 B，英文的受詞卻是被換掉的 A。substitute 剛好相反：substitute B for A 才是用 B 代替 A。replace A as B 這個用法見 102 年學測第 2 題）

詞彙題.stem: Without much contact with the outside world for many years, John found many technological inventions _____ to him.
詞彙題.stemZh: 多年來與外界甚少接觸，約翰發現許多科技發明對他來說都很陌生。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 外國的, 外來的, 陌生的, 不相關的；搭配：found many technological inventions ___ to him；be foreign to sb（對某人來說很陌生、格格不入，介系詞用 to）

詞彙題.stem: The medicine you take for a cold may cause _____; try not to drive after you take it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 你吃的感冒藥可能會導致嗜睡，服用後盡量避免開車。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 睡意, 嗜睡, 睏倦；搭配：The medicine you take for a cold may cause ___；cause／induce drowsiness（造成／引發睡意，中文的「造成」不用 make，同組的副作用名詞還有 dizziness 頭暈、nausea 噁心）

詞彙題.stem: To gain more ______, some legislators would get into violent physical fights so that they may appear in TV news reports.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了獲得更多曝光度，有些立委會做出激烈的肢體衝突，好讓自己出現在電視新聞報導中。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 宣傳, 關注, 名聲；搭配：To gain more ___；gain publicity（獲得曝光）

詞彙題.stem: To live an efficient life, we have to arrange the things to do in order of _____ and start with the most important ones.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了有效率地生活，我們必須依優先順序安排要做的事，先從最重要的開始。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 優先事項, 優先順序, 優先權；搭配：arrange the things to do in order of ___；give priority to + N（把…列為優先處理，介系詞用 to）

詞彙題.stem: Mastery of English ______ us with a very important tool for acquiring knowledge and information.
詞彙題.stemZh: 精通英語為我們____了一個獲取知識和資訊的非常重要的工具。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 使具備, 使有能力, 裝備, 配備（equip 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：___ us with a very important tool；equip sb with sth（使某人具備…）

詞彙題.stem: Languages change all the time. Many words that were found in Shakespeare's works are no longer in ______ use.
詞彙題.stemZh: 語言總是在變化。莎士比亞作品中發現的許多詞彙現在已不再____使用。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 當前的, 現行的, 通用的, 流通的；n. 水流, 電流, 潮流；搭配：are no longer in ___ use；in current use（仍在使用中，另有 in common use 與 in general use 同型）／current affairs／trends（時事、當前趨勢）／current studies（當前的研究，110 學測文意選填第 34 格考過同一組）

詞彙題.stem: Do not just sit and wait ______ for a good chance to come to you. You have to take the initiative and create chances for yourself.
詞彙題.stemZh: 不要只是坐著____等待好機會來找你。你必須主動出擊，為自己創造機會。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 被動地, 消極地；搭配：Do not just sit and wait ___ for a good chance to come to you；passively wait／sit by／accept（被動地等待、坐視不管、消極接受，配的是不採取行動的那一類動詞）／passively ↔ actively（與主動正好相反，下一句的 take the initiative 即是）

詞彙題.stem: Identical twins have almost all of their genes in common, so any ______ between them is in large part due to the effects of the environment.
詞彙題.stemZh: 同卵雙胞胎幾乎擁有所有共同的基因，所以他們之間的任何____很大程度上都是由於環境的影響。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 變化, 變異, 變動, 變種, 變奏曲；搭配：any ___ between them；variation between／in + N（…之間／…方面的差異）

詞彙題.stem: People believed in the ______ of the judge, so they were shocked to hear that he was involved in the bribery scandal.
詞彙題.stemZh: 人們相信法官的____，所以當聽說他捲入賄賂醜聞時，他們感到震驚。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 正直, 廉正, 完整；搭配：believed in the ___ of the judge；professional integrity（職業操守）

詞彙題.stem: The discovery of the new vaccine is an important ______ in the fight against avian flu.
詞彙題.stemZh: 新疫苗的發現是對抗禽流感戰役中的一個重要____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 突破, 重大進展；搭配：is an important ___ in the fight against avian flu；make／achieve a breakthrough（取得突破，動詞用 make 或 achieve）／a major／significant breakthrough（重大的、重要的突破）／a breakthrough in + N（在…方面的突破，介系詞用 in）

詞彙題.stem: To avoid being misled by news reports, we should learn to ______ between facts and opinions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了避免被新聞報導誤導，我們應該學會____事實和觀點。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 區別, 辨別；搭配：we should learn to ___ between facts and opinions；distinguish between A and B（分辨 A 與 B，本題即此型）／distinguish A from B（把 A 與 B 區分開來，110 指考文意選填第 22 格考過同一組）／distinguish oneself（表現傑出，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: After the big flood, the area was mostly ______, with only one or two homes still clinging to their last relics.
詞彙題.stemZh: 大洪水過後，該地區大部分被____，只剩下一兩戶人家還守著最後的殘跡。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 空無一人的, 荒廢的, 廢棄的；v. 拋棄, 遺棄（desert 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：the area was mostly ___；a deserted village／street（荒廢的村莊／空蕩的街道）

詞彙題.stem: In his speech, Dr. Huang presented all the reports about the energy crisis to ______ the need for developing new energy resources.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在他的演講中，黃博士提出了所有關於能源危機的報告，以____發展新能源的必要性。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 強調, 使顯著, 突出；n. 最精彩的部分；搭配：to ___ the need for developing new energy；highlight the need for + N（凸顯…的必要）

詞彙題.stem: Hearing the art critic's bitter and ______ comments on her new painting, Molly started a heated argument with him.
詞彙題.stemZh: 聽到藝術評論家對她的新畫作所做的尖酸刻薄和____的評論，莫莉開始與他激烈爭論。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 駭人的, 極無禮的, 無法接受的, 離譜的；搭配：bitter and ___ comments；outrageous comments／behavior（過分的言論／行為）

詞彙題.stem: If we can ______ to, we will take a vacation abroad in the summer.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果經濟能力許可，我們夏天會出國度假。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 買得起, 負擔得起, 提供；搭配：If we can ___ to, we will take a vacation abroad；can／can't afford + N／to V（買得起，幾乎只出現在 can、could、be able to 之後）

詞彙題.stem: A ______ mistake found in parenthood is that parents often set unrealistic goals for their children.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為人父母常犯的一個錯誤，就是常為孩子設定不切實際的目標。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 常見的, 普遍的, 共同的, 普通的；搭配：A ___ mistake found in parenthood；a common mistake／common sense／common ground（常犯的錯誤／常識／共同點，形容詞用 common，不用 usual 或 often）

詞彙題.stem: Some words, such as “sandwich” and “hamburger,” were ______ the names of people or even towns.
詞彙題.stemZh: 有些字，像是「三明治」和「漢堡」，原本是人名，甚至是城鎮的名字。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 原本, 本來, 原來, 起初

詞彙題.stem: Have you ever ______ how the ancient Egyptians created such marvelous feats of engineering as the pyramids?
詞彙題.stemZh: 你是否曾經好奇，古埃及人是如何創造出金字塔這樣驚人的工程壯舉？
詞彙題.explanation: v. 想知道, 好奇, 感到驚訝（wonder 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Have you ever ___ how the ancient Egyptians created；wonder how／why／if + 子句（好奇、想知道，後面直接接子句，不加 about）

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Johnson was disappointed at his students for having a passive learning ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 強森老師對學生消極被動的學習態度感到失望。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 態度, 看法, 姿勢；搭配：for having a passive learning ___；one's attitude toward／to + N（對某事的態度，用 toward 或 to，不用 for）

詞彙題.stem: Anne dreaded giving a speech before three hundred people; even thinking about it made her ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 安很害怕在三百人面前演講；光是想到這件事就讓她感到焦慮。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 焦慮的, 不安的, 渴望的；搭配：even thinking about it made her ___；be anxious about + N／be anxious to + V（前者是擔心某事，後者是急著想做某事）；anxious parents／patients／contestants、an anxious wait（焦急的父母／病人／參賽者、焦慮的等待，放在名詞前面）

詞彙題.stem: I had to ______ Jack’s invitation to the party because it conflicted with an important business meeting.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我不得不婉拒傑克的派對邀請，因為時間和一場重要的商務會議衝突。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 婉拒, 謝絕, 減少, 衰退；n. 衰退, 減少；搭配：I had to ___ Jack’s invitation to the party；decline an invitation／an offer／a request（婉拒邀請、提議、請求）

詞彙題.stem: Selling fried chicken at the night market doesn’t seem to be a decent business, but it is actually quite ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在夜市賣炸雞看似不是什麼體面的生意，但其實相當賺錢。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 賺錢的, 有利潤的, 有益的；搭配：but it is actually quite ___；a profitable business／venture／investment（賺錢的生意／事業／投資）

詞彙題.stem: The passengers ______ escaped death when a bomb exploded in the subway station, killing sixty people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一顆炸彈在地鐵站爆炸，造成 60 人死亡，這些乘客僥倖逃過一劫。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 勉強地, 差一點, 僥倖地, 狹義地, 仔細地；搭配：The passengers ___ escaped death；narrowly escape death／injury／defeat（差一點就沒命／受傷／落敗）

詞彙題.stem: Jerry didn’t ______ his primary school classmate Mary until he listened to her self-introduction.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑瑞直到聽了瑪麗的自我介紹後，才認出她是自己的小學同學。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 認出, 認可, 承認, 公認, 識別, 賞識；搭配：Jerry didn’t ___ his primary school classmate Mary；can hardly recognize sb／recognize A as B（幾乎認不出某人／認出 A 是 B）

詞彙題.stem: With the completion of several public ______ projects, such as the MRT, commuting to work has become easier for people living in the suburbs.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著捷運等多項公共運輸建設完工，郊區居民通勤上班變得更加便利。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 運輸, 交通運輸, 交通工具, 輸送；搭配：several public ___ projects, such as the MRT；public transportation／means of transportation（大眾運輸／交通工具，車流量才是 traffic）

詞彙題.stem: With a good ______ of both Chinese and English, Miss Lin was assigned the task of oral interpretation for the visiting American delegation.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於精通中英雙語，林小姐被指派為來訪美國代表團擔任口譯工作。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 掌握, 運用能力, 命令, 指揮, 控制；v. 命令, 指揮；搭配：a good ___ of both Chinese and English；have a good command of + 語言（精通某語言）

詞彙題.stem: I am studying so hard for the forthcoming entrance exam that I do not have the ______ of a free weekend to rest.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我正為即將到來的入學考試拚命讀書，根本沒有奢侈的空閒週末可以休息。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 奢侈, 豪華；搭配：I do not have the ___ of a free weekend；have the luxury of + N／V-ing（奢侈到還有餘裕做某事）

詞彙題.stem: Kim was completely ______ after jogging in the hot sun all afternoon; she had little energy left.
詞彙題.stemZh: 金在烈日下慢跑了一整個下午後，整個人筋疲力盡，幾乎沒有力氣了。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　筋疲力盡的，疲憊不堪的，用壞的，不能再用的

詞彙題.stem: When Jason failed to pay his bill, the network company ______ his Internet connection.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑森未繳費，網路公司便切斷了他的網路連線。
詞彙題.explanation: 片語　切斷，中斷；搭配：the network company ___ his Internet connection；cut off the power／the water／the Internet connection（切斷電力／自來水／網路連線）

詞彙題.stem: With his excellent social skills, Steven has been ______ as a great communicator by all his colleagues.
詞彙題.stemZh: 憑藉他出色的社交技巧，史蒂文被所有同事____為一位偉大的溝通者。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 視為, 認為, 看待, 察覺, 意識到（perceive 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：has been ___ as a great communicator；be perceived as + N（被視為…）

詞彙題.stem: When you enter a building, be sure to look behind you and hold the door open for someone coming through the same door. It is a common ______ in many cultures.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當你進入一棟建築物時，一定要向後看，為從同一個門進來的人把門扶住。這在許多文化中是一種常見的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 禮貌, 禮節, 謙恭, 好意；搭配：It is a common ___ in many cultures；a common courtesy（一種基本禮節，可數用法）／out of courtesy（另一個意思，出於禮貌，不用 from，見 85 推薦甄選第 4 題）

詞彙題.stem: The telephone has changed beyond ______ in recent years. In both form and function, it has become totally different from what it was before.
詞彙題.stemZh: 近年來，電話的變化已經到了無法____的程度。無論在形式還是功能上，它都與以前完全不同了。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 認出, 識別, 承認, 認可, 賞識, 讚譽；搭配：has changed beyond ___；change beyond recognition（變得面目全非）

詞彙題.stem: Though Jack has moved out of his parents' house, he is dependent on them ______ still. They send him a check every month for his living expenses.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然傑克已經搬出父母家，但他仍然____依賴他們。他們每個月都會寄支票給他當作生活費。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 財務上, 經濟上, 金融上；搭配：he is dependent on them ___ still；be financially dependent on sb（金錢上依賴某人）／be financially independent（經濟獨立）／financially secure（經濟上有保障）

詞彙題.stem: If you want to keep your computer from being attacked by new viruses, you need to constantly renew and ______ your anti-virus software.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你想讓你的電腦不被新病毒攻擊，你需要不斷更新和____你的防毒軟體。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 更新, 使現代化；搭配：you need to constantly renew and ___ your anti-virus software；update software／a database／records（更新軟體、資料庫、紀錄）／keep sb updated on + N（隨時向某人回報最新狀況）

詞彙題.stem: Many factors may explain why people are addicted to the Internet. One factor ______ to this phenomenon is the easy access to the Net.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多因素可以解釋為什麼人們會沉迷於網路。造成這種現象的一個因素是網路的易於接觸。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 促成, 有助於, 貢獻, 捐獻（contribute 的現在分詞）；搭配：One factor ___ to this phenomenon；a contributing factor（促成的因素）

詞彙題.stem: We were awaiting ______ the results of the school's annual English drama contest. Our class won the first place last year, and we certainly wanted to win again this year.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們____地等待著學校年度英語戲劇比賽的結果。我們班去年得了第一名，我們當然希望今年能再贏一次。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 憂慮地, 不安地；搭配：We were awaiting ___ the results；anxiously await + N（焦急等待，本題把副詞放在動詞與受詞之間）／look／search anxiously for + N（焦急地找，副詞跟在動詞後面，見 107 學測第 8 題）

詞彙題.stem: Tropical rainforests are home to about one million plant and animal species. If the rainforests disappear, many of these species will become ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 熱帶雨林是約一百萬種動植物的家園。如果雨林消失，許多這些物種將會____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 滅絕的, 絕種的, （火山）不活躍的；搭配：many of these species will become ___；become／go extinct（絕種）／an extinct species／volcano（已滅絕的物種、死火山）／extinction（詞形，滅絕）

詞彙題.stem: An honest person is faithful to his promise. Once he makes a ______, he will not go back on his own word.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一個誠實的人會信守他的諾言。一旦他做出____，他就不會食言。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 承諾, 保證, 投入, 奉獻, 忠誠；搭配：Once he makes a ___, he will not go back on his own word；make a commitment（做出承諾）／a firm／long-term commitment to + N（堅定的、長期的投入）／動詞 commit 的用法見 110 學測第 14 題

詞彙題.stem: The new computer game Wii provides us with an ______ way of exercising. People now may play sports in their living rooms, which was unimaginable before.
詞彙題.stemZh: 新的電腦遊戲 Wii 為我們提供了一種____的運動方式。人們現在可以在客廳裡運動，這在以前是無法想像的。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 革新的, 創新的, 富有革新精神的；搭配：provides us with an ___ way of exercising；innovative ways to + V（創新的…方式，本題的用法）／an innovative solution／approach to + N（創新的解方、對應某事的創新做法）／innovative ideas／technology／design（創新的構想、技術、設計）

詞彙題.stem: The movie director adapted this year’s bestseller into a hit and made a ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位電影導演把今年的暢銷書改編成賣座電影，賺進了一大筆財富。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 財富, 一大筆錢, 運氣, 命運；搭配：made a ___；make a fortune（賺大錢）

詞彙題.stem: Wang Chien-ming, the Yankees’ best pitcher last year, already showed his great _____ for baseball when he was still a teenager.
詞彙題.stemZh: 王建民——去年洋基隊最出色的投手——早在青少年時期就已展現出他在棒球方面的過人潛力。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 潛力, 潛能, 可能性；adj. 潛在的, 可能的；搭配：already showed his great ___ for baseball；show／have great potential for + N（展現在某方面的潛力，用 for 不用 of）

詞彙題.stem: Although Jeffery had to keep two part-time jobs to support his family, he never ______ his studies. In fact, he graduated with honors.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管傑弗瑞得同時打兩份工來養家，他從未忽略自己的學業，事實上他還以優異成績畢業。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 忽略, 忽視, 疏忽（neglect 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：he never ___ his studies；neglect one's studies／duty／health（疏忽學業、職責、健康，直接接受詞）

詞彙題.stem: If it is too cold in this room, you can ______ the air conditioner to make yourself feel comfortable.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果這個房間太冷，你可以調整空調讓自己感覺舒適一點。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 調整, 適應, 校準；搭配：you can ___ the air conditioner；adjust + N／adjust to + N（前者是調整某物，後者是適應新環境）

詞彙題.stem: This course will provide students with a solid ______ for research. It is highly recommended for those who plan to go to graduate school.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這門課將為學生打下紮實的研究基礎，非常推薦給打算讀研究所的人。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 基礎, 根據, 創建, 基金會；搭配：provide students with a solid ___ for research；lay／provide a solid foundation for + N（為某事打下紮實的基礎）

詞彙題.stem: Peter is now living on a ______ of NT$100 per day. He cannot afford any recreational activities.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彼得現在每天靠新台幣 100 元的預算過活，負擔不起任何休閒活動。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 預算；搭配：Peter is now living on a ___ of NT$100 per day；live on a tight／limited budget（靠有限的預算過活，用 on 不用 with）

詞彙題.stem: Amy succeeded in ______ for a raise though her boss didn’t agree to increase her salary at first.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管老闆一開始不同意加薪，艾咪最終還是協商成功爭取到加薪。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 協商, 談判, 交涉（negotiate 的現在分詞）；搭配：succeeded in ___ for a raise；succeed in + V-ing（成功做到…）。其中 succeed in + V-ing 這一組考過 3 個年度，學測克漏字 87 年第 24 題、102 年第 29 題都出現過。

詞彙題.stem: Ms. Li’s business ______ very quickly. She opened her first store two years ago; now she has fifty stores all over the country.
詞彙題.stemZh: 李小姐的事業擴張得很快，她兩年前開了第一間店，如今全國已有五十家分店。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 擴大, 擴張, 擴展, 膨脹, 詳述（expand 的過去式及過去分詞）

詞彙題.stem: Ruth is a very ____ person. She cannot take any criticism and always finds excuses to justify herself.
詞彙題.stemZh: 露絲是個防衛心很重的人，她無法接受任何批評，總是為自己找藉口辯解。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 防衛的, 防禦性的, 懷有戒心的, 防守的；搭配：a very ___ person；be defensive about + N（對…聽不得批評）

詞彙題.stem: It’s a pity that you have to leave so soon. I ______ hope that you will come back very soon.
詞彙題.stemZh: 你這麼快就得離開真是可惜，我誠心希望你能盡快再回來。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 真誠地；搭配：I ___ hope that you will come back very soon；sincerely hope／apologize／regret（誠心希望、鄭重道歉、深感遺憾，後面接的是表達心意的動詞）

詞彙題.stem: We human beings may live without clothes, but food and air are ______ to our life.
詞彙題.stemZh: 人類或許可以沒有衣服生活，但食物和空氣對我們的生命是不可或缺的。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 必要的, 不可或缺的, 本質的；n. 必需品；搭配：food and air are ___ to our life；be essential to／for + N（對某人某事不可或缺）

詞彙題.stem: The manager ______ without hesitation after he had been offered a better job in another company.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位經理在獲得另一家公司更好的工作機會後，毫不猶豫地辭職了。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 辭職, 辭去, 放棄（resign 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 聽天由命的, 順從的, 不得不接受的；搭配：The manager ___ without hesitation；resign from + N（辭去…職務）

詞彙題.stem: Many important legal ______ concerning the tragic incident have now been preserved in the museum.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多與這起悲劇事件相關的重要法律文件，如今都保存在博物館裡。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 文件（document 的複數）；搭配：legal ___ concerning the incident；a legal document（法律文件，不是 law document）

詞彙題.stem: I’m not sure exactly how much scholarship you’ll receive, but it will _____ cover your major expenses.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我不確定你能拿到多少獎學金，但大致上應該足以支付你的主要開銷。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 大約, 大致上, 粗略地, 粗糙地, 粗暴地；搭配：it will ___ cover your major expenses；a rough estimate（粗估）

詞彙題.stem: Tom was very ill a week ago, but now he looks healthy. We are ______ by his quick recovery.
詞彙題.stemZh: 湯姆一週前病得很重，但現在看起來很健康，我們都對他快速的復原感到驚訝。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 驚訝的, 驚奇的；v. 使驚訝（amaze 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：We are ___ by his quick recovery；be amazed by／at + N／be amazed to + V（對某事感到驚訝）

詞彙題.stem: The new stadium was built at a convenient ______, close to an MRT station and within walking distance to a popular shopping center.
詞彙題.stemZh: 新體育館建在一個方便的____，靠近捷運站，並且在步行可達一個受歡迎的購物中心的距離內。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 位置, 地點, 場所；搭配：was built at a convenient ___；at a convenient／central location（位於方便的、市中心的地點，介系詞用 at）／the location of + N（…的位置）

詞彙題.stem: The young Taiwanese pianist performed ______ well and won the first prize in the music contest.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位年輕的台灣鋼琴家表現____出色，並在音樂比賽中獲得一等獎。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 非常, 出奇地, 顯著地, 引人注目地

詞彙題.stem: As thousands of new ______ from Southeastern Asia have moved to Taiwan for work or marriage, we should try our best to help them adjust to our society.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著成千上萬來自東南亞的新____為了工作或婚姻移居台灣，我們應該盡力幫助他們適應我們的社會。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 移民（immigrant 的複數）；搭配：thousands of new ___ from Southeastern Asia；immigrants from + 地方（來自…的移民）／new／illegal immigrants（新移民、非法移民）

詞彙題.stem: Although the manager apologized many times for his poor decision, there was nothing he could do to ______ his mistake.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管經理多次為他的錯誤決定道歉，但他卻無法做任何事來____他的錯誤。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 補救, 糾正, 改善；n. 療法, 治療, 補救辦法；搭配：do to ___ his mistake；remedy a mistake／situation（彌補錯誤／補救情況）

詞彙題.stem: Last winter's snowstorms and freezing temperatures were quite ______ for this region where warm and short winters are typical.
詞彙題.stemZh: 去年冬天的暴風雪和冰凍溫度對於這個通常冬季溫暖而短暫的地區來說相當____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 非凡的, 異常的, 特別的, 令人驚奇的；搭配：were quite ___ for this region；extraordinary circumstances／weather conditions（異常的情況、異常的天候）／an extraordinary achievement／talent（非凡的成就、非凡的天分，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: To overcome budget shortages, some small schools in rural areas have set up ______ programs to share their teaching and library resources.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了克服預算短缺，一些農村地區的小學設立了____計畫來分享他們的教學和圖書館資源。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 合作的, 協作的, 樂於合作的；n. 合作社；搭配：have set up ___ programs to share their teaching and library resources；a cooperative program／effort（合作計畫、共同的努力）／be cooperative with sb（願意配合某人）

詞彙題.stem: After spending much time carefully studying the patient's ______, the doctor finally made his diagnosis.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在花了很多時間仔細研究病人的____後，醫生終於做出了診斷。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 症狀, 病徵, 徵兆（symptom 的複數）；搭配：carefully studying the patient's ___；symptoms of + 疾病（…的症狀）／show／develop symptoms（出現症狀）／relieve／treat symptoms（緩解、治療症狀）

詞彙題.stem: The universe is full of wonders. Throughout history, people have been ______ by the mystery of what lies beyond our planet.
詞彙題.stemZh: 宇宙充滿了奇蹟。縱觀歷史，人們一直被我們星球之外的神秘事物所____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 著迷的, 極感興趣的；v. 使著迷, 深深吸引（fascinate 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：people have been ___ by the mystery；be fascinated by／with + N（對…著迷，介系詞用 by 或 with）

詞彙題.stem: The president's speech will be broadcast on television and radio so that more people can listen to it ______ at the time when it is delivered.
詞彙題.stemZh: 總統的演講將在電視和廣播上____播出，以便更多人能在演講發表時聽到。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 同時, 同時地, 一齊；搭配：so that more people can listen to it ___；be broadcast／released simultaneously（同步播出、同步發行）／occur／happen simultaneously（同時發生）

詞彙題.stem: In order to expand its foreign market, the company decided to ______ its products and provide more varieties to the customer.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了擴大其國外市場，公司決定____其產品並為客戶提供更多種類。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 使多樣化, 使變化；搭配：decided to ___ its products；diversify its products／business（使產品、業務多樣化）／diversify into + 新領域（跨足…，介系詞用 into）

詞彙題.stem: Amy did not _____ changes in the course schedule and therefore missed the class.
詞彙題.stemZh: 艾咪沒注意到課表的變動，因此錯過了那堂課。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 注意到, 察覺

詞彙題.stem: It is not easy for old people to _____ their backs, so they need help when their backs itch.
詞彙題.stemZh: 老年人要抓自己的背並不容易，所以背癢時需要別人幫忙。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 抓, 搔, 擦, 劃, 刮；n. 抓痕, 刮痕；搭配：for old people to ___ their backs；scratch one's back／head／an itch（用指甲抓。另有 scratch the surface，指只碰到表面、沒真正深入）

詞彙題.stem: Mary is suffering from a stomachache and needs to eat food which is easy to _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 瑪麗胃痛，需要吃容易消化的食物。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 消化, 理解, 吸收；n. 文摘, 摘要；搭配：food which is easy to ___；digest food／a meal（把食物消化掉。也用在資訊上，digest information 指把大量資料看懂、吸收進去）

詞彙題.stem: Since our classroom is not air-conditioned, we have to _____ the heat during the hot summer days.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於教室沒有冷氣，炎熱的夏天我們只能忍受高溫。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 容忍, 忍受, 寬容, 容許；搭配：we have to ___ the heat；tolerate the heat／the noise／the pain／different opinions（撐得住撐不住的事用它，容忍不同意見也用它）

詞彙題.stem: Sue is so _____ that she always breaks something when she is shopping at a store.
詞彙題.stemZh: 蘇很笨拙，每次在店裡購物總會弄壞什麼東西。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 笨拙的, 笨手笨腳的, 不靈活的

詞彙題.stem: Ann enjoyed going to the flower market. She believed that the _____ of flowers refreshed her mind.
詞彙題.stemZh: 安很喜歡逛花市，她相信花朵的香氣能讓她神清氣爽。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 芬芳, 香味；搭配：the ___ of flowers refreshed her mind；the fragrance of flowers／a sweet fragrance（花香。芳香療法的英文是 aromatherapy，不是 fragrance therapy）

詞彙題.stem: The profits of Prince Charles’s organic farm go to _____ to help the poor and the sick.
詞彙題.stemZh: 查爾斯王子有機農場的利潤都捐給慈善機構，幫助貧困與病患。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 慈善機構, 慈善事業（charity 的複數）；搭配：organic farm go to ___；donate／give to charity（捐錢做善事時 charity 不加冠詞也不加 s。加了 s 的 charities 指的是一個個慈善團體）

詞彙題.stem: Jack was given the rare _____ of using the president’s office, which made others quite jealous.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克獲得使用總裁辦公室這項難得的特權，讓其他人相當眼紅。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 特權, 特別待遇, 榮幸；搭配：was given the rare ___ of using；be given／enjoy the privilege of + V-ing（後面接 of 加動名詞，不接不定詞）

詞彙題.stem: This new computer is obviously _____ to the old one because it has many new functions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這台新電腦明顯優於舊電腦，因為它有許多新功能。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 較好的, 優越的, 出眾的, 上級的, 高傲的；n. 上司, 上級；搭配：is obviously ___ to the old one；be superior／inferior／senior／junior／prior to（這一組從拉丁文來的比較詞後面一律接 to，不接 than）

詞彙題.stem: Simon loves his work. To him, work always comes first, and family and friends are _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 賽門熱愛他的工作。對他而言，工作永遠是第一位，家人與朋友都是其次。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 次要的, 從屬的, 中學的, 中等的, 輔助的；搭配：family and friends are ___；be secondary to + N／of secondary importance（次要於某件事。secondary school 那個 secondary 是中等的，跟本題的次要不是同一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Although your plans look good, you have to be _____ and consider what you can actually do.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然你的計畫看起來不錯，但你必須實際一點，考慮自己真正能做到的事。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 實際的, 務實的, 現實的, 逼真的；搭配：you have to be ___；be realistic about + N／a realistic goal／plan／expectation（對某件事實際一點，介系詞用 about）

詞彙題.stem: Built under the sea in 1994, the _____ between England and France connects the UK more closely with mainland Europe.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這條 1994 年建於海底的隧道，將英國與歐洲大陸連結得更緊密。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 隧道, 地下道

詞彙題.stem: This tour package is very appealing, and that one looks _____ attractive. I don’t know which one to choose.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個旅遊行程很吸引人，那個看起來也同樣誘人，我不知道該選哪一個。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 同樣地, 一樣地, 相等地, 平等地, 平均地

詞彙題.stem: Hseu Fang-yi, a young Taiwanese dancer, recently _____ at Lincoln Center in New York and won a great deal of praise.
詞彙題.stemZh: 台灣年輕舞者許芳宜最近在紐約林肯中心演出，贏得了廣大讚譽。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 表演, 演出, 執行, 進行（perform 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：recently ___ at Lincoln Center；perform a play／a concert／an operation／a task（表演之外，動手術與執行任務也用 perform）

詞彙題.stem: The police searched the house of the suspect _____. They almost turned the whole house upside down.
詞彙題.stemZh: 警方徹底搜查了嫌犯的住處，幾乎把整間屋子翻了個底朝天。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 徹底地, 仔細地, 完全地, 非常；搭配：searched the house of the suspect ___；thoroughly inspect／investigate／examine／clean（配的是要做到毫無遺漏的那一類動作。另有 thoroughly enjoy，那個 thoroughly 是非常的意思）

詞彙題.stem: You'll need the store ______ to show proof of purchase if you want to return any items you bought.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你想退回任何你買的商品，你需要商店的____來證明購買。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 收據, 收入, 收到；搭配：need the store ___ to show proof of purchase；a receipt for + N（…的收據）／keep／show the receipt（保留、出示收據）／issue a receipt（開立收據）

詞彙題.stem: Spending most of his childhood in Spain, John, a native speaker of English, is also ______ in Spanish.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰的童年大部分在西班牙度過，作為一個英語母語者，他的西班牙語也很____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 流利的, 流暢的；搭配：is also ___ in Spanish；be fluent in + 語言（…說得流利，介系詞用 in）／a fluent speaker of + 語言（說…很流利的人）

詞彙題.stem: The mirror slipped out of the little girl's hand, and the broken pieces ______ all over the floor.
詞彙題.stemZh: 鏡子從小女孩手中滑落，碎片____了滿地。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 散開, 分散, 撒, 撒播（scatter 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 分散的, 散布的, 稀疏的；搭配：the broken pieces ___ all over the floor；scatter all over／across + 地點（散落一地、散落各處）／be scattered around／throughout + 地點（散布在…各處）

詞彙題.stem: No one knows how the fire broke out. The police have started an ______ into the cause of it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 沒有人知道火災是如何發生的。警方已開始對其起因進行____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 調查, 審查；搭配：started an ___ into the cause；an investigation into + N（針對…的調查，介系詞用 into）／launch／conduct an investigation（展開、進行調查）

詞彙題.stem: When there is a heavy rain, you have to drive very ______ so as to avoid traffic accidents.
詞彙題.stemZh: 下大雨時，你必須非常____地開車以避免交通事故。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 小心地, 謹慎地, 慎重地；搭配：you have to drive very ___；drive cautiously（小心駕駛，與同題誘答 recklessly 魯莽駕駛正好相反，該組見 109 年指考補考第 9 題）／proceed／act cautiously（謹慎行事）

詞彙題.stem: We decided to buy some ______ for our new apartment, including a refrigerator, a vacuum cleaner, and a dishwasher.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們決定為我們的新公寓買一些____，包括冰箱、吸塵器和洗碗機。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 家電, 器具, 設備（appliance 的複數）；搭配：buy some ___ for our new apartment；home／kitchen appliances（家電／廚房家電）

詞彙題.stem: This math class is very ______; I have to spend at least two hours every day doing the assignments.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這堂數學課非常____；我每天至少要花兩個小時做作業。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 要求高的, 費力的；搭配：This math class is very ___；a demanding job／course／schedule（要求嚴苛的工作、課程、行程）／physically demanding（體力上很吃重的）

詞彙題.stem: One can generally judge the quality of eggs with the naked eye. ______, good eggs must be clean, free of cracks, and smooth-shelled.
詞彙題.stemZh: 人們通常可以用肉眼判斷雞蛋的品質。____，好的雞蛋必須乾淨、無裂痕且蛋殼光滑。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 在外部, 外表上, 從外面, 在外面, 從外部；搭配：___, good eggs must be clean；externally／internally（在外部／在內部）

詞彙題.stem: The scientist ______ his speech to make it easier for children to understand the threat of global warming.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位科學家____了他的演講，以便讓孩子們更容易理解全球暖化的威脅。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 修改, 更改, 改造（modify 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：___ his speech to make it easier；modify one's behavior／plan／design（修改行為、計畫、設計）／genetically modified（基因改造的）

詞彙題.stem: The Internet has ______ newspapers as a medium of mass communication. It has become the main source for national and international news for people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 網際網路已經____報紙成為大眾傳播的媒介。它已成為人們獲取國內外新聞的主要來源。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 超過, 優於, 勝過（surpass 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：has ___ newspapers as a medium；surpass A as B（作為 B 而超越 A）

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: The sales manager of this company believes that good products are important, but high-quality service is _______ important.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這家公司的業務經理認為，好產品固然重要，但高品質的服務也一樣重要。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 同樣地, 一樣地, 相等地, 平等地, 平均地

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: My older brother Jonathan had qualified as a doctor but later gave up his medical _______. He is now a well-known musician.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我哥哥強納森曾取得醫生資格，但後來放棄了行醫，如今是一位知名音樂家。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 執業, 業務, 實踐, 練習, 慣例, 習慣；v. 練習, 實踐, 執業；搭配：gave up his medical ___；medical practice（行醫、醫療業務）／set up a practice（開業）／put sth into practice（把…付諸實行，這是另一個意思）

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: The shift from profit to loss this year was _______ due to lower demands, not to any other factors.
詞彙題.stemZh: 今年由盈轉虧主要是因為需求下降，而非其他因素所致。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 主要地

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: Martha had long hoped to become a ballet dancer, but a serious car accident crippled her and _______ her dream.
詞彙題.stemZh: 瑪莎一直渴望成為芭蕾舞者，但一場嚴重車禍使她殘疾，也粉碎了她的夢想。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 粉碎, 打碎, 摧毀, 破壞（shatter 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 破碎的, 極難過的, 極度疲勞的；搭配：crippled her and ___ her dream；shatter sb's dream／hope／confidence（粉碎夢想、希望、信心）／be shattered by + N（因…而崩潰）

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: The city government has been _______ to providing better housing after many citizens raised concerns about the housing shortage.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在許多市民對住房短缺表達關切後，市政府已致力於提供更好的住房。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 犯（罪、錯）, 承諾, 投入（時間或金錢）, 將…送進（監獄或醫院）（commit 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 致力於…的, 忠誠的；搭配：has been ___ to providing better housing；be committed to + 名詞或動名詞（致力於，to 是介系詞不是不定詞）／commit oneself to + N（許下承諾投入）

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: Many recent events have been surprises for all of us—how things will turn out is often not _______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 最近許多事都出乎我們所有人的意料——事情最後會如何發展，往往是無法預測的。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 可預測的, 可預料的, 意料之中的, 老套的；搭配：how things will turn out is often not ___；highly／entirely predictable（完全可以預料的）／a predictable outcome／result（可預期的結果）

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: Accused of taking bribes from a construction company, five officers were _______ from all their duties.
詞彙題.stemZh: 五名官員因被控收受一家建設公司的賄賂，而被停止一切職務。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 使停職, 暫停, 中止, 懸掛, 懸浮（suspend 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：five officers were ___ from all their duties；be suspended from + N（被停止…職務、被勒令停學，介系詞用 from）／suspend operations（暫停營運）

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: Jack used to be stingy, but now he is unusually generous. There has been a(n) _______ change in his attitude.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克以前很小氣，但現在卻異常大方，他的態度出現了劇烈的轉變。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 劇烈的, 激烈的, 嚴厲的；搭配：a(n) ___ change in his attitude；a drastic change／measure（劇烈的改變／激烈的措施）

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: Manufacturers in developed countries have a competitive _______ in the global market. They are more technologically advanced.
詞彙題.stemZh: 已開發國家的製造商在全球市場上擁有競爭優勢，因為他們的技術較為先進。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 優勢, 邊緣, 刀刃；v. 徐徐移動；搭配：have a competitive ___ in the global market；a competitive edge（競爭優勢）／have an edge over + 人或公司（勝過…一籌）／on the edge of + N（在…的邊緣，另一個意思）

詞彙題.exam: 指考參考試卷（99 課綱適用）
詞彙題.stem: Dancing is basically the repetition of a _______ of steps over and over again. It is not so difficult to learn.
詞彙題.stemZh: 跳舞基本上就是不斷重複一連串的步伐，並不難學。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 一連串, 一系列, 順序, 次序；搭配：the repetition of a ___ of steps；a sequence of steps／events（一連串步伐／事件）

詞彙題.stem: Steve’s description of the place was so _____ that I could almost picture it in my mind.
詞彙題.stemZh: 史提夫對那個地方的描述非常生動，讓我幾乎能在腦海中想像出畫面。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 生動的, 鮮明的, 鮮豔的, 活潑的, 逼真的, 清晰的；搭配：description of the place was so ___；a vivid description／imagination／memory／dream（想像力豐富是 vivid，不是 rich）

詞彙題.stem: When people feel uncomfortable or nervous, they may _____ their arms across their chests as if to protect themselves.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當人們感到不自在或緊張時，可能會把雙臂交叉抱在胸前，彷彿在保護自己。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 摺疊, 交叉（雙臂）, 合起；n. 摺痕；搭配：they may ___ their arms across their chests；fold one's arms／with one's arms folded（抱胸。後者是 with + 受詞 + 受詞補語）

詞彙題.stem: The doors of these department stores slide open _____ when you approach them. You don’t have to open them yourself.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些百貨公司的門在你靠近時會自動滑開，不需要自己動手開門。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 自動地, 不自覺地

詞彙題.stem: Nicole is a _____ language learner. Within a short period of time, she has developed a good command of Chinese and Japanese.
詞彙題.stemZh: 妮可是個出色的語言學習者，在短時間內就精通了中文與日文。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 聰穎的, 出色的, 有才氣的, 燦爛的, 明亮的；搭配：Nicole is a ___ language learner；a brilliant student／idea／performance（才華洋溢，不是明亮的那個意思）

詞彙題.stem: With rising oil prices, there is an increasing _____ for people to ride bicycles to work.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著油價上漲，越來越多人傾向騎腳踏車上班。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 傾向, 趨勢, 趨向；搭配：there is an increasing ___ for people to ride bicycles；a tendency to + V／a tendency for sb to V（接不定詞，不接 of + V-ing）

詞彙題.stem: This information came from a very _____ source, so you don’t have to worry about being cheated.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這項資訊來自非常可靠的來源，所以你不必擔心被騙。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 可靠的, 可信賴的；搭配：came from a very ___ source；a reliable source／partner／supplier（另有 according to reliable sources，用複數、不加冠詞）

詞彙題.stem: We hope that there will be no war in the world and that all people live in peace and _____ with each other.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們希望世界上不再有戰爭，所有人都能和平和諧地相處。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 和諧, 協調, 和睦, 和聲；搭配：all people live in peace and ___ with each other；live／be in harmony with sb（和睦相處。介系詞固定用 with）

詞彙題.stem: To have a full discussion of the issue, the committee spent a whole hour _____ their ideas at the meeting.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了充分討論這個議題，委員會在會議上花了整整一個小時交換意見。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 交換, 交流, 兌換（exchange 的現在分詞）；搭配：spent a whole hour ___ their ideas at the meeting；exchange ideas／information／gifts／greetings（交換意見用 exchange，不用 change）

詞彙題.stem: While adapting to western ways of living, many Asian immigrants in the US still try hard to _____ their own cultures and traditions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多在美國的亞裔移民，在適應西方生活方式的同時，仍努力保存自己的文化與傳統。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 保存, 保護, 維護, 保養, 醃製；n. 保護區, 蜜餞, 果醬；搭配：try hard to ___ their own cultures and traditions；preserve culture／tradition／wildlife／food（保存原樣。preserved fruit 是蜜餞，protect 是防止傷害）

詞彙題.stem: With the worsening of global economic conditions, it seems wiser and more _____ to keep cash in the bank rather than to invest in the stock market.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著全球經濟狀況惡化，把現金存在銀行似乎比投資股市更明智、更理智。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 明智的, 理智的, 合理的, 實用的；搭配：seems wiser and more ___ to keep cash；a sensible decision／choice（明智的決定／選擇）

詞彙題.stem: Under the _____ of newly elected president Barack Obama, the US is expected to turn a new page in politics and economy.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在新當選總統歐巴馬的領導下，美國預期將在政治與經濟上翻開新的一頁。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 領導, 領導能力, 領導地位, 領導階層；搭配：Under the ___ of newly elected president；under the leadership of sb（在某人的領導下。介系詞是 under，不是 in）

詞彙題.stem: Rapid advancement in motor engineering makes it _____ possible to build a flying car in the near future.
詞彙題.stemZh: 汽車工程的快速進步，使得在不久的將來打造飛天車在技術上成為可能。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 技術上, 嚴格說來, 事實上, 在專業上；搭配：makes it ___ possible to build a flying car；technically possible／feasible／illegal（另有 technically speaking，那個是嚴格說來）

詞彙題.stem: When you take photos, you can move around to shoot the target object from different _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 拍照時，你可以移動位置，從不同角度拍攝目標物。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 角度, 觀點（angle 的複數）；搭配：shoot the target object from different ___；from a different angle／from different angles（介系詞是 from，不是 in）

詞彙題.stem: Students were asked to _____ or rewrite their compositions based on the teacher’s comments.
詞彙題.stemZh: 學生被要求根據老師的評語修改或重寫作文。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 修改, 修訂, 修正, 複習；搭配：asked to ___ or rewrite their compositions；revise an essay（修改文章）

詞彙題.stem: Besides lung cancer, another _____ of smoking is wrinkles, a premature sign of aging.
詞彙題.stemZh: 除了肺癌之外，吸菸的另一個後果是皺紋，這是提早老化的徵兆。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 後果, 結果, 重要性；搭配：another ___ of smoking is wrinkles；a consequence of + N／suffer／face the consequences（承擔後果那一組固定用複數）

詞彙題.stem: Chinese is a language with many _______ differences. People living in different areas often speak different dialects.
詞彙題.stemZh: 中文是一種有許多____差異的語言。生活在不同地區的人們常說不同的方言。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 地方的, 地域性的；搭配：a language with many ___ differences；regional differences／variations（地區差異）／regional dialect／accent（地方方言、地方口音）

詞彙題.stem: A menu serves to _____ customers about the varieties and prices of the dishes offered by the restaurant.
詞彙題.stemZh: 菜單的作用是____顧客餐廳提供的菜餚種類和價格。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 通知, 告知, 使了解；搭配：serves to ___ customers about the varieties and prices；inform sb about／of + N（告知某人某事，介系詞用 about 或 of）／keep sb informed（隨時告知某人最新狀況）

詞彙題.stem: Mary and Jane often fight over which radio station to listen to. Their _______ arises mainly from their different tastes in music.
詞彙題.stemZh: 瑪麗和珍經常為聽哪個廣播電台而爭吵。她們的____主要源於她們對音樂的不同品味。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 爭論, 爭執, 糾紛；v. 爭論, 對…有異議；搭配：Their ___ arises mainly from their different tastes in music；a dispute arises from／over + N（爭執起於…、為…起爭執）／settle／resolve a dispute（解決爭端）

詞彙題.stem: The baby polar bear is being _____ studied by the scientists. Every move he makes is carefully observed and documented.
詞彙題.stemZh: 科學家們正在____地研究這隻小北極熊。它的一舉一動都被仔細觀察和記錄下來。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 密集地, 深入地, 集中地, 加強地；搭配：is being ___ studied by the scientists；be intensively studied／monitored（受到密集研究、密集監測）／study／train intensively（密集地研讀、密集訓練）

詞彙題.stem: At twelve, Catherine has won several first prizes in international art competitions. Her talent and skills are _____ for her age.
詞彙題.stemZh: 十二歲時，凱瑟琳已在國際藝術比賽中獲得了幾個一等獎。她的才華和技能對她的年齡來說是____的。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 卓越的, 傑出的, 特別的, 例外的；搭配：Her talent and skills are ___ for her age；exceptional talent／ability／skills（非凡的天分、能力、技術）／exceptional quality／value（極佳的品質、超值）／in exceptional circumstances（在特殊情況下，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: After his superb performance, the musician received a big round of _____ from the appreciative audience.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在他精湛的表演之後，這位音樂家得到了欣賞的觀眾的一陣熱烈____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 鼓掌, 喝彩, 讚許；搭配：received a big round of ___；a round of applause（一陣掌聲）／burst into applause（爆出掌聲）／thunderous applause（如雷的掌聲）

詞彙題.stem: The water company inspects the pipelines and _____ the water supply regularly to ensure the safety of our drinking water.
詞彙題.stemZh: 自來水公司定期檢查管線並____供水，以確保我們飲用水的安全。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 監測, 監控, 監視, 監督（monitor 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：inspects the pipelines and ___ the water supply regularly；monitor the water supply／situation／progress（監控供水、情況、進度）／closely monitor（密切監控）

詞彙題.stem: This year's East Asia Summit meetings will focus on critical _____ such as energy conservation, food shortages, and global warming.
詞彙題.stemZh: 今年的東亞高峰會將聚焦於能源節約、糧食短缺和全球暖化等關鍵____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 議題, 問題（issue 的複數）；搭配：will focus on critical ___ such as energy conservation；focus on／address + issues（聚焦於議題、處理議題）／critical／controversial issues（重大議題、有爭議的議題）／raise an issue（提出議題）

詞彙題.stem: Having fully recognized Mei-ling's academic ability, Mr. Lin strongly _____ her for admission to the university.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在充分認識到美玲的學術能力後，林先生強力____她入學大學。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 推薦, 建議, 勸告（recommend 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 推薦的, 建議的；搭配：Mr. Lin strongly ___ her for admission to the university；strongly recommend（強力推薦）／recommend sb for + N（推薦某人擔任或申請…，介系詞用 for）／recommend that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（建議…，另一個用法）

詞彙題.stem: The weatherman has warned about drastic temperature change in the next few days, and suggested that we check the weather on a daily basis and dress _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 氣象員警告說未來幾天將有劇烈的溫度變化，並建議我們每天查看天氣並____穿衣。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 相應地, 因此, 於是；搭配：and dress ___；act／dress accordingly（依情況行動／穿衣）

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Lin is a very ________ writer; he publishes at least five novels every year.
詞彙題.stemZh: 林先生是位非常多產的作家，他每年至少出版五本小說。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 多產的, 富有成效的, 有生產力的；搭配：Mr. Lin is a very ___ writer；a productive writer／meeting／discussion（多產的。用在會議討論是有成效的）

詞彙題.stem: Using a heating pad or taking warm baths can sometimes help to _____ pain in the lower back.
詞彙題.stemZh: 使用電熱墊或泡溫水澡有時能幫助緩解下背痛。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 減輕, 解除, 紓解；搭配：help to ___ pain in the lower back；relieve pain／stress／pressure／symptoms（減輕不適的那一類）

詞彙題.stem: Peter stayed up late last night, so he drank a lot of coffee this morning to keep himself _____ in class.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彼得昨晚熬夜了，所以今天早上喝了很多咖啡，好讓自己上課時保持清醒。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 醒著的；v. 醒來, 喚醒；搭配：to keep himself ___ in class；keep sb awake／stay awake／lie awake（awake 只放動詞後，不放名詞前）

詞彙題.stem: Due to _______, prices for daily necessities have gone up and we have to pay more for the same items now.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於通貨膨脹，民生必需品的價格上漲了，我們現在買同樣的東西得花更多錢。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 通貨膨脹, 膨脹, 充氣

詞彙題.stem: The government is doing its best to ____ the cultures of the tribal people for fear that they may soon die out.
詞彙題.stemZh: 政府正竭盡全力保存原住民部落的文化，深怕這些文化很快就會消失。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 保存, 保護, 維護, 保養, 醃製；n. 保護區, 蜜餞, 果醬；搭配：doing its best to ___ the cultures of the tribal people；preserve culture／tradition／wildlife／food（保存原樣。preserved fruit 是蜜餞，protect 是防止傷害）

詞彙題.stem: I could not ______ the sweet smell from the bakery, so I walked in and bought a fresh loaf of bread.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我抵擋不住麵包店飄出的香甜氣味，於是走進去買了一條新鮮麵包。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 抵抗, 抗拒, 忍住, 抵制, 反抗；搭配：I could not ___ the sweet smell；can't resist + N／V-ing／resist temptation（接動名詞，不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: Steve has several meetings to attend every day; therefore, he has to work on a very _____ schedule.
詞彙題.stemZh: 史提夫每天都有好幾場會議要開，因此他的工作行程排得非常緊湊。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 緊的, 緊湊的, 拮據的, 牢固的, 嚴格的, 吝嗇的；搭配：he has to work on a very ___ schedule；a tight schedule／budget／deadline（行程很滿用 tight，不用 full）

詞彙題.stem: Michael Phelps, an American swimmer, broke seven world records and won eight gold medals in men’s swimming _____ in the 2008 Olympics.
詞彙題.stemZh: 美國泳將麥可．菲爾普斯在 2008 年奧運男子游泳項目中打破七項世界紀錄，奪得八面金牌。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 比賽, 競賽, 爭奪（contest 的複數）；搭配：won eight gold medals in men’s swimming ___；enter／win a contest／a beauty contest（參賽用 enter，不用 join）

詞彙題.stem: Those college students work at the orphanage on a _____ basis, helping the children with their studies without receiving any pay.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些大學生在孤兒院擔任志工，無償協助孩子們的課業。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 自願的, 志願的, 自發的, 公益性的；搭配：work at the orphanage on a ___ basis；on a voluntary／regular／daily／part-time basis（介系詞是 on，名詞用單數）

詞彙題.stem: Studies show that asking children to do house _____, such as taking out the trash or doing the dishes, helps them grow into responsible adults.
詞彙題.stemZh: 研究顯示，讓孩子做家事，例如倒垃圾或洗碗，有助於他們成長為負責任的成年人。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 雜務, 家事, 日常瑣事（chore 的複數）；搭配：asking children to do house ___；do the chores／household chores（用複數，動詞是 do 不是 make）

詞彙題.stem: John has been scolded by his boss for over ten minutes now. _____, she is not happy about his being late again.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰已經被老闆罵了超過十分鐘，顯然她對他又遲到感到很不高興。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 顯然, 看來, 似乎

詞彙題.stem: Since the orange trees suffered _____ damage from a storm in the summer, the farmers are expecting a sharp decline in harvests this winter.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於柳橙樹在夏季的暴風中受到嚴重損害，農民預期今年冬天的收成將大幅減少。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 嚴重的, 劇烈的, 嚴厲的, 苛刻的, 樸素的；搭配：suffered ___ damage from a storm；severe damage／weather／shortage／pain（程度嚴重的那一類）

詞彙題.stem: Typhoon Morakot claimed more than six hundred lives in early August of 2009, making it the most serious natural _____ in Taiwan in recent decades.
詞彙題.stemZh: 莫拉克颱風在 2009 年 8 月初奪走超過六百條人命，成為台灣近幾十年來最嚴重的天然災害。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 災難, 災禍, 徹底失敗；搭配：making it the most serious natural ___ in Taiwan；a natural disaster／disaster relief／a disaster area（賑災是 disaster relief，不是 rescue）

詞彙題.stem: Robert was the only _____ to the car accident. The police had to count on him to find out exactly how the accident happened.
詞彙題.stemZh: 羅伯特是這場車禍唯一的目擊者，警方必須靠他才能查明事故確切的經過。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 目擊者, 證人, 見證人；v. 目擊, 見證, 證明；搭配：Robert was the only ___ to the car accident；a witness to sth（介系詞是 to，不是 of）

詞彙題.stem: Badly injured in the car accident, Jason could _____ move his legs and was sent to the hospital right away.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑森在車禍中受了重傷，雙腿幾乎無法動彈，立刻被送往醫院。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 幾乎不, 勉強, 剛…就, 絕不；搭配：Jason could ___ move his legs；can／could scarcely + V（本身就是否定，不再加 not）

詞彙題.stem: Many people think cotton is the most comfortable _____ to wear in hot weather.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多人認為棉是熱天穿起來最舒服的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 布料, 織物, 結構；搭配：the most comfortable ___ to wear in hot weather；cotton／silk／synthetic fabric（棉質、絲質、合成布料）／a soft／lightweight fabric（柔軟、輕薄的布料）／the fabric of society（社會的結構，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Because of the engine problem in the new vans, the auto company decided to _____ them from the market.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於新款廂型車的引擎問題，汽車公司決定將它們從市場上____。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 回想起, 記得, 召回, 收回；n. 記憶力, 召回；搭配：the auto company decided to ___ them from the market；recall a product／a car model（召回產品、召回某款車）／recall sth from the market（把…自市場召回，介系詞用 from）／vividly／vaguely recall（清楚地想起、隱約想起，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: After a day's tiring work, Peter walked _____ back to his house, hungry and sleepy.
詞彙題.stemZh: 經過一天疲憊的工作，彼得____地走回家，又餓又睏。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 疲倦地, 厭倦地, 無聊地；搭配：Peter walked ___ back to his house；walk／trudge wearily（拖著步子疲憊地走）／sigh／nod／smile wearily（疲倦地嘆氣、點頭、微笑）／rub one's eyes wearily（疲倦地揉眼睛）

詞彙題.stem: In team sports, how all members work as a group is more important than how they perform _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在團隊運動中，所有成員如何作為一個團隊工作比他們如何____表現更重要。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 個別地, 分別地, 以個人身分, 獨特地

詞彙題.stem: Despite her physical disability, the young blind pianist managed to overcome all _____ to win the first prize in the international contest.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管身有殘疾，這位年輕的盲人鋼琴家還是設法克服了所有____，在國際比賽中贏得了一等獎。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 障礙, 阻礙, 絆腳石（obstacle 的複數）；搭配：managed to overcome all ___；overcome／face／encounter obstacles（克服、面對、遭遇障礙）／an obstacle to + N／V-ing（…的阻礙，介系詞用 to）／remove／clear obstacles（排除障礙）

詞彙題.stem: Each of the planets in the solar system circles around the sun in its own _____, and this prevents them from colliding with each other.
詞彙題.stemZh: 太陽系中的每顆行星都在自己的____中圍繞太陽旋轉，這防止了它們相互碰撞。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 軌道, 常軌, 眼眶；搭配：circles around the sun in its own ___；in orbit around + N（在環繞…的軌道上，介系詞用 around）／put／send a satellite into orbit（把衛星送上軌道）／enter／leave orbit（進入、脫離軌道）

詞彙題.stem: Professor Wang is well known for his contributions to the field of economics. He has been _____ to help the government with its financial reform programs.
詞彙題.stemZh: 王教授以其在經濟學領域的貢獻而聞名。他已被____來幫助政府進行金融改革計劃。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 招募, 招聘, 吸收（recruit 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：___ to help the government；be recruited to + V（被延攬來做…）

詞彙題.stem: Most earthquakes are too small to be noticed; they can only be detected by _____ instruments.
詞彙題.stemZh: 大多數地震都太小而不會被注意到；它們只能用____的儀器來檢測。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 敏感的, 靈敏的, 體貼的, 善解人意的, 脆弱的；搭配：they can only be detected by ___ instruments；a sensitive instrument／device／detector（靈敏的儀器、裝置、偵測器）／highly sensitive（高度靈敏的）／be sensitive to + N（對…敏感、對…體貼，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: With Wikileaks releasing secrets about governments around the world, many countries are worried that their national security information might be _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著維基解密發布世界各國政府的秘密，許多國家擔心他們的國家安全資訊可能會被____。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 揭露, 洩露, 公開, 透露（disclose 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：their national security information might be ___；disclose information／details（揭露資訊、細節）／disclose sth to sb（向某人透露…，介系詞用 to）／refuse／decline to disclose（拒絕透露）

詞彙題.stem: I'm afraid we can't take your word, for the evidence we've collected so far is not ____ with what you said.
詞彙題.stemZh: 恐怕我們不能相信你的話，因為到目前為止我們收集的證據與你說的並不____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 一致的, 吻合的, 一貫的, 始終如一的；搭配：is not ___ with what you said；be consistent with + N（與…相符）

詞彙題.stem: All the new students were given one minute to _____ introduce themselves to the whole class.
詞彙題.stemZh: 所有新生都被給予一分鐘時間，向全班簡短地自我介紹。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 簡短地, 短暫地, 簡言之；搭配：one minute to ___ introduce themselves；briefly explain／describe／mention／summarize（用少少的話講完的動作。另有短暫地的意思，配 pause／appear）

詞彙題.stem: His dark brown jacket had holes in the elbows and had _____ to light brown, but he continued to wear it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 他那件深棕色的外套手肘處有破洞，顏色也褪成了淺棕色，但他仍然繼續穿著。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 褪色, 逐漸消失, 變暗（fade 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 褪色的；搭配：had ___ to light brown；fade to + 顏色／faded jeans（褪成什麼顏色用 to。顏色退掉用 fade，不用 lose color）

詞彙題.stem: Everyone in our company enjoys working with Jason. He’s got all the qualities that make a _____ partner.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們公司每個人都喜歡跟傑森共事，他具備了成為理想夥伴的所有特質。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 理想的, 令人嚮往的, 值得擁有的, 可取的；搭配：qualities that make a ___ partner；a desirable partner（理想的合作對象）

詞彙題.stem: Eyes are sensitive to light. Looking at the sun _____ could damage our eyes.
詞彙題.stemZh: 眼睛對光線很敏感，直視太陽可能會傷害我們的眼睛。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 直接地, 直率地, 立即

詞彙題.stem: We were forced to _____ our plan for the weekend picnic because of the bad weather.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於天氣惡劣，我們被迫取消了週末野餐的計畫。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 取消, 終止, 撤銷

詞彙題.stem: Three people are running for mayor. All three _____ seem confident that they will be elected, but we won’t know until the outcome of the election is announced.
詞彙題.stemZh: 有三個人在競選市長，三位候選人似乎都對自己當選很有信心，但結果要等選舉揭曉才會知道。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 候選人, 應試者, 申請人（candidate 的複數）；搭配：All three ___ seem confident；a candidate for + 職位／a strong candidate（市長候選人是 a candidate for mayor，不用 of）

詞彙題.stem: If you _____ a traffic law, such as drinking and driving, you may not drive for some time.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你違反交通法規，例如酒後駕車，你可能有一段時間不能開車。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 違反, 違背, 違犯, 侵犯；搭配：If you ___ a traffic law；violate a law／human rights／sb's privacy（正式規章與權利用 violate，日常說 break the law）

詞彙題.stem: Applying to college means sending in applications, writing study plans, and so on. It’s a long _____, and it makes students nervous.
詞彙題.stemZh: 申請大學意味著要遞交申請表、撰寫讀書計畫等等，這是一個漫長的過程，讓學生感到緊張。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 過程, 程序, 步驟, 製作方法；v. 處理, 加工；搭配：It’s a long ___；process data／information／applications（動詞的處理不是 deal。名詞另有 in the process of + V-ing）

詞彙題.stem: Dr. Chu’s speech on the new energy source attracted great _____ from the audience at the conference.
詞彙題.stemZh: 朱博士關於新能源的演講，在會議上吸引了聽眾極大的關注。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 注意, 注意力；搭配：attracted great ___ from the audience；attract／draw sb's attention 與 pay attention to（引起注意不用 cause，to 不能省）

詞彙題.stem: Everyone in the office must attend the meeting tomorrow. There are no _____ allowed.
詞彙題.stemZh: 辦公室裡的每個人明天都必須出席會議，不允許有任何例外。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 例外, 除外（exception 的複數）；搭配：There are no ___ allowed；make an exception／an exception to the rule（破例用 make，介系詞是 to 不是 of）

詞彙題.stem: To make fresh lemonade, cut the lemon in half, _____ the juice into a bowl, and then add as much water and sugar as you like.
詞彙題.stemZh: 要做新鮮檸檬水，把檸檬切半，把汁擠進碗裡，再依喜好加入適量的水和糖。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 擠, 擠壓, 榨, 捏, 擠進；n. 擠壓, 捏, 緊縮；搭配：___ the juice into a bowl；squeeze a lemon／squeeze the juice out of（用力擠出汁。另有 the squeezed middle class，指被財務壓縮的一群）

詞彙題.stem: Buddhism is the _____ religion in Thailand, with 90% of the total population identified as Buddhists.
詞彙題.stemZh: 佛教是泰國的主要宗教，全國人口中有 90%信奉佛教。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 主要的, 佔優勢的, 主導的, 支配的, 顯性的；搭配：Buddhism is the ___ religion；the dominant religion／language／culture（在競爭中占上風而成為主流，單純的主要用 main）

詞彙題.stem: When I open a book, I look first at the table of _____ to get a general idea of the book and to see which chapters I might be interested in reading.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我打開一本書時，會先看目錄，藉此大致了解書的內容，並看看自己對哪些章節感興趣。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 目錄, 內容, 容納的東西（content 的複數）；搭配：at the table of ___；the table of contents／the contents of a book（目錄一定用複數，單數 content 是滿足或含量）

詞彙題.stem: The children were so _____ to see the clown appear on stage that they laughed, screamed, and clapped their hands happily.
詞彙題.stemZh: 孩子們看到小丑登台時非常高興，又笑又叫，還開心地拍手。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 高興的, 欣喜的；v. 使高興, 使愉快（delight 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：were so ___ to see the clown appear on stage；be delighted to V／be delighted with sth（很高興…。名詞 delight 另有 take delight in V-ing）

詞彙題.stem: Typhoon Maggie brought to I-lan County a huge amount of rainfall, much greater than the _____ rainfall of the season in the area.
詞彙題.stemZh: 瑪姬颱風為宜蘭縣帶來大量降雨，遠超過當地這個季節的平均雨量。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 平均的, 一般的, 普通的；n. 平均數, 平均, 一般水準；搭配：than the ___ rainfall；an average student／city／above average／on average（中等程度不用 normal 或 ordinary，平均而言是 on average）

詞彙題.stem: Since it hasn't rained for months, there is a water _____ in many parts of the country.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於好幾個月沒下雨，全國許多地區都出現了水____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 不足, 缺乏；搭配：there is a water ___ in many parts of the country；a shortage of + N（…的短缺，介系詞用 of）／a water／food／labor shortage（缺水、糧食短缺、缺工，名詞直接放在前面）

詞彙題.stem: The problem with Larry is that he doesn't know his limitations; he just _____ he can do everything.
詞彙題.stemZh: 賴瑞的問題在於他不知道自己的極限；他只是____他什麼都能做。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 假定, 假設, 承擔, 取得（權力）（assume 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：he just ___ he can do everything；assume (that) + 子句（假定…，that 可省略）／assume responsibility／power／control（承擔責任、掌權、接掌，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Agnes seems to have a _____ personality. Almost everyone is immediately attracted to her when they first see her.
詞彙題.stemZh: 艾格妮絲似乎有一種____的個性。幾乎每個人第一次見到她時都會立刻被她吸引。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有吸引力的, 有魅力的, 有磁性的, 磁的；搭配：Agnes seems to have a ___ personality；a magnetic personality／charm（有吸引力的個性、迷人的魅力）／a magnetic field／card（磁場、磁卡，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Jason always _____ in finishing a task no matter how difficult it may be. He hates to quit halfway in anything he does.
詞彙題.stemZh: 無論任務多麼困難，傑森總是____完成。他討厭做任何事半途而廢。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 堅持, 堅持不懈, 持續（persist 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：Jason always ___ in finishing a task；persist in + N／V-ing（堅持做…，介系詞用 in）／persist with + N（繼續進行…不放棄）／the problem／symptom persists（問題、症狀持續存在，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Poor _____ has caused millions of deaths in developing countries where there is only a limited amount of food.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在食物有限的發展中國家，不良的____已造成數百萬人死亡。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 營養, 營養學；搭配：Poor ___ has caused millions of deaths；poor／good nutrition（營養不良、營養良好）／nutrition facts／label（營養標示）

詞彙題.stem: The helicopters _____ over the sea, looking for the divers who had been missing for more than 30 hours.
詞彙題.stemZh: 直升機在海上____，尋找失蹤超過 30 小時的潛水員。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 盤旋, 徘徊, 猶豫（hover 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：The helicopters ___ over the sea；hover over／above + N（盤旋在…上方，介系詞用 over 或 above）／hover around + 數字（在某個數字上下徘徊，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: One of the tourist attractions in Japan is its hot spring _____, where guests can enjoy relaxing baths and beautiful views.
詞彙題.stemZh: 日本的旅遊景點之一是它的溫泉____，客人可以在那裡享受放鬆的沐浴和美麗的景色。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 度假村, 度假勝地（resort 的複數）；搭配：its hot spring ___；a hot spring／ski／beach resort（溫泉、滑雪、海濱度假勝地）／resort to + N（訴諸…手段，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: When a young child goes out and commits a crime, it is usually the parents who should be held _____ for the child's conduct.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當一個年幼的孩子外出犯罪時，通常應該為孩子的行為____的是父母。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 應負責任的, 有義務說明的；搭配：held ___ for the child's conduct；be held accountable for + N（為…負責）

詞彙題.stem: Since you have not decided on the topic of your composition, it's still ______ to talk about how to write your conclusion.
詞彙題.stemZh: 既然你還沒有決定作文的主題，現在談論如何寫結論還____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 過早的, 不成熟的, 倉促的, 早產的；搭配：it's still ___ to talk about how to write your conclusion；It is premature to V（現在做…還太早）／a premature baby／birth（早產兒、早產，另一個意思）／premature death（早逝）

詞彙題.stem: Human rights are fundamental rights to which a person is ________ entitled, that is, rights that she or he is born with.
詞彙題.stemZh: 人權是一個人____享有的基本權利，也就是說，是他或她與生俱來的權利。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 內在地, 生來地, 固有地；搭配：a person is ___ entitled；be inherently + 形容詞（本質上就…）／inherently dangerous／unstable／flawed（本質上危險、本質上不穩定、本身就有缺陷）

詞彙題.stem: The ending of the movie did not come as a _____ to John because he had already read the novel that the movie was based on.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這部電影的結局對約翰來說並不意外，因為他早已讀過電影改編的原著小說。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 意外, 驚訝, 驚喜, 意想不到的事；v. 使驚訝, 使感到意外；搭配：did not come as a ___ to John；come as a surprise to sb／come as no surprise（讓某人感到意外／一點也不意外，後者常見於評論與新聞）

詞彙題.stem: In order to stay healthy and fit, John exercises _____. He works out twice a week in a gym.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了保持健康與體態，約翰定期運動，每週去健身房兩次。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 定期地, 經常地, 有規律地；搭配：John exercises ___；exercise／sleep／update／meet regularly（規律地。配的是會反覆發生的作息或例行公事）

詞彙題.stem: Traveling is a good way for us to _____ different cultures and broaden our horizons.
詞彙題.stemZh: 旅行是讓我們探索不同文化、開闊視野的好方法。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 探索, 探險, 探測, 探究；搭配：a good way for us to ___ different cultures；explore a culture／possibilities／options（深入接觸還不熟的事物。另有探勘義 explore for oil）

詞彙題.stem: The story about Hou-I shooting down nine suns is a well-known Chinese _____, but it may not be a true historical event.
詞彙題.stemZh: 后羿射下九個太陽的故事是中國著名的傳說，但這未必是真實的歷史事件。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 傳說, 傳奇故事, 傳奇人物, 圖例；搭配：a well-known Chinese ___；according to legend／an urban legend／a living legend（傳說。a living legend 指還在世的傳奇人物）

詞彙題.stem: According to recent research, children under the age of 12 are generally not _____ enough to recognize risk and deal with dangerous situations.
詞彙題.stemZh: 根據最近的研究，12 歲以下的兒童通常還不夠成熟，無法辨識風險並應付危險狀況。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 成熟的, 到期的, 充分考慮的

詞彙題.stem: Helen let out a sigh of ______ after hearing that her brother was not injured in the accident.
詞彙題.stemZh: 海倫聽說哥哥在意外中沒有受傷後，鬆了一口氣。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 寬慰, 鬆一口氣, 減輕, 解除, 救濟, 浮雕；搭配：let out a sigh of ___；a sigh of relief／to one's relief（鬆一口氣。另有救災義 disaster relief）

詞彙題.stem: Research suggests that people with outgoing personalities tend to be more _____, often expecting that good things will happen.
詞彙題.stemZh: 研究顯示，性格外向的人往往較為樂觀，常常期待好事會發生。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 樂觀的, 樂觀主義的, 樂天的；搭配：tend to be more ___；be optimistic about the future／one's chances（對…感到樂觀，介系詞固定用 about）

詞彙題.stem: No one could beat Paul at running. He has won the running championship _____ for three years.
詞彙題.stemZh: 沒有人能在賽跑中打敗保羅，他已經連續三年蟬聯賽跑冠軍。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 不斷地, 連續地

詞彙題.stem: If you fly from Taipei to Tokyo, you’ll be taking an international, rather than a _____ flight.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你從台北飛往東京，搭的會是國際航班，而不是國內航班。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 家庭的, 國內的, 馴養的；搭配：an international, rather than a ___ flight；a domestic flight／market（國內的，與 international 相對。另有家庭的用法 domestic violence／domestic affairs）

詞彙題.stem: Jack is very proud of his fancy new motorcycle. He has been _____ to all his friends about how cool it looks and how fast it runs.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克對他那台炫麗的新機車感到十分自豪，一直向所有朋友吹噓它有多酷、跑多快。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 吹噓, 誇耀, 自吹自擂（boast 的現在分詞）；搭配：has been ___ to all his friends about；boast about／of sth（誇耀。另有及物用法 boast a huge campus「擁有值得誇耀的…」，學生多半只寫得出 have a huge campus）

詞彙題.stem: The ideas about family have changed _____ in the past twenty years. For example, my grandfather was one of ten children in his family, but I am the only child.
詞彙題.stemZh: 過去二十年來，家庭觀念已經有了相當大的改變。舉例來說，我祖父家中有十個兄弟姊妹，但我卻是獨生子女。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 相當地, 大大地, 非常；搭配：have changed ___ in the past twenty years；change／increase／vary considerably（大幅地，配的是量的變化。修飾比較級時作 considerably + 比較級）

詞彙題.stem: The chairperson of the meeting asked everyone to speak up instead of _____ their opinions among themselves.
詞彙題.stemZh: 會議主席要求大家把意見大聲說出來，而不是彼此小聲嘀咕。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 低聲說, 低語, 私下抱怨（murmur 的現在分詞）

詞彙題.stem: Although Mr. Chen is rich, he is a very _____ person and is never willing to spend any money to help those who are in need.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然陳先生很有錢，但他非常吝嗇，從不願意花錢幫助有需要的人。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 小氣的, 吝嗇的；搭配：he is a very ___ person；be stingy with money／praise（吝於給出，介系詞用 with）

詞彙題.stem: If you want to know what your dreams mean, now there are websites you can visit to help you _____ them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你想知道自己的夢境代表什麼意思，現在有網站可以幫你解夢。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 解釋, 理解, 詮釋, 演繹, 口譯；搭配：help you ___ them；interpret dreams／data／results／body language（解讀需要看懂含意的東西。把 A 解讀成 B 作 interpret sth as + N）

詞彙題.stem: The memory _____ of the new computer has been increased so that more information can be stored.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這台新電腦的記憶體容量已經提升，可以儲存更多資訊。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 容量, 容積, 能力, 身分；搭配：The memory ___ of the new computer；memory／seating capacity／at full capacity（容量。另有能力義 the capacity to V）

詞彙題.stem: Industrial waste must be carefully handled, or it will _____ the public water supply.
詞彙題.stemZh: 工業廢物必須小心處理，否則會____公共供水。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 汙染, 弄髒, 毒害；搭配：it will ___ the public water supply；contaminate the water supply／soil／food（汙染水源、土壤、食物）／be contaminated with／by + N（受…汙染，介系詞用 with 或 by）

詞彙題.stem: John's vision was direct, concrete and simple and he recorded _______ the incidents of everyday life.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰的視野直接、具體而簡單，他____地記錄了日常生活的事件。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 忠實地, 如實地, 準確地, 忠誠地；搭配：recorded ___ the incidents of everyday life；record faithfully（如實記錄）

詞彙題.stem: The government cannot find a good reason to _____ its high expenses on weapons, especially when the number of people living in poverty is so high.
詞彙題.stemZh: 政府找不到好理由來____其高昂的武器開支，特別是在貧困人口如此之多的情況下。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 證明…正當, 為…辯護, 是…的正當理由；搭配：cannot find a good reason to ___ its high expenses；justify + N／V-ing（為…提出正當理由，後面接動詞用 V-ing）／justify the cost／expense／decision（說明這筆費用、這個決定有其道理）／be justified in V-ing（做…是站得住腳的）

詞彙題.stem: The writing teacher has found that reading fantasies such as J. K. Rowling's Harry Potter may inspire her students to think and write with _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 寫作老師發現，閱讀像 J.K.羅琳的《哈利波特》這樣的奇幻作品，可能會激發她的學生用____來思考和寫作。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 創造力, 創造性；搭配：inspire her students to think and write with ___；inspire／encourage／stimulate creativity（激發、鼓勵、刺激創造力）／stifle creativity（扼殺創造力，方向相反）／a lack of creativity（缺乏創意）

詞彙題.stem: Since several child _____ cases were reported on the TV news, the public has become more aware of the issue of domestic violence.
詞彙題.stemZh: 自從電視新聞報導了幾起兒童____案件後，公眾對家庭暴力問題的意識提高了。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 濫用, 虐待, 辱罵；搭配：several child ___ cases were reported；child abuse（虐待兒童）／physical／verbal abuse（肢體暴力、言語暴力）／drug／alcohol abuse／abuse of power（藥物濫用、酗酒、濫用職權，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Helen's doctor suggested that she undergo a heart surgery. But she decided to ask for a second _____ from another doctor.
詞彙題.stemZh: 海倫的醫生建議她接受心臟手術。但她決定向另一位醫生尋求第二次____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 意見, 評價, 主張；搭配：she decided to ask for a second ___ from another doctor；ask for／get a second opinion（徵詢第二意見，尤指再請另一位醫師看）／in my opinion（依我看）／a matter of opinion（見仁見智）

詞彙題.stem: All candidates selected after _____ screening will be further invited to an interview, after which the final admission decision will be made.
詞彙題.stemZh: 所有經過____篩選的候選人將被進一步邀請參加面試，之後將做出最終的錄取決定。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 初步的, 開始的, 預備的；搭配：selected after ___ screening；a preliminary screening（初步篩選）

詞彙題.stem: To prevent terrorist attacks, the security guards at the airport check all luggage carefully to see if there are any _____ items or other dangerous objects.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了防止恐怖攻擊，機場的保安人員會仔細檢查所有行李，看是否有任何____物品或其他危險物品。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 易爆炸的, 爆炸性的, 一觸即發的, 暴躁的；n. 炸藥, 爆炸物；搭配：if there are any ___ items or other dangerous objects；explosive items／devices／materials（易爆物品、爆裂裝置、爆炸性物質）／highly explosive（極易爆炸的）／an explosive temper（暴躁的脾氣，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: In the desert, a huge mall with art galleries, theaters, and museums will be constructed to _____ visitors from the heat outside.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在沙漠中，將建造一個擁有美術館、劇院和博物館的巨大購物中心，以____遊客免受室外的炎熱。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 保護, 遮蔽, 躲避, 庇護；n. 避難所, 庇護所, 遮蔽處；搭配：to ___ visitors from the heat outside；shelter sb from + N（讓某人免受…，介系詞用 from）／shelter from the rain／storm（躲雨、避風雨，作不及物）／take shelter（找地方躲避，作名詞）

詞彙題.stem: Judge Harris always has good points to make. Her arguments are very _____ as they are based on logic and sound reasoning.
詞彙題.stemZh: 哈里斯法官總能提出很好的觀點。她的論點非常有____，因為它們基於邏輯和合理的推理。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有說服力的, 令人信服的；搭配：Her arguments are very ___；a persuasive argument／salesperson（有說服力的論點、很會說服人的業務員）／find sth persuasive（覺得某個說法有說服力）

詞彙題.stem: It rained so hard yesterday that the baseball game had to be ______ until next Saturday.
詞彙題.stemZh: 昨天雨下得太大，棒球賽只好延期到下週六舉行。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 延後, 延期, 延緩（postpone 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：the baseball game had to be ___ until next Saturday；postpone sth until + 時間（延期到…。後面接名詞或動名詞的用法見 92 年學測第 7 題，本題考的是時間介系詞）

詞彙題.stem: As more people rely on the Internet for information, it has ______ newspapers as the most important source of news.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨著越來越多人依賴網路獲取資訊，網路已取代報紙，成為最重要的新聞來源。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 取代, 代替, 替換, 更換, 放回（replace 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：it has ___ newspapers as the most important source of news；replace A as B（取代 A 成為 B。replace A with B 這個用法見 94 年學測第 11 題，本題考的是 as）

詞彙題.stem: Having saved enough money, Joy ______ two trips for this summer vacation, one to France and the other to Australia.
詞彙題.stemZh: 存夠了錢之後，喬伊訂了兩趟今年暑假的旅程，一趟去法國，一趟去澳洲。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 預訂, 預約, 登記（book 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Joy ___ two trips for this summer vacation；book a trip／flight／table／room（預訂。同義的 make a reservation 要加 for：make a reservation for two）

詞彙題.stem: Since I do not fully understand your proposal, I am not in the position to make any ______ on it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於我還沒完全理解你的提案，我沒有立場對此提出任何評論。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 評論, 意見, 評語；v. 評論, 發表意見；搭配：I am not in the position to make any ___ on it；make a comment on sth／comment on sth（評論，介系詞用 on 不用 about。No comment. 是「無可奉告」）

詞彙題.stem: Betty was ______ to accept her friend’s suggestion because she thought she could come up with a better idea herself.
詞彙題.stemZh: 貝蒂不太願意接受朋友的建議，因為她認為自己能想出更好的點子。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 不情願的, 勉強的；搭配：Betty was ___ to accept her friend’s suggestion；be reluctant to V（不情願做…，固定接不定詞。反義是 be willing to V）

詞彙題.stem: The bank tries its best to attract more customers. Its staff members are always available to provide ______ service.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這家銀行竭盡所能吸引更多顧客，行員總是隨時提供迅速的服務。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 迅速的, 及時的, 敏捷的；v. 促使, 引起, 提示；搭配：provide ___ service；prompt service／reply（服務迅速／立即回覆）

詞彙題.stem: John’s part-time experience at the cafeteria is good ______ for running his own restaurant.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰在自助餐廳打工的經驗，是他將來自己開餐廳的良好準備。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 準備, 預備, 預習；搭配：is good ___ for running his own restaurant；preparation for sth／in preparation for（為…所做的準備。要說「做準備」是 make preparations for，用複數）

詞彙題.stem: Women’s fashions are ______ changing: One season they may favor pantsuits, but the next season they may prefer miniskirts.
詞彙題.stemZh: 女性時尚不斷變化：這一季可能流行褲裝套裝，下一季可能又偏好迷你裙。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 不斷地, 經常地, 總是；搭配：Women’s fashions are ___ changing；constantly changing／improving／practice constantly（不斷…。88 年推薦甄選第 2 題也考這個字，但那一格寫的是旁邊的 change one’s mind，本題才是 constantly 自己的名單）

詞彙題.stem: Standing on the seashore, we saw a ______ of seagulls flying over the ocean before they glided down and settled on the water.
詞彙題.stemZh: 站在海邊，我們看到一群海鷗飛過海面，接著滑翔而下，停在水面上。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 鳥群, 羊群, 一群人；v. 聚集, 蜂擁；搭配：we saw a ___ of seagulls flying over the ocean；a flock of birds／sheep（鳥群、羊群。其餘三個量詞各有歸屬：a pack of wolves、a herd of cattle、a school of fish）

詞彙題.stem: The book is not only informative but also ______, making me laugh and feel relaxed while reading it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這本書不僅資訊豐富，也很有趣，讓我在閱讀時又笑又放鬆。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 使人愉快的, 有趣的
