詞彙題.stem: After working in front of my computer for the entire day, my neck and shoulders got so ______ that I couldn’t even turn my head.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在電腦前工作了一整天後，我的脖子和肩膀變得非常僵硬，連頭都轉不動。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 僵硬的, 硬的, 堅硬的, 生硬的, 嚴厲的；搭配：my neck and shoulders got so ___；a stiff neck／shoulders（脖子僵硬、落枕。另有 stiff competition 激烈的競爭）

詞彙題.stem: Getting a flu shot before the start of flu season gives our body a chance to build up protection against the ______ that could make us sick.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在流感季開始前接種流感疫苗，能讓身體有機會建立對抗致病病毒的保護力。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 病毒, 病毒感染, 電腦病毒；搭配：build up protection against the ___ that could make us sick；catch／get a virus（染上病毒。另有 the flu virus 流感病毒、a computer virus 電腦病毒）

詞彙題.stem: The kingdom began to ______ after the death of its ruler, and was soon taken over by a neighboring country.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個王國在統治者去世後開始瓦解，不久便被鄰國併吞。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 倒塌, 崩潰, 瓦解, 昏倒；n. 倒塌, 崩潰, 瓦解；搭配：The kingdom began to ___ after the death of its ruler；a building／the economy／a government／a kingdom collapses（倒塌、垮台，主詞是撐不住的那個東西。另有 collapse under the weight of 不堪重負）

詞彙題.stem: Though Kevin failed in last year’s singing contest, he did not feel ______. This year he practiced day and night and finally won first place in the competition.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管凱文去年在歌唱比賽中落敗，他並沒有感到氣餒。今年他日夜苦練，終於贏得比賽冠軍。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 灰心的, 氣餒的, 失意的, 挫敗的；搭配：he did not feel ___；feel／get frustrated／be frustrated with sb（感到挫折，對某人感到挫折）

詞彙題.stem: Emma and Joe are looking for a live-in babysitter for their three-year-old twins, ______ one who knows how to cook.
詞彙題.stemZh: 艾瑪和喬正在為他們三歲的雙胞胎找一位住家保母，最好是會做飯的人。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 最好是, 可能的話, 更可取地

詞彙題.stem: When dining at a restaurant, we need to be ______ of other customers and keep our conversations at an appropriate noise level.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在餐廳用餐時，我們需要____其他顧客，並將我們的談話保持在適當的音量。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 體貼的, 體諒的, 考慮周到的；搭配：we need to be ___ of other customers；be considerate of／towards sb（體貼某人，介系詞用 of 或 towards）／It is considerate of sb to V（某人做…很體貼）

詞彙題.stem: John shows ______ towards his classmates. He doesn't take part in any of the class activities and doesn't even bother talking to other students in his class.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰對他的同學表現出____。他不參加任何班級活動，甚至懶得和班上其他同學說話。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 漠不關心, 冷淡, 不感興趣；搭配：John shows ___ towards his classmates；show indifference to／towards + N（對…表現出漠不關心，介系詞用 to 或 towards）／with indifference（冷淡地）

詞彙題.stem: To meet the unique needs of the elderly, the company designed a cell phone ______ for seniors, which has big buttons and large color displays.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了滿足老年人的獨特需求，該公司____為老年人設計了一款手機，具有大按鈕和大型彩色顯示螢幕。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 特意, 專門地, 明確地, 具體地；搭配：the company designed a cell phone ___ for seniors；be specifically designed／developed for + N（專為…設計、開發，介系詞用 for）／more specifically（更明確地說）

詞彙題.stem: A well-constructed building has a better chance of ______ natural disasters such as typhoons, tornadoes, and earthquakes.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一座建造精良的建築物更有機會____颱風、龍捲風和地震等自然災害。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 承受, 經受, 抵擋（withstand 的現在分詞）；搭配：a better chance of ___ natural disasters；withstand + 天災或外力（承受得住…）／withstand pressure／heat／the test of time（承受壓力、耐得住高溫、禁得起時間考驗）

詞彙題.stem: Our family doctor has repeatedly warned me that spicy food may ______ my stomach, so I'd better stay away from it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們的家庭醫生一再警告我，辛辣食物可能會____我的胃，所以我最好遠離它。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 激怒, 刺激, 使惱火, 使發炎；搭配：spicy food may ___ my stomach；irritate the stomach／skin／eyes／throat（刺激胃、皮膚、眼睛、喉嚨而引起不適）／irritate sb（惹惱某人，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Because the new principal is young and inexperienced, the teachers are ______ about whether he can run the school well.
詞彙題.stemZh: 因為新校長年輕且缺乏經驗，老師們對他是否能辦好學校感到____。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 懷疑的, 持懷疑態度的；搭配：the teachers are ___ about whether he can run the school well；be skeptical about／of + N（對…感到懷疑，介系詞用 about 或 of）／remain skeptical（仍持保留態度）

詞彙題.stem: Many universities offer a large number of scholarships as an ______ to attract outstanding students to enroll in their schools.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多大學提供大量獎學金作為____，以吸引優秀學生入學。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 誘因, 激勵, 鼓勵, 刺激；搭配：as an ___ to attract outstanding students；an incentive to + V（做…的誘因）

詞彙題.stem: Since Diana is such an ______ speaker, she has won several medals for her school in national speech contests.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於黛安娜是一位如此____的演講者，她已在全國演講比賽中為她的學校贏得了數枚獎牌。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 雄辯的, 有口才的, 有說服力的；搭配：Diana is such an ___ speaker；an eloquent speaker／speech（口才好的演講者、動人的演說）／an eloquent defense／appeal（有力的辯護、動人的呼籲）

詞彙題.stem: The candidate made energy ______ the central theme of his campaign, calling for a greater reduction in oil consumption.
詞彙題.stemZh: 該候選人將能源____作為其競選活動的核心主題，呼籲大幅減少石油消耗。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 保育, 節約, 保護, 保存；搭配：The candidate made energy ___ the central theme of his campaign；energy／water／soil conservation（節約能源、節約用水、水土保持）／wildlife／nature conservation（野生動物保育、自然保育，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Concerned about mudslides, the local government quickly ______ the villagers from their homes before the typhoon hit the mountain area.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於擔心土石流，當地政府在颱風襲擊山區之前迅速將村民從家中____。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 疏散, 撤離, 撤出（evacuate 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：quickly ___ the villagers from their homes；evacuate 人 from + 地方（把某人自…撤離，介系詞用 from）／evacuate a building／an area（撤空一棟建築、淨空一個區域）

詞彙題.stem: Lost and scared, the little dog ______ along the streets, looking for its master.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這隻小狗又迷路又害怕，在街上四處遊蕩，尋找牠的主人。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 遊蕩, 閒逛, 漫步, 走神（wander 的過去式及過去分詞）

詞彙題.stem: On a sunny afternoon last month, we all took off our shoes and walked on the grass with _____ feet.
詞彙題.stemZh: 上個月一個晴朗的下午，我們都脫了鞋，赤腳走在草地上。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 赤裸的, 無遮蔽的, 空的, 僅最基本的；搭配：walked on the grass with ___ feet；bare feet／with one's bare hands（赤腳、徒手，該穿鞋卻沒穿、該有工具卻徒手）／bare shelves／walls（空蕩蕩的貨架、沒掛東西的牆，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: It is both legally and _______ wrong to spread rumors about other people on the Internet.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在網路上散播他人的謠言，在法律和道德上都是不對的。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 道德上, 德性上, 有道德地；搭配：both legally and ___ wrong；morally wrong／right（道德上錯的／對的）；be morally responsible for（道德上該負責）；morally acceptable／unacceptable（道德上可／不可接受）

詞彙題.stem: These warm-up exercises are designed to help people _____ their muscles and prevent injuries.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些暖身運動是為了幫助人們放鬆肌肉、預防受傷而設計的。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 放鬆, 鬆開, 解除；搭配：help people ___ their muscles；loosen one's muscles（放鬆肌肉）；loosen a screw／knot／tie（旋鬆螺絲／解開繩結／鬆開領帶）；loosen one's grip on（放鬆對…的掌控）；反義為 tighten

詞彙題.stem: Mei-ling has a very close relationship with her parents. She always ______ them before she makes important decisions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 美玲和父母的關係非常親密，她做重大決定前總會先徵詢他們的意見。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 請教, 徵求意見, 諮詢, 查閱（consult 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：always ___ them before she makes important decisions；consult sb about sth（就某事請教某人）；consult a doctor／lawyer（求診／諮詢律師）；consult a dictionary／map（查字典／看地圖）；consult with sb（與某人商議）

詞彙題.stem: The restaurant has a _____ charge of NT$250 per person. So the four of us need to pay at least NT$1,000 to eat there.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這間餐廳每人低消新台幣 250 元，所以我們四人要在那裡用餐至少得付 1,000 元。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 最小的, 最低的；搭配：a ___ charge of NT$250；the minimum wage（基本工資）；a minimum requirement／age（最低要求／年齡限制）；a minimum of + 數量（至少…）；keep sth to a minimum（把…降到最低）；反義為 maximum

詞彙題.stem: At the Book Fair, exhibitors from 21 countries will _______ textbooks, novels, and comic books.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在書展中，來自 21 個國家的參展商將展示教科書、小說和漫畫。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 陳列, 展示, 顯示, 表現；n. 陳列, 展示, 顯示, 顯示器；搭配：will ___ textbooks, novels, and comic books；display goods／products（陳列商品）；on display（展示中）；display an interest in（表現出對…的興趣）；名詞用法 a fireworks display（煙火秀）、put on a fireworks display（舉辦煙火施放）

詞彙題.stem: Before John got on the stage to give the speech, he took a deep ________ to calm himself down.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰上台演講前，深呼吸了一口氣讓自己冷靜下來。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 呼吸, 氣息, 一次呼吸；搭配：took a deep ___ to calm himself down；take a deep breath（深呼吸）；hold one's breath（屏住呼吸）；out of breath（喘不過氣）；catch one's breath（喘口氣）

詞彙題.stem: Most young people in Taiwan are not satisfied with a high school _____ and continue to pursue further education in college.
詞彙題.stemZh: 台灣大多數年輕人不滿足於只有高中文憑，會繼續升學進入大學深造。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 文憑, 畢業證書；搭配：not satisfied with a high school ___；a high school diploma（高中畢業證書）；大學以上發的是 degree 不是 diploma——a bachelor's／master's degree（學士／碩士學位）；earn／receive a degree（取得學位）

詞彙題.stem: Residents are told not to dump all household waste _____ into the trash can; reusable materials should first be sorted out and recycled.
詞彙題.stemZh: 居民被告知不要把所有家庭垃圾直接丟進垃圾桶；可回收的材料應該先分類回收。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 直接, 徑直, 筆直地, 立即；adj. 直的, 筆直的, 坦率的, 連續的, 整齊的；搭配：dump all household waste ___ into the trash can；go straight（直走）；sit up straight（坐直）；look sb straight in the eye（直視對方的眼睛）；straight away（立刻）

詞彙題.stem: Kevin had been standing on a ladder trying to reach for a book on the top shelf when he lost his ______ and fell to the ground.
詞彙題.stemZh: 凱文站在梯子上想拿最上層架子的書時，失去平衡摔到了地上。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 平衡, 均衡, 餘額；搭配：lost his ___ and fell to the ground；lose one's balance（失去平衡）；keep／maintain one's balance（保持平衡）；a balanced diet（均衡飲食）；strike a balance between A and B（在兩者之間取得平衡）

詞彙題.stem: If student enrollment continues to drop, some programs at the university may be ______ to reduce the operation costs.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果學生入學人數持續下降，大學可能會為了降低營運成本而裁撤部分學程。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 排除, 取消, 消除, 淘汰（eliminate 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：some programs may be ___ to reduce the operation costs；eliminate the need for（免去…的必要）；eliminate waste／errors／poverty（消除浪費／錯誤／貧窮）；be eliminated from a competition（在比賽中遭淘汰）

詞彙題.stem: People in that remote village feed themselves by hunting and engaging in _____ forms of agriculture. No modern agricultural methods are used.
詞彙題.stemZh: 那個偏遠村莊的居民靠打獵和原始的農耕方式維生，並未使用現代農業技術。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 原始的, 上古的

詞彙題.stem: The government issued a travel _____ for Taiwanese in response to the outbreak of civil war in Syria.
詞彙題.stemZh: 政府因應敘利亞爆發內戰，對國人發布了旅遊警示。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 警報, 戒備；adj. 警覺的, 機警的；v. 使警覺, 通知；搭配：issued a travel ___；issue a travel alert（發布旅遊警示）；be on alert／on high alert（戒備／高度戒備——颱風要來時全島戒備就是這個說法）；put sb on alert（讓某人進入戒備）；alert sb to sth（提醒某人注意某事）；a red alert（紅色警戒）

詞彙題.stem: The baby panda Yuan Zai at the Taipei Zoo was separated from her mother because of a minor injury that occurred during her birth. She was ______ by zookeepers for a while.
詞彙題.stemZh: 台北市立動物園的貓熊寶寶圓仔，因出生時受了輕傷而與母親分開，曾有一段時間由保育員照料。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 照顧, 照料, 護理, 傾向, 往往會（tend 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：She was ___ by zookeepers；tend the sick／a garden（照料病人／整理花園）

詞彙題.stem: John is very close to his family. Whenever he feels depressed, he returns to the warm, ______, and comfortable atmosphere of his home.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰和他的家人非常親近。每當他感到沮喪時,他都會回到他家溫暖、____和舒適的氛圍中。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 安心的, 安全的, 無憂無慮的, 牢靠的, 可靠的；v. 獲得, 使安全, 保護；搭配：the warm, ___, and comfortable atmosphere of his home；feel secure（感到安心）／a secure job／income（有保障的工作與收入）／be secure in the knowledge that + 子句（篤定知道某事而安心）

詞彙題.stem: Tom ______ something before he left the room, but I couldn't figure out exactly what he said.
詞彙題.stemZh: 湯姆離開房間前____了些什麼，但我聽不清他到底說了什麼。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 含糊地說, 咕噥（mumble 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Tom ___ something before he left the room；mumble to oneself（自言自語地咕噥）／mumble under one's breath（壓低聲音嘟囔，不想讓人聽清楚）

詞彙題.stem: The content of the book is very much technical and specialized; it is too difficult for a ______ to understand.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這本書的內容非常技術性和專業性；對於____來說太難理解了。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 外行人, 門外漢, 一般信徒；搭配：it is too difficult for a ___ to understand；in layman's terms（用外行人聽得懂的話說）／a layman（門外漢，與 an expert 專家相對）

詞彙題.stem: Food shortages are one of the main causes of ______ nutrition among children in developing countries.
詞彙題.stemZh: 糧食短缺是發展中國家兒童____營養的主要原因之一。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 不充分的, 不適當的；搭配：one of the main causes of ___ nutrition；inadequate nutrition／supply／funding（營養不足、供應不足、經費不足）／be inadequate for + N（不足以應付）

詞彙題.stem: Good writers do not always write ______; on the contrary, they often express what they really mean in an indirect way.
詞彙題.stemZh: 好的作家並不總是____地寫作；相反地，他們常常用間接的方式表達他們的真實意思。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 明確地, 明白地；搭配：Good writers do not always write ___；explicitly state／say／mention（明白說出）／explicitly forbid／prohibit（明文禁止）／形容詞 explicit 的用法見 89 學測第 6 題

詞彙題.stem: According to the weather report, some light rain or ______ is expected today. You may need to take an umbrella with you when you go out.
詞彙題.stemZh: 根據天氣預報，今天預計會有一些小雨或____。你出門時可能需要帶傘。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 毛毛雨, 細雨；v. 下毛毛雨；搭配：some light rain or ___ is expected today；light／fine／steady drizzle（毛毛雨，drizzle 本身就指細小的雨）／in the drizzle（在細雨中）

詞彙題.stem: The movie was so popular that many people came to the ______ conclusion that it must be good; however, many professional critics thought otherwise.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這部電影非常受歡迎，以致於許多人得出了它一定很好的____結論；然而，許多專業評論家卻不這麼認為。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 天真的, 純真的, 幼稚的；搭配：came to the ___ conclusion；a naive conclusion／assumption（天真的結論／假設）

詞彙題.stem: In ancient times, people used large shells to ______ voices in open-air ceremonies so that their tribal members near and far could hear what was said.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在古代，人們在露天儀式上使用大貝殼來____聲音，以便遠近的部落成員都能聽到所說的話。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 增強, 放大, 擴大, 詳述；搭配：people used large shells to ___ voices in open-air ceremonies；amplify a sound／a voice／a signal（把聲音或訊號放大）／an amplifier（詞形，放大器、擴大機）

詞彙題.stem: The audience held their breath and sat motionless in the theater as they watched the tragic historical event ______ in front of their eyes.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當觀眾看著那悲慘的歷史事件在眼前____時，他們屏住呼吸，一動不動地坐在劇院裡。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 展開, 發展, 呈現, 打開, 攤開（unfold 的現在分詞）；搭配：historical event ___ in front of their eyes；events unfold（事件逐漸展開）

詞彙題.stem: According to government regulations, if employees are unable to work because of a serious illness, they are ______ to take an extended sick leave.
詞彙題.stemZh: 根據政府規定，如果員工因重病無法工作，他們____請長病假。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有權利的, 有資格的；v. 給予權利, 使有資格, 給…命名（entitle 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：___ to take an extended sick leave；be entitled to + V（有權做…）

詞彙題.stem: Nowadays many companies adopt a ______ work schedule which allows their employees to decide when to arrive at work—from as early as 6 a.m. to as late as 11 a.m.
詞彙題.stemZh: 現今許多公司採用彈性工時制度，讓員工自行決定上班時間——最早可以早上 6 點，最晚到上午 11 點。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 靈活的, 可變通的, 可彎曲的, 柔韌的；搭配：adopt a ___ work schedule；flexible working hours（彈性工時）；a flexible schedule／timetable（彈性班表／課表）；be flexible about sth（在某件事上有彈性）；反義為 rigid（僵化的）、fixed（固定的）

詞彙題.stem: To teach children right from wrong, some parents will ______ their children when they behave well and punish them when they misbehave.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了教導孩子明辨是非，有些父母會在孩子表現良好時給予獎勵，行為不當時則加以處罰。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 獎賞, 獎勵, 酬謝, 報答；n. 報酬, 獎賞, 酬金, 賞金；搭配：will ___ their children when they behave well；reward sb for sth（因某事獎賞某人）；reward sb with sth（用某物獎賞某人）；as a reward for（作為…的回報）；易混淆 award sb a prize（頒獎給某人）

詞彙題.stem: To stick to a tight budget, Robert bought a more ______ LED TV instead of a fancy, expensive 3D TV.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了堅守有限的預算，羅伯特買了一台較平價的 LED 電視，而不是昂貴炫目的 3D 電視。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 負擔得起的, 價格合理的；搭配：bought a more ___ LED TV；at affordable prices（用負擔得起的價格——107 指考翻譯官方用字）；affordable housing（平價住宅）；反面說法 high housing prices（高房價）；動詞用法 afford 見 95 學測第 1 題

詞彙題.stem: David’s new book made it to the best-seller list because of its beautiful ______ and amusing stories.
詞彙題.stemZh: 大衛的新書因為精美的插圖和有趣的故事而登上暢銷排行榜。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 插圖, 插畫, 圖解, 實例（illustration 的複數）

詞彙題.stem: The airport was closed because of the snowstorm, and our ______ for Paris had to be delayed until the following day.
詞彙題.stemZh: 機場因暴風雪而關閉，我們飛往巴黎的出發時間只好延後到隔天。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 離開, 出發, 違背, 偏離；搭配：our ___ for Paris had to be delayed；departure for + 地點（前往某地的啟程）；departure from + 地點（自某地出發）；departure time／gate／lounge（起飛時間／登機門／候機室）；反義為 arrival

詞彙題.stem: The moment the students felt the earthquake, they ran ______ out of the classroom to an open area outside.
詞彙題.stemZh: 學生一感覺到地震，就迅速跑出教室到外面的空曠處。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 迅速地, 很快地

詞彙題.stem: The ______ capacity of this elevator is 400 kilograms. For safety reasons, it shouldn’t be overloaded.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這台電梯的最大載重是 400 公斤，基於安全考量，不應超載。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 最高的, 最大的, 最大極限的；搭配：the ___ capacity of this elevator；maximum capacity／speed／temperature（最大容量／最高速度／最高溫度）；a maximum of + 數量（最多…）；反義 minimum 那一組見 103 學測第 6 題

詞彙題.stem: An open display of ______ behavior between men and women, such as hugging and kissing, is not allowed in some conservative societies.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在一些保守的社會中，不允許公開展現男女之間親密的行為，例如擁抱和親吻。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 親密的, 私人的, 秘密的；搭配：an open display of ___ behavior；an intimate relationship（親密關係）；an intimate friend（密友）；be on intimate terms with sb（與某人交情很好）；intimate details（私密細節）

詞彙題.stem: When taking medicine, we should read the instructions on the ______ carefully because they provide important information such as how and when to take it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 服藥時應仔細閱讀標籤上的說明，因為上面有服用方法與時間等重要資訊。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 標籤, 標示（label 的複數）；搭配：read the instructions on the ___；read the label（看清楚標示）；a warning／price label（警語標示／價格標籤）；label A as B（把 A 貼上 B 的標籤）

詞彙題.stem: The angry passengers argued ______ with the airline staff because their flight was cancelled without any reason.
詞彙題.stemZh: 憤怒的乘客與航空公司人員激烈爭吵，因為他們的班機無故被取消。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 激烈地, 猛烈地, 狂怒地, 拚命地

詞彙題.stem: To ______ the new product, the company offered some free samples before they officially launched it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了推廣新產品，公司在正式上市前提供了一些免費樣品。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 推廣, 促銷, 促進, 晉升；搭配：to ___ the new product；promote a product（推廣產品）；promote health／peace（促進健康／和平）；be promoted to + 職位（升任…）；a sales promotion（促銷活動）

詞彙題.stem: I was worried about my first overseas trip, but my father ______ me that he would help plan the trip so that nothing would go wrong.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我對第一次出國旅行感到擔心，但父親向我保證他會協助規劃行程，確保一切順利。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 向…保證, 使確信, 確保（assure 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 自信的, 確定的；搭配：my father ___ me that he would help；assure sb that …（向某人保證…）；assure sb of sth（向某人擔保某事）；rest assured that（儘管放心…）；易混淆 ensure that（確保）、insure（投保）

詞彙題.stem: The recent cooking oil scandals have led to calls for tougher ______ of sales of food products.
詞彙題.stemZh: 近來的食用油醜聞引發了要求對食品銷售實施更嚴格管制的呼聲。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 管制, 規定, 規則, 法規, 管理；搭配：calls for tougher ___ of sales；the regulation of + 事物（對…的管制）；safety／government regulations（安全法規／政府法規）；rules and regulations（規章制度）；follow／comply with regulations（遵守規定）

詞彙題.stem: John should ______ more often with his friends and family after work, instead of staying in his room to play computer games.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰下班後應該多和朋友、家人互動，而不是待在房間裡打電腦遊戲。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 互動, 交流, 相互影響；搭配：should ___ more often with his friends；interact with sb（與某人互動）；interact with each other（彼此互動）；interaction between A and B（雙方之間的互動）；social interaction（社交互動）

詞彙題.stem: To prevent the spread of the Ebola virus from West Africa to the rest of the world, many airports have begun Ebola ______ for passengers from the infected areas.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為防止伊波拉病毒從西非擴散到世界其他地區，許多機場已開始對來自疫區的旅客進行伊波拉篩檢。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 篩檢, 檢查（screening 的複數）；搭配：begun Ebola ___ for passengers；health／security screening（健康／安全檢查）

詞彙題.stem: Microscopes are used in medical research labs for studying bacteria or ______ that are too small to be visible to the naked eye.
詞彙題.stemZh: 顯微鏡在醫學研究實驗室中用於研究肉眼看不見的細菌或____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 病菌, 細菌（germ 的複數）；搭配：for studying bacteria or ___ that are too small；spread／carry／transmit germs（傳播、帶有病菌）／kill germs（殺死病菌）

詞彙題.stem: Lisa hopped on her bicycle and ______ as fast as she could through the dark narrow backstreets to get home after working the night shift.
詞彙題.stemZh: 麗莎跳上她的自行車，在值完夜班後，盡可能快地____穿過黑暗狹窄的後巷回家。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 騎（腳踏車）, 踩踏板（pedal 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：hopped on her bicycle and ___ as fast as she could；pedal a bicycle／bike（踩踏板騎車，受詞幾乎只配腳踏車一類）／pedal hard／furiously／fast（用力踩、飛快地踩）

詞彙題.stem: Rated as one of the top restaurants of the city, this steak house is highly ______ to visitors by the tourism bureau.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這家牛排館被評為該市頂級餐廳之一，觀光局向遊客們高度____。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 推薦, 建議, 勸告（recommend 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 推薦的, 建議的；搭配：this steak house is highly ___ to visitors；strongly／highly recommend（強力推薦）／recommend sb／sth to sb（把某人或某物推薦給某人，介系詞用 to）／recommend that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（建議…，另一個用法）

詞彙題.stem: The manager ______ agreed to rent his apartment to me. Even though the agreement was not put in writing, I am sure he will keep his word.
詞彙題.stemZh: 經理____同意把他的公寓租給我。雖然協議沒有書面化，但我相信他會信守諾言。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 口頭上, 言語上, 非書面地；搭配：The manager ___ agreed to rent his apartment to me；verbally agree／promise／confirm（口頭上答應、口頭承諾，本題即此義，verbally ↔ in writing）／verbally abuse／attack／threaten sb（言語上的辱罵與攻擊，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: For Jerry, practicing yoga three times a week is a relaxing ______ from his tight work schedule.
詞彙題.stemZh: 對傑瑞來說，每週練習三次瑜伽是他緊張工作日程中的一種放鬆的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 消遣, 娛樂, 轉移注意力的事物, 轉移, 改道；搭配：___ from his tight work schedule；a diversion from + N（暫時擺脫…的調劑）

詞彙題.stem: Parents could be charged with neglect or abandonment if they leave their young children home alone without adult ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果父母將年幼的孩子獨自留在家中而無成人____，他們可能會被控疏忽或遺棄。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 監督, 管理；搭配：leave their young children home alone without adult ___；adult／parental／medical supervision（成人、家長、醫療監督，形容詞側是封閉名單）／under (sb's) supervision、without supervision（在某人監督之下、無人看顧）

詞彙題.stem: Walking at a ______ pace for a shorter amount of time burns more calories than walking at a slow pace for a longer period of time.
詞彙題.stemZh: 以____的步伐走較短的時間，比以慢速走較長的時間燃燒更多的卡路里。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 輕快的, 生氣勃勃的, 清新涼爽的；搭配：Walking at a ___ pace for a shorter amount of time；a brisk walk／at a brisk pace（快步走、以輕快的步伐，本題即此義）／do a brisk trade／business（生意興隆，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Plants and animals in some deserts must cope with a climate of ______—freezing winters and very hot summers.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一些沙漠中的動植物必須應對____的氣候——嚴寒的冬天和酷熱的夏天。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 極端, 極度, 極端的事物（extreme 的複數）；搭配：must cope with a climate of ___；extremes of temperature／weather／heat and cold（溫度、天氣、冷熱的兩極，本題即此義，恆用複數）／go to extremes、go from one extreme to the other（做得太過頭、從一個極端擺到另一端，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: The success of J.K. Rowling is ______, with her Harry Potter series making her a multi-millionaire in just a few years.
詞彙題.stemZh: J.K.羅琳的成功是____的，她的哈利波特系列在短短幾年內就讓她成為了千萬富翁。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 傳奇的, 赫赫有名的, 傳說中的；搭配：The success of J.K. Rowling is ___；be／become legendary（傳為佳話、名聲響亮，本題把它放在 be 動詞後面當主詞補語）／a legendary figure／player（傳奇人物、傳奇球員）

詞彙題.stem: The high-tech company's ______ earnings surely made its shareholders happy since they were getting a good return on their investment.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這家高科技公司的____收益肯定讓股東們高興，因為他們的投資得到了很好的回報。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 強健的, 強勁的, 穩健的, 強壯的, 堅固的, 耐用的；搭配：company's ___ earnings；robust earnings／growth（亮眼的獲利／成長）

詞彙題.stem: Posters of the local rock band were displayed in store windows to promote the sale of their _____ tickets.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當地搖滾樂團的海報張貼在商店櫥窗，以促銷他們的演唱會門票。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 音樂會, 演唱會；搭配：promote the sale of their ___ tickets；go to／attend a concert（去聽演唱會——不說 join a concert）；give／hold a concert（舉辦演唱會）；a concert hall（音樂廳）；取消與表演那兩組見 85 推薦甄選第 15 題與 97 學測第 14 題

詞彙題.stem: Maria didn’t want to deliver the bad news to David about his failing the job interview. She herself was quite _____ about it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 瑪莉亞不想把大衛面試失敗的壞消息告訴他，她自己對此也感到相當難過。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 難過的, 心煩的, 生氣的, 不舒服的；v. 使心煩, 使難過, 打亂, 打翻；搭配：She herself was quite ___ about it；be upset about／over sth（為某事心煩）；get upset（動氣、鬧脾氣）；upset the balance（打破平衡）；an upset stomach（腸胃不適）

詞彙題.stem: The newcomer speaks with a strong Irish _____; he must be from Ireland.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位新來的人講話帶有濃厚的愛爾蘭腔，他一定是愛爾蘭人。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 口音, 腔調, 重音；搭配：speaks with a strong Irish ___；speak with an accent（帶著某種口音說話）；a strong／heavy accent（很重的口音）；a British／southern accent（英國腔／南方腔）；lose one's accent（口音不見了）

詞彙題.stem: Although Maggie has been physically _____ to her wheelchair since the car accident, she does not limit herself to indoor activities.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管瑪姬自從車禍後身體就得靠輪椅行動，她並沒有把自己侷限在室內活動。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 侷限, 限制, 禁閉（confine 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：has been physically ___ to her wheelchair；be confined to a wheelchair／bed（行動限於輪椅／臥床不起）；confine sth to（把…侷限在）；a confined space（密閉空間）

詞彙題.stem: All passengers riding in cars are required to fasten their seatbelts in order to reduce the risk of _____ in case of an accident.
詞彙題.stemZh: 所有乘車的乘客都必須繫上安全帶，以降低發生事故時受傷的風險。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 傷害, 受傷, 損傷；搭配：reduce the risk of ___；suffer a serious head injury（頭部受重傷——學生多半寫成 his head was hurt badly，英文習慣用名詞）；a serious／minor injury（重傷／輕傷）；the risk of injury（受傷的風險）；a knee／back injury（膝傷／背傷）

詞彙題.stem: The principal of this school is a man of exceptional _____. He sets aside a part of his salary for a scholarship fund for children from needy families.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這所學校的校長是個非常慷慨的人，他把部分薪水撥出來設立獎學金，幫助貧困家庭的孩子。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 慷慨, 寬大；搭配：a man of exceptional ___；exceptional／great generosity（極為慷慨。配的是「程度很高」這一類形容詞）／show generosity to sb（對某人展現慷慨，介系詞用 to）

詞彙題.stem: The science teacher always _____ the use of the laboratory equipment before she lets her students use it on their own.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位理化老師總是先示範實驗器材的用法，才讓學生自己操作。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 示範, 展示, 證明, 顯示, 示威（demonstrate 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：always ___ the use of the laboratory equipment；demonstrate how to + V（示範怎麼做）；demonstrate the use of（示範…的用法）；demonstrate that + 子句（證明…）；另一個意思 demonstrate against（示威抗議）

詞彙題.stem: Most of the area is covered by woods, where bird species are so _____ that it is a paradise for birdwatchers.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個地區大部分被森林覆蓋，鳥類種類繁多，是賞鳥者的天堂。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 很多的, 數目眾多的, 多數的

詞彙題.stem: In most cases, the committee members can reach agreement quickly. _____, however, they differ greatly in opinion and have a hard time making decisions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 大多數情況下，委員會成員都能很快達成共識。然而偶爾他們意見會有很大分歧，難以做出決定。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 偶爾, 有時候, 間或

詞彙題.stem: Many people try to save a lot of money before _____, since having enough money would give them a sense of security for their future.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多人在退休前努力存錢，因為擁有足夠的錢能讓他們對未來更有安全感。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 退休, 退職, 退休生活；搭配：save a lot of money before ___；before／after retirement（退休前／後——學生多半寫成 before they retire）；early retirement（提早退休）；retirement age／plan（退休年齡／退休計畫）；動詞 retire from（自…退休）

詞彙題.stem: In winter, our skin tends to become dry and _____, a problem which is usually treated by applying lotions or creams.
詞彙題.stemZh: 冬天時我們的皮膚容易變得乾燥發癢，這個問題通常可以擦乳液或乳霜來改善。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 癢的, 發癢的, 使人發癢的；搭配：our skin tends to become dry and ___；dry and itchy skin（乾癢的皮膚）；an itchy throat／nose（喉嚨癢／鼻子癢）；itchy eyes（眼睛癢）

詞彙題.stem: Benson married Julie soon after he had _____ her heart and gained her parents’ approval.
詞彙題.stemZh: 班森在贏得茱莉的芳心、獲得她父母的認可後不久，就和她結婚了。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 征服, 擊敗, 克服（conquer 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：after he had ___ her heart；conquer one's fear（克服恐懼）；conquer a disease／a mountain（戰勝疾病／攻頂）；conquer sb's heart（擄獲某人的心，同義 win sb's heart）

詞彙題.stem: The recent flood completely _____ my parents’ farm. The farmhouse and fruit trees were all gone and nothing was left.
詞彙題.stemZh: 最近這場洪水徹底毀了我父母的農場，農舍和果樹全都不見了，什麼都沒剩下。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 毀壞, 毀掉, 破壞, 使破產（ruin 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 毀壞的, 成為廢墟的；搭配：The recent flood completely ___ my parents' farm；ruin one's life／career／reputation（毀掉人生／前途／名聲）；be ruined by（毀於…）；in ruins（成為廢墟）

詞彙題.stem: The results of this survey are not reliable because the people it questioned were not a typical or _____ sample of the entire population that was studied.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這份調查的結果並不可靠，因為受訪者並非該研究母體具代表性的典型樣本。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有代表性的, 典型的, 代表…的；n. 代表, 代理人；搭配：not a typical or ___ sample；a representative sample（有代表性的樣本）；be representative of（足以代表…）；名詞用法 a sales representative（業務代表）

詞彙題.stem: In line with the worldwide green movement, carmakers have been working hard to make their new models more _____ friendly to reduce pollution.
詞彙題.stemZh: 因應全球綠色運動，汽車製造商一直致力於讓新車款更加環保，以減少污染。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 在環境方面, 在環保上；搭配：make their new models more ___ friendly；environmentally friendly（環保的）；user-friendly（好上手的）；environmental protection／pollution（環境保護／環境污染）

詞彙題.stem: Martha has been trying to ______ her roommate since their quarrel last week, as she doesn't want to continue the argument.
詞彙題.stemZh: 自從上週吵架後，瑪莎一直試圖____她的室友，因為她不想繼續爭吵。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 避免, 避開, 迴避；搭配：has been trying to ___ her roommate since their quarrel；avoid doing sth（避免做某事，後面接動名詞，不接不定詞）／avoid eye contact／the issue（避開眼神接觸、避談問題）

詞彙題.stem: As David finished the last drop of the delicious chicken soup, he licked his lips and gave out sounds of ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當大衛喝完最後一滴美味的雞湯時，他舔了舔嘴唇，發出了____的聲音。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 滿足, 滿意, 知足；搭配：licked his lips and gave out sounds of ___；a feeling／sense of contentment（滿足感，98 指考文意選填第 21 格考過同一組）／a sigh of contentment（滿足的嘆息，與本題的 sounds of contentment 同型）

詞彙題.stem: After several rounds of intense fighting, the boxer punched his ______ right in the face, knocked him out, and won the match.
詞彙題.stemZh: 經過幾輪激烈的戰鬥，拳擊手一拳打在____的臉上，將他擊倒，贏得了比賽。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 對手, 敵手, 反對者；搭配：the boxer punched his ___ right in the face；beat／defeat one's opponent、a worthy opponent（擊敗對手、可敬的對手，本題即此義）／an opponent of the plan／the war（計畫、戰爭的反對者，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Watch out! The bench has just been painted. You can fan the wet paint if you want to ______ its drying.
詞彙題.stemZh: 小心！長凳剛漆過。如果你想____它的乾燥，你可以搧濕油漆。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 加快, 加速, 催促, 趕緊；搭配：if you want to ___ its drying；hasten the process（加快進度，別跟 fasten 繫緊搞混）

詞彙題.stem: Warm milk ______ sleepiness. So if you have trouble falling asleep, try drinking some warm milk before going to bed.
詞彙題.stemZh: 溫牛奶會____睡意。所以如果你入睡困難，睡前試著喝些溫牛奶。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 引起, 導致, 誘使, 催生（induce 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：Warm milk ___ sleepiness；induce sleep／sleepiness／vomiting（引發睡意、催吐，受詞多為生理狀態，本題即此義）／induce sb to do sth（勸使某人做某事，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Having worked five years as a data processor in a small town, Alice is tired of the routine of her job and the ______ of her life.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在一個小鎮當了五年的資料處理員後，愛麗絲厭倦了她工作的常規和生活的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 單調, 缺乏變化；搭配：tired of the routine of her job and the ___ of her life；break／relieve the monotony of sth（打破、排解某事的單調，動詞側是封閉名單）／escape the monotony of daily life（逃離日復一日的單調）

詞彙題.stem: Peter has never been on time to meetings or appointments. It would be interesting to look into reasons why he is ______ late.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彼得從未準時參加會議或約會。探究他為何____遲到的原因會很有趣。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 慢性地, 長期地, 習慣性地；搭配：why he is ___ late；chronically late／ill（老是遲到／長期患病）

詞彙題.stem: The film Life of Pi won Ang Lee an Oscar in 2013 for Best Director—one of the most ______ awards in the movie industry.
詞彙題.stemZh: 電影《少年 Pi 的奇幻漂流》為李安贏得了 2013 年奧斯卡最佳導演獎——這是電影界最____的獎項之一。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 令人垂涎的, 夢寐以求的；v. 覬覦, 垂涎, 渴望（covet 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：one of the most ___ awards；a coveted award／prize（人人稱羨的獎項／獎品）

詞彙題.stem: According to environmental scientists, the earth is likely to experience significant ______ changes within the next century.
詞彙題.stemZh: 根據環境科學家的說法，地球在下個世紀內可能會經歷重大的____變化。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 生態的, 生態學的, 環保的；搭配：experience significant ___ changes within the next century；the ecological balance（生態平衡）／an ecological disaster、ecological damage（生態浩劫、生態破壞）

詞彙題.stem: Traditional Chinese medical practices include ______ remedies, which use plants, plant parts, or a mixture of these to prevent or cure diseases.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傳統中醫實踐包括____療法，使用植物、植物部分或其混合物來預防或治療疾病。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 草藥的；搭配：Traditional Chinese medical practices include ___ remedies；herbal remedy／medicine（草藥療法、草藥，本題即此義）／herbal tea（花草茶，飲品那一側）

詞彙題.stem: John’s clock is not functioning _____. The alarm rings even when it’s not set to go off.
詞彙題.stemZh: 約翰的時鐘運作不正常，即使沒有設定，鬧鈴也會響。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 正確地, 合適地, 適當地, 恰當地；搭配：is not functioning ___；work／function properly（機器運作正常，中文的正常不是 normally，另有 properly trained 受過正規訓練）

詞彙題.stem: Michael has decided to _____ a career in physics and has set his mind on becoming a professor.
詞彙題.stemZh: 麥可決定投身物理學領域，並下定決心要成為一名教授。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 追求, 從事, 追趕, 追捕, 追查；搭配：has decided to ___ a career in physics；pursue a career／a dream／a degree（追求事業／夢想／學位，直接接受詞，不加 after）

詞彙題.stem: Peter plans to hike in a _____ part of Africa, where he might not meet another human being for days.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彼得計畫到非洲偏遠地區健行，那裡可能好幾天都遇不到另一個人。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 偏遠的, 偏僻的, 遙遠的, 疏遠的, 微乎其微的, 遠端的；搭配：hike in a ___ part of Africa；a remote area／village（偏遠地區／村落）

詞彙題.stem: People in this community tend to _____ with the group they belong to, and often put group interests before personal ones.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個社群裡的人往往會認同自己所屬的團體，常把團體利益擺在個人利益之前。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 識別, 認同, 認出, 確定；搭配：tend to ___ with the group；identify with + N（認同某人或某群體，一定要加 with，另一個用法 identify + N 是辨識出身分，如 identify the victim）

詞彙題.stem: I mistook the man for a well-known actor and asked for his autograph; it was really _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我把那名男子誤認成知名演員，還向他要簽名，真的很尷尬。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 令人尷尬的, 使人難堪的, 令人為難的

詞彙題.stem: After spending most of her salary on rent and food, Amelia _____ had any money left for entertainment and other expenses.
詞彙題.stemZh: 阿蜜莉亞的薪水大多花在房租和伙食上，幾乎沒有剩下多少錢可以用於娛樂或其他開銷。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 幾乎沒有, 幾乎不, 僅, 剛好；搭配：Amelia ___ had any money left；barely any + N（幾乎沒有，barely 本身就是否定，配 any 不配 some，另有 barely visible 幾乎看不見、barely four inches long 才四英寸長）

詞彙題.stem: In the Bermuda Triangle, a region in the Western part of the North Atlantic Ocean, some airplanes and ships were reported to have mysteriously disappeared without a _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在北大西洋西側的百慕達三角，據報導曾有一些飛機和船隻神祕地消失得無影無蹤。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 痕跡, 蹤跡, 微量, 少許；v. 追蹤, 找到, 追溯, 描摹；搭配：mysteriously disappeared without a ___；disappear／vanish without a trace（消失得無影無蹤，動詞用法見 87 學年度推薦甄選第 9 題）

詞彙題.stem: Shouting greetings and waving a big sign, Tony _____ the passing shoppers to visit his shop and buy the freshly baked bread.
詞彙題.stemZh: 東尼一邊大聲招呼、一邊揮舞大招牌，極力邀請路過的顧客光顧他的店，購買剛出爐的麵包。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 力勸, 敦促, 催促, 驅策（urge 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Tony ___ the passing shoppers to visit his shop；urge sb to + V（力勸某人做…）

詞彙題.stem: With a continuous 3 km stretch of golden sand, the beach attracts artists around the world each summer to create amazing _____ with its fine soft sand.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這片綿延三公里的金色沙灘，每年夏天都吸引世界各地的藝術家前來，用細軟的沙子創作出令人驚豔的沙雕。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 雕塑, 雕刻, 雕塑品, 雕刻品（sculpture 的複數）；搭配：create amazing ___ with its fine soft sand；sand／ice／bronze sculptures（沙雕／冰雕／銅雕，一件件作品可數用複數，指這門藝術時不可數）

詞彙題.stem: The clouds parted and a _____ of light fell on the church, through the windows, and onto the floor.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雲層散開，一道光束灑落在教堂上，穿過窗戶，落在地板上。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 光線, 光束, 橫樑；v. 眉開眼笑, 發光；搭配：a ___ of light fell on the church；a beam of light／sunlight（一道光／陽光，光的量詞用 beam，不用 line 或 piece，另有動詞 beam with joy 眉開眼笑）

詞彙題.stem: Instead of a gift, Tim’s grandmother always _____ some money in the birthday card she gave him.
詞彙題.stemZh: 提姆的祖母總是在生日卡片裡附上一些錢，而不是送禮物。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 附上, 隨函附上, 圍住（enclose 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 附上的, 封閉的；搭配：always ___ some money in the birthday card；enclose sth in + N（把…附在…裡）

詞彙題.stem: While winning a gold _____ is what every Olympic athlete dreams of, it becomes meaningless if it is achieved by cheating.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然贏得金牌是每位奧運選手的夢想，但如果是靠作弊得來的，就毫無意義了。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 獎牌, 勳章

詞彙題.stem: The thief went into the apartment building and stole some jewelry. He then _____ himself as a security guard and walked out the front gate.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這名竊賊潛入公寓大樓偷了一些珠寶，接著偽裝成保全人員，大搖大擺地從正門走出去。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 偽裝, 假扮, 喬裝, 掩飾（disguise 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：He then ___ himself；disguise oneself as + N（偽裝成…，反身受詞不能省，另有 in disguise 喬裝、a blessing in disguise 因禍得福）

詞彙題.stem: Due to numerous accidents that occurred while people were playing Pokémon GO, players were advised to be _____ of possible dangers in the environment.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於玩「精靈寶可夢 GO」時發生了許多意外，玩家被建議要留意周遭環境可能的危險。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 意識到的, 知道的, 察覺的；搭配：to be ___ of possible dangers；be aware of + N（察覺到…，aware 後面一定要加 of，接子句用 be aware that，名詞是 awareness）

詞彙題.stem: Sherlock Holmes, a detective in a popular fiction series, has impressed readers with his amazing powers of _____ and his knowledge of trivial facts.
詞彙題.stemZh: 福爾摩斯——知名小說系列中的偵探——以其驚人的觀察力和對瑣碎細節的博學，讓讀者印象深刻。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 觀察, 注意, 觀測, 觀察力；搭配：his amazing powers of ___；keen observation（敏銳的觀察，另有 make an observation 提出看法，動詞用 make 不用 do，其餘兩個用法見 92 學年度學測第 6 題與 93 學年度學測第 2 題）

詞彙題.stem: Gorillas have often been portrayed as a fearful animal, but in truth these shy apes ______ fight over sex, food, or territory.
詞彙題.stemZh: 大猩猩常被描繪成一種可怕的動物，但事實上，這些害羞的猿類____會為了性、食物或領地而打鬥。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 很少地, 罕有地

詞彙題.stem: With her nine-to-five job, Sally sometimes has to run personal ______ during the lunch break, such as going to the bank or mailing letters.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於朝九晚五的工作，莎莉有時不得不在午休時間辦理一些私人的____，比如去銀行或寄信。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 差事, 跑腿（errand 的複數）；搭配：Sally sometimes has to run personal ___ during the lunch break；run errands（跑腿、辦雜事，動詞固定用 run）／send sb on an errand（差某人去辦事）

詞彙題.stem: After an argument with the parents of his students, the teacher finally admitted his mistake and ______ himself to ask for their forgiveness.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在與學生家長發生爭執後，老師終於承認了自己的錯誤並____自己請求他們的原諒。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 使謙卑, 放下身段, 使感到慚愧（humble 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：the teacher finally admitted his mistake and ___ himself；humble oneself（放下身段，後面固定接反身代名詞）／a humble background／request（出身寒微、謙卑的請求）

詞彙題.stem: Instead of criticizing other people, we should focus on their strengths and give them ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們不應該批評別人，而應該專注於他們的優點並給予他們____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 稱讚, 恭維話, 問候, 致意（compliment 的複數）；搭配：focus on their strengths and give them ___；give／pay sb a compliment（讚美某人）／compliment sb on + N（因某事稱讚某人，介系詞用 on）／a backhanded compliment（表面稱讚實則挖苦的話）

詞彙題.stem: Taking advantage of a special function of the search engine, users can ______ the Internet without leaving behind any history of the webpages they visit.
詞彙題.stemZh: 利用搜尋引擎的一個特殊功能，使用者可以____網路，而不會留下任何他們訪問過的網頁歷史記錄。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 瀏覽, 吃草；搭配：users can ___ the Internet without leaving behind any history；browse the Internet／a website（瀏覽網路、網站，直接接受詞）／browse through a magazine（隨手翻閱雜誌，介系詞用 through）

詞彙題.stem: Due to extremely low rainfall and a dangerous reduction of reservoir water, the area is experiencing the worst ______ in 30 years.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於降雨量極低和水庫水量危險性減少，該地區正經歷 30 年來最嚴重的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 乾旱, 缺乏；搭配：the area is experiencing the worst ___ in 30 years；a severe／prolonged drought（嚴重的、持續的乾旱）／suffer from drought（受旱災之苦）

詞彙題.stem: On Teachers' Day we pay ______ to Confucius for his contribution to the philosophy of education.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在教師節，我們向孔子____，以表彰他對教育哲學的貢獻。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 讚揚, 敬意, 頌詞, 禮物, 貢品；搭配：we pay ___ to Confucius for his contribution；pay tribute to sb（向某人致敬，動詞固定用 pay）／a tribute to sb（對某人的頌揚）

詞彙題.stem: When the fire fighter walked out of the burning house with the crying baby in his arms, he was ______ as a hero by the crowd.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當消防員抱著哭泣的嬰兒走出燃燒的房子時，他被群眾____為英雄。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 譽為, 稱讚, 招呼, 下冰雹（hail 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：he was ___ as a hero by the crowd；hail sb as + N（讚譽某人為…，介系詞用 as）／be hailed as a hero／a breakthrough（被譽為英雄、重大突破）

詞彙題.stem: Due to the worldwide recession, the World Bank's forecast for next year's global economic growth is ______.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於全球經濟衰退，世界銀行對明年全球經濟增長的預測是____的。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 令人擔憂的, 令人沮喪的, 嚴肅的, 冷酷的；搭配：the World Bank's forecast for next year's global economic growth is ___；a grim forecast／outlook／picture（嚴峻的預測、前景、景況）／grim reality（殘酷的現實）

詞彙題.stem: Jeffery has always been a ______ person, so it's not surprising he got into an argument with his colleagues.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑佛瑞一直是一個____的人，所以他與同事發生爭執並不奇怪。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 喜歡吵架的, 好爭論的；搭配：Jeffery has always been a ___ person；a quarrelsome person／child（好爭吵的人、小孩）／quarrel with sb about／over + N（為某事與某人爭吵）

詞彙題.stem: Mangoes are a _____ fruit here in Taiwan; most of them reach their peak of sweetness in July.
詞彙題.stemZh: 芒果在台灣是季節性水果，大多數在七月時甜度達到高峰。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 季節性的, 季節的, 週期性的；搭配：Mangoes are a ___ fruit here in Taiwan；seasonal fruit／vegetables（季節性水果／蔬菜，中文的「季節」是名詞，這裡英文要用形容詞 seasonal，名詞 season 則用在 in season 當令、out of season 非當令）

詞彙題.stem: Writing term papers and giving oral reports are typical course _____ for college students.
詞彙題.stemZh: 撰寫期末報告和進行口頭報告是大學生典型的課程要求。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 要求, 規定, 必要條件, 需要（requirement 的複數）；搭配：typical course ___ for college students；meet／satisfy the requirements for + N（達到…的要求，中文的「達到」不用 reach 或 achieve，且要求通常不只一項，用複數 requirements）

詞彙題.stem: If we work hard to _____ our dreams when we are young, we will not feel that we missed out on something when we get old.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果我們趁年輕努力實現夢想，年老時就不會覺得自己錯過了什麼。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 實現, 履行, 完成, 滿足；搭配：work hard to ___ our dreams；fulfill a dream／promise／potential（實現夢想／承諾、發揮潛能，配的是答應過或期待中的那一類事，另有形容詞 fulfilling 指工作讓人覺得充實）

詞彙題.stem: Few people will trust you if you continue making _____ promises and never make efforts to keep them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 如果你一直開空頭支票、卻從不努力去實現，很少有人會信任你。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 空的, 空洞的, 虛偽的, 空心的, 凹陷的；n. 坑, 洞；搭配：continue making ___ promises；hollow promises／words／victory（空頭承諾／空話／贏了卻沒意義的勝利，指表面有內裡沒有，另有具體義的 a hollow tree 中空的樹）

詞彙題.stem: Becky _____ her ankle while she was playing tennis last week. Now it still hurts badly.
詞彙題.stemZh: 貝琪上週打網球時扭傷了腳踝，現在還是很痛。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 扭傷, 扭轉, 纏繞, 曲解（twist 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Becky ___ her ankle；twist／sprain one's ankle（扭傷腳踝，兩個動詞通用，同樣配 wrist 手腕與 knee 膝蓋，受詞前面要加所有格，另有 a twisted sense of humor 扭曲的幽默感）

詞彙題.stem: Research shows that men and women usually think differently. For example, they have quite different _____ about what marriage means in their life.
詞彙題.stemZh: 研究顯示男女思考方式通常不同。舉例來說，他們對婚姻在人生中的意義有著相當不同的信念。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 信念, 看法, 信仰（belief 的複數）；搭配：quite different ___ about what marriage means；religious／political beliefs（宗教／政治信念，一個人的信念通常不只一條，用複數 beliefs，另有 belief in + N 相信…存在或有價值）

詞彙題.stem: The new manager is very _____. For instance, the employees are given much shorter deadlines for the same tasks than before.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位新經理要求非常嚴格，例如同樣的工作，員工現在被給予的期限比以前短得多。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 要求高的, 費力的；搭配：The new manager is very ___；a demanding job／boss／customer（要求嚴格的工作／上司／客人，配的是會把標準訂高的人或事，另有 be in demand 搶手，那是名詞 demand）

詞彙題.stem: While the couple were looking _____ for their missing children, the kids were actually having fun in the woods nearby.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這對夫妻焦急地尋找失蹤的孩子時，孩子們其實正在附近的樹林裡玩得很開心。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 憂慮地, 不安地；搭配：the couple were looking ___ for their missing children；look／search anxiously for + N（焦急地找，這個副詞跟在動詞後面，另有 anxiously await 焦急等待，那一組是放在動詞前面）；形容詞 anxious 的用法見 95 學測第 6 題

詞彙題.stem: After delivering a very powerful speech, the award winner was _____ by a group of fans asking for her signature.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位得獎者發表了一場非常有力的演講後，被一群索取簽名的粉絲團團圍住。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 包圍, 環繞, 圍繞（surround 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：the award winner was ___ by a group of fans；be surrounded by + N（被…包圍，被動用 by，主動則是 surround oneself with + N 讓自己身邊都是…，介系詞跟著語態換）

詞彙題.stem: The interviewees were trying very hard to _____ the interviewers that they were very capable and should be given the job.
詞彙題.stemZh: 求職者們非常努力想讓面試官印象深刻，證明自己能力出眾、應該獲得這份工作。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 使印象深刻, 使欽佩, 使銘記；搭配：trying very hard to ___ the interviewers；impress sb with + N（用…讓某人印象深刻，另有 make a good impression on sb 給某人好印象，介系詞用 on 不用 to）

詞彙題.stem: After the first snow of the year, the entire grassland disappeared under a _____ of snow.
詞彙題.stemZh: 今年初雪過後，整片草原被一層雪覆蓋，消失不見。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 毛毯, 毯子, 厚厚的一層（覆蓋物）；v. 以厚層覆蓋；搭配：disappeared under a ___ of snow；a blanket of snow／fog（一層雪／霧）

詞彙題.stem: Peter likes books with wide _____, which provide him with enough space to write notes.
詞彙題.stemZh: 彼得喜歡頁緣寬的書，這樣他就有足夠的空間寫筆記。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 頁邊空白, 邊緣, 差額, 利潤（margin 的複數）；搭配：books with wide ___；write sth in the margin（寫在頁邊留白處，這個意思常用複數 margins，另有 profit margin 利潤率與 win by a narrow margin 以些微差距勝出）

詞彙題.stem: At the beginning of the semester, the teacher told the students that late assignments would receive a low grade as a _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 學期初，老師告訴學生遲交作業將以低分作為處罰。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 處罰, 懲罰, 刑罰, 罰款, 罰球, 不利；搭配：receive a low grade as a ___；a penalty for + N（…的罰則，介系詞用 for，另有 pay／face a penalty 受罰與 the death penalty 死刑）

詞彙題.stem: Various studies have been _____ in this hospital to explore the link between a high-fat diet and cancer.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這間醫院已進行多項研究，探討高脂飲食與癌症之間的關聯。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 進行, 實施, 指揮（樂隊）, 傳導（電或熱）（conduct 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Various studies have been ___ in this hospital；conduct a study／survey／experiment（進行研究／調查／實驗，正式的研究活動用 conduct，另有 conduct electricity 導電與 conduct an orchestra 指揮樂團）

詞彙題.stem: Intense, fast-moving fires raged across much of California last week. The _____ firestorm has claimed the lives of thirty people.
詞彙題.stemZh: 上週猛烈迅速蔓延的野火席捲了加州大部分地區，這場大規模的火災已奪走三十條人命。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 巨大的, 大規模的, 大量的, 厚重的；搭配：The ___ firestorm has claimed the lives of thirty people；a massive earthquake／explosion／heart attack（大規模的地震／爆炸／嚴重的心臟病發，配的是規模驚人的災害或事件。另一個意思是大量的，用在 massive amounts of + N）

詞彙題.stem: The sign in front of the Johnsons' house says that no one is allowed to set foot on their ______ without permission.
詞彙題.stemZh: 強森家門前的標示寫著，未經許可，任何人不得踏入他們的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 財產, 房地產, 地產, 所有權, 屬性；搭配：no one is allowed to set foot on their ___；set foot on sb's property（踏入某人的地產，動詞固定用 set foot）／private property（私人土地，告示牌上的固定寫法）／intellectual property（智慧財產權）

詞彙題.stem: Instead of giving negative criticism, our teachers usually try to give us ______ feedback so that we can improve on our papers.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我們的老師通常不會給予負面批評，而是試圖給我們____的回饋，以便我們能改進我們的論文。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 建設性的, 有益的, 積極的；搭配：our teachers usually try to give us ___ feedback；constructive criticism／advice／feedback（有建設性的批評、建議、回饋）／constructive dialogue（有建設性的對話）

詞彙題.stem: A study shows that the chance of an accident is much higher for drivers who are ______ in phone conversations while driving.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一項研究顯示，開車時____於電話交談的司機發生事故的機率要高得多。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 忙於…的, 從事…的, 已訂婚的, （電話）佔線的；搭配：drivers who are ___ in phone conversations while driving；be engaged in + N／V-ing（從事、忙於某事，介系詞用 in）／be engaged to sb（與某人訂婚，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Mike trembled with ______ and admiration when he saw the magnificent view of the waterfalls.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當麥克看到瀑布的壯麗景色時，他因____和欽佩而顫抖。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 敬畏, 驚嘆；搭配：Mike trembled with ___ and admiration；tremble／shake with awe（因敬畏而顫抖，介系詞用 with）／be／stand in awe of sb（對某人心生敬畏）／awe-inspiring（令人敬畏的，形容詞形）

詞彙題.stem: Ms. Chen has a large collection of books and most of them are quite heavy; she needs a bookshelf ______ enough to hold all of them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 陳女士藏書甚多，且大部分都很重；她需要一個夠____的書架來放置所有書。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 堅固的, 結實的, 牢固的, 強壯的, 堅定的；搭配：she needs a bookshelf ___ enough to hold all of them；a sturdy table／chair／pair of shoes（結實耐用的桌子、椅子、鞋）／a sturdy build（結實的體格）

詞彙題.stem: The athlete rolled up his sleeves to show his ______ forearms, thick and strong from years of training in weight-lifting.
詞彙題.stemZh: 那位運動員捲起袖子，露出他____的前臂，因多年舉重訓練而變得粗壯有力。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 強壯的, 肌肉發達的, 有力的；搭配：to show his ___ forearms, thick and strong；muscular arms／legs（發達的手臂、腿）／a muscular build（結實的體格，不可寫成 muscle build）

詞彙題.stem: Suffering from a serious financial crisis, the car company is now on the edge of ______, especially with the recent sharp decrease in its new car sales.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於嚴重的財務危機，這家汽車公司現在正處於____的邊緣，尤其是最近新車銷量急劇下降。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 破產；搭配：the car company is now on the edge of ___；on the edge／verge／brink of bankruptcy（瀕臨破產）／file for bankruptcy（聲請破產，動詞固定用 file for）／go bankrupt（破產，形容詞形）

詞彙題.stem: After the rain, the meadow ______ under the sun with the droplets of water on the grass.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雨後，草地上的水珠在陽光下____。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 閃耀, 閃閃發亮（glisten 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：the meadow ___ under the sun with the droplets of water；glisten with sweat／dew／tears（因汗水、露水、淚水而閃亮，介系詞用 with）／glisten in the sun（在陽光下閃爍）

詞彙題.stem: The Great Wall of China was originally built to ______ the northern border of the country against foreign invasion.
詞彙題.stemZh: 中國的長城最初是為了____國家的北部邊界以抵禦外國入侵而建造的。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 加強防禦, 加強, 增強, 使堅強；搭配：originally built to ___ the northern border against foreign invasion；fortify a city／a border against + N（加強防禦以抵擋…，介系詞用 against）／be fortified with vitamins（強化添加維生素，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: A mad scientist in a novel is often portrayed as a wild-eyed man with crazy hair, working ______ in a lab full of strange equipment and bubbling test tubes.
詞彙題.stemZh: 小說中的瘋狂科學家常被描繪成一個眼神狂野、頭髮凌亂的男人，在一個充滿奇怪設備和冒泡試管的實驗室裡____地工作。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 發狂似地, 緊張忙亂地, 瘋狂地

詞彙題.stem: Bobby cared a lot about his _____ at home and asked his parents not to go through his things without his permission.
詞彙題.stemZh: 巴比非常重視自己在家中的隱私，要求父母未經他同意不要翻他的東西。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 隱私, 隱私權, 獨處；搭配：cared a lot about his ___ at home；invade／respect sb's privacy（侵犯／尊重某人的隱私，另有 a privacy policy 隱私權政策）

詞彙題.stem: The new manager is a real gentleman. He is kind and humble, totally different from the former manager, who was _____ and bossy.
詞彙題.stemZh: 新來的經理真是位紳士，他既善良又謙虛，和以前那位刻薄又愛指使人的經理完全不同。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 刻薄的, 卑劣的, 吝嗇的, 小氣的, 平均的；v. 意思是, 意味著, 打算；搭配：the former manager, who was ___ and bossy；be mean to sb（對某人刻薄，介系詞用 to）；動詞義是「意思是」，名詞是 means，單複數同形——by means of 藉由、a means to an end 達到目的的手段

詞彙題.stem: The weather bureau _____ that the typhoon would bring strong winds and heavy rains, and warned everyone of the possible danger.
詞彙題.stemZh: 氣象局預測這次颱風將帶來強風豪雨，並警告大家注意可能的危險。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 預測, 預言, 預料（predict 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：The weather bureau ___ that the typhoon would；predict the weather／outcome／result（預測天氣／結果，另有 it is predicted that + 子句。氣象預報的固定用字是 forecast，the weather forecast 天氣預報）

詞彙題.stem: Different airlines have different _____ for carry-on luggage, but many international airlines limit a carry-on piece to 7 kilograms.
詞彙題.stemZh: 不同航空公司對隨身行李有不同的限制，但許多國際航空公司規定隨身行李重量限制為 7 公斤。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 限制, 限制條件, 規定（restriction 的複數）；搭配：different ___ for carry-on luggage；impose／lift restrictions on + N（實施／解除…的限制，這個意思常用複數）；restrict／limit／confine sth to + N 三個字同型；動詞用法見 90 學測第 3 題

詞彙題.stem: Many people were happy that the government had finally _____ Children’s Day as a national holiday.
詞彙題.stemZh: 政府終於宣布兒童節為國定假日，許多人都感到開心。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 宣布, 宣告, 申報, 斷言（declare 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：___ Children's Day as a national holiday；declare A (as) B（宣布 A 為 B）；declare war／independence（宣戰／宣布獨立）；announce 是宣布消息，pronounce 是正式宣告或指發音

詞彙題.stem: To reach the goal of making her company a market leader, Michelle _____ a plan to open ten new stores around the country this year.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了讓公司成為市場領導者，蜜雪兒提出了今年在全國開設十家新店的計畫。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 提出, 提議, 建議（propose 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 建議的, 計劃的；搭配：___ a plan to open ten new stores；propose a plan／solution／change（提出計畫／解決辦法／變革）；propose that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（假設語氣）；求婚是 propose to sb，口語說 tie the knot

詞彙題.stem: Silence in some way is as _____ as speech. It can be used to show, for example, disagreement or lack of interest.
詞彙題.stemZh: 沉默在某種程度上和言語一樣具有表達力，它可以用來表示，例如，不贊同或缺乏興趣。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 富有表現力的, 富於表情的, 表達的；搭配：Silence in some way is as ___ as speech；an expressive face／voice／gesture（富有表情的臉／有感情的聲音／傳達意思的手勢）

詞彙題.stem: This TV program is designed for children, _____ for those under five. It contains no violence or strong language.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個電視節目是為兒童設計的，尤其是五歲以下的孩子，內容不含暴力或粗俗用語。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 尤其, 特別, 格外

詞彙題.stem: Tommy, please put away the toys in the box, or you might _____ on them and hurt yourself.
詞彙題.stemZh: 湯米，請把玩具收進箱子裡，不然你可能會被絆倒受傷。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 絆倒, 絆腳, 跌跌撞撞地走, 結結巴巴地說

詞彙題.stem: The _____ costume party, held every September, is one of the biggest events of the school year.
詞彙題.stemZh: 每年九月舉行的年度化妝派對，是這學年度最盛大的活動之一。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 每年的, 一年一次的, 全年的, 一年生的；搭配：The ___ costume party, held every September；an annual event／meeting／report（年度活動／年會／年報）；annual income／leave（年收入／年假）

詞彙題.stem: In a job interview, attitude and personality are usually important _____ that influence the decision of the interviewers.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在求職面試中，態度和個性通常是影響面試官決定的重要因素。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 因素（factor 的複數）；搭配：attitude and personality are usually important ___；a key／major／determining factor（關鍵／主要／決定性的因素）；factors that influence + N（影響…的因素）

詞彙題.stem: The snow-capped mountain is described so _____ in the book that the scene seems to come alive in front of the reader’s eyes.
詞彙題.stemZh: 書中對這座白雪皚皚的山描寫得如此生動，彷彿那景象就在讀者眼前活了過來。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 生動地, 鮮明地, 清晰地, 鮮豔地；搭配：is described so ___ in the book；vividly describe／remember／recall（生動地描述、清楚地記得，動詞名單封閉）；形容詞 vivid 的用法見 98 學測第 1 題

詞彙題.stem: Surrounded by flowers blooming and birds _____ merrily, the Wangs had a good time hiking in the national park.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在盛開的花朵和歡快鳴叫的鳥兒環繞下，王家人在國家公園健行度過了愉快的時光。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 啁啾, 吱喳叫（chirp 的現在分詞）；搭配：birds ___ merrily；birds／crickets chirp（鳥啁啾、蟲唧唧，chirp 的主詞限於鳥類與昆蟲）

詞彙題.stem: It is essential for us to maintain constant _____ with our friends to ensure that we have someone to talk to in times of need.
詞彙題.stemZh: 與朋友保持經常性的聯絡對我們來說非常重要，這樣在需要時才有人可以傾訴。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 聯絡, 聯繫, 接觸, 人脈；v. 聯絡, 聯繫；搭配：maintain constant ___ with our friends；keep／stay in contact with sb（與某人保持聯絡）；maintain contact with sb 不加 in；come into contact with + N（接觸到…）

詞彙題.stem: The young generation in this country has shown less interest in factory work and other _____ labor jobs, such as house construction and fruit picking.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個國家的年輕一代對工廠工作及其他體力勞動工作（如房屋建造和採果）的興趣越來越低。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 體力的, 手工的, 手動的, 用手的；n. 手冊, 說明書；搭配：other ___ labor jobs, such as house construction；manual labor／work（勞力工作、手工的）；當名詞是使用手冊，a user's manual／an instruction manual

詞彙題.stem: When John proposes an idea, people in his office always lend their support. He feels lucky to have ______ like them.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當約翰提出一個想法時，他辦公室的人總是給予支持。他覺得有他們這樣的____很幸運。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 同事, 同僚（colleague 的複數）

詞彙題.stem: As last year's MVP (Most Valuable Player), Joan is ______ to the basketball team. No other player can replace her.
詞彙題.stemZh: 作為去年的 MVP（最有價值球員），瓊對籃球隊來說是____。沒有其他球員可以取代她。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 不可或缺的, 必不可少的, 絕對必要的；搭配：Joan is ___ to the basketball team；be indispensable to + 人或團體（對…不可或缺）／be indispensable for + 事物或目的（要達成…少不了它）／an indispensable part／role（不可或缺的一環、角色）

詞彙題.stem: The researcher warned that the results of the study needed to be interpreted with ______ because the sample size was not big enough to make firm conclusions.
詞彙題.stemZh: 研究人員警告說，對該研究結果的解釋需要____，因為樣本量不夠大，無法得出確切的結論。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 謹慎, 小心, 慎重, 警告；v. 告誡, 提醒；搭配：needed to be interpreted with ___；with caution（謹慎地，與副詞 cautiously 同義，該字見 98 年指考第 5 題）／exercise caution（審慎行事）／a word of caution（一句提醒）

詞彙題.stem: Although the small group of soldiers was greatly ______ by their enemy, they fought with great courage and finally won the battle.
詞彙題.stemZh: 雖然這小群士兵在____上遠不及敵人，但他們以極大的勇氣戰鬥，並最終贏得了戰鬥。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 在數量上超過, 比…多（outnumber 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：the small group of soldiers was greatly ___ by their enemy；be outnumbered by + N（在人數上被…壓過）／outnumber A by + 倍數或人數（人數多過 A 多少）

詞彙題.stem: Mr. Wise received an award for his ______ to the needy children and the elderly in the neighborhood.
詞彙題.stemZh: 懷斯先生因其對鄰里貧困兒童和老人的____而獲獎。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 奉獻, 摯愛, 忠誠, 熱愛, 投入；搭配：received an award for his ___ to the needy children；devotion to + N（對…的付出、投入）／be devoted to + N（致力於、奉獻給，這一組是形容詞的用法）

詞彙題.stem: One simple yet good way to ______ your love for your family is to express it directly in words.
詞彙題.stemZh: ____你對家人的愛，一個簡單而好的方法就是直接用言語表達出來。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 顯示, 表現, 表明；adj. 明顯的, 顯而易見的；搭配：a good way to ___ your love for your family；manifest itself in／as + N（以…的形式顯現）／manifest one's feelings（把感受表露出來）

詞彙題.stem: Cloning animals has been very controversial. Some people consider it a medical breakthrough, while others think it is ______ and should be prohibited.
詞彙題.stemZh: 動物複製一直備受爭議。有些人認為這是一項醫學突破，而另一些人則認為這是____的，應該被禁止。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 不道德的；搭配：others think it is ___；unethical behavior／practice（不道德的行為、做法）／it is unethical to + 原形動詞（做…是不道德的）

詞彙題.stem: Animals that stay in groups are more likely to find food and detect danger than a ______ animal—multiple pairs of eyes are better than one.
詞彙題.stemZh: 群居動物比____動物更容易找到食物和發現危險——多雙眼睛勝過一雙。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 孤獨的, 獨居的；搭配：than a ___ animal；a solitary animal／life（獨居動物、獨居生活）／solitary confinement（單獨監禁）

詞彙題.stem: On the first page of her new book, the writer ______ all the people who helped in the publication of the book.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在新書的第一頁，作者____了所有幫助該書出版的人。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 承認, 致謝, 告知收到, 向…打招呼（acknowledge 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：___ all the people who helped；acknowledge sb's help（感謝某人的協助）

詞彙題.stem: Due to the recession, it is not easy for people to get ______ paid jobs, even if they are highly educated and well-trained in the field.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於經濟衰退，即使人們受過高等教育並在該領域受過良好培訓，也不容易找到____薪酬的工作。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 相當不錯地, 像樣地, 得體地, 正派地；搭配：get ___ paid jobs；a decently paid job（待遇不錯的工作）

詞彙題.stem: On cold winter nights, a bowl of ______ and spicy beef noodle soup is much more popular than any other food served in this restaurant.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在寒冷的冬夜裡，一碗____又辣的牛肉麵湯比這家餐廳供應的任何其他食物都更受歡迎。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 冒著熱氣的, 滾燙的；搭配：a bowl of ___ and spicy beef noodle soup；steaming hot（滾燙的，兩個字連用）／a steaming bowl of + 食物（一碗熱騰騰的…）

詞彙題.stem: The government official gave some shocking examples to ______ the seriousness of the traffic problem.
詞彙題.stemZh: 政府官員舉了一些驚人的例子來____交通問題的嚴重性。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 強調, 突顯, 在…下面畫線；搭配：___ the seriousness of the traffic problem；underline the importance／seriousness of + N（凸顯…的重要性、嚴重性）／underline a word（在字的下面畫線）

詞彙題.stem: Jenny lost her parents at the age of five. Despite this ______, she managed to become a leading scholar in computer science.
詞彙題.stemZh: 珍妮五歲時失去了父母。儘管有此____，她還是成功地成為了一位頂尖的電腦科學學者。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 不幸, 災禍, 壞運氣；搭配：Despite this ___；suffer a misfortune（遭逢不幸）／have the misfortune to + 原形動詞（不幸遇上…）

詞彙題.stem: The newspaper apologized for releasing false information that had ______ the public to believe toilet paper was in short supply and caused panic buying.
詞彙題.stemZh: 該報為發布不實資訊而道歉，該資訊____公眾相信衛生紙短缺並引發了恐慌性搶購。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 誤導, 使產生錯誤的想法（mislead 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：had ___ the public to believe；mislead sb into + 動名詞（誤導某人去做…）／misleading information／advertising（誤導性的資訊、廣告）

詞彙題.stem: The glass lid of the pot is ______, and the cook can clearly observe how well the food is prepared.
詞彙題.stemZh: 鍋子的玻璃蓋是____的，廚師可以清楚地觀察食物的烹煮情況。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 透明的, 顯然的, 清晰的；搭配：The glass lid of the pot is ___；transparent glass／plastic（透明玻璃、透明塑膠）／be transparent about + N（對…公開透明）

詞彙題.stem: Many people ______ Christopher Columbus with the discovery of America, but others question this honor because Native Americans had lived there long before his arrival.
詞彙題.stemZh: 許多人將發現美洲的____歸功於哥倫布，但其他人對此榮譽提出質疑，因為在他抵達之前，美洲原住民早已居住在那裡。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 功勞, 讚揚, 榮譽, 信用, 賒帳, 學分；v. 把…歸功於, 相信, 存入（帳戶）；搭配：___ Christopher Columbus with the discovery of America；credit sb with + N（把…歸功於某人）／give sb credit for + N（肯定某人在…上的功勞）／take credit for + N（把功勞攬在自己身上）

詞彙題.stem: To prevent the spread of disease, we should take the ______ of washing our hands frequently.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為防止疾病傳播，我們應該採取勤洗手的____。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 預防措施, 預防, 警戒；搭配：we should take the ___ of washing our hands；take precautions against + N（採取措施預防…）／as a precaution（以防萬一）

詞彙題.stem: Sharing profits with employees is an effective way to improve their ______ and thus increase productivity in a company.
詞彙題.stemZh: 與員工分享利潤是提高他們____從而增加公司生產力的有效方法。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 士氣, 鬥志；搭配：an effective way to improve their ___；boost／raise morale（提振士氣）／low／high morale（士氣低落、士氣高昂）

詞彙題.stem: As he pulled out of the parking lot, Mr. Chuang drove so ______ that he hit several vehicles and almost knocked down a small girl.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當莊先生駛出停車場時，他開車如此____，以致於撞了好幾輛車，還差點撞倒一個小女孩。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 魯莽地, 輕率地, 不顧後果地；搭配：drove so ___ that he hit several vehicles；drive recklessly（魯莽駕駛）

詞彙題.stem: When the culture center was seriously damaged in a fire, all its prescheduled activities came to an ______ halt.
詞彙題.stemZh: 當文化中心在火災中嚴重受損時，所有預定的活動都____停止了。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 突然的, 唐突的, 陡峭的, 不連貫的；搭配：came to an ___ halt；come to an abrupt halt／end（戛然而止）

詞彙題.stem: After hours of discussion, our class finally reached the _____ that we would go to Hualien for our graduation trip.
詞彙題.stemZh: 經過數小時的討論，我們班終於得出結論，決定去花蓮畢業旅行。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 結論, 結尾, 推論；搭配：reached the ___ that we would go to Hualien；reach the conclusion that + 子句（得出…的結論，不用 get）

詞彙題.stem: Jane _____ her teacher by passing the exam with a nearly perfect score; she almost failed the course last semester.
詞彙題.stemZh: 珍以近乎滿分的成績通過考試，讓老師大吃一驚；她上學期這門課差點被當掉。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 驚訝的, 驚奇的；v. 使驚訝（amaze 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：Jane ___ her teacher by passing the exam；amaze sb by V-ing（使某人驚訝）／be amazed at + N（對…感到驚訝）

詞彙題.stem: The vacuum cleaner is not working. Let’s send it back to the _____ to have it inspected and repaired.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這台吸塵器故障了，我們把它送回製造商檢修吧。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 製造業者, 廠商；搭配：send it back to the ___ to have it inspected；a manufacturer of + 產品（…的製造商，不用 for）

詞彙題.stem: Due to the global financial crisis, the country’s exports _____ by 40 percent last month, the largest drop since 2000.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於全球金融危機，該國上個月出口銳減 40%，是自 2000 年以來最大的跌幅。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 減少, 下降, 降低（decrease 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：the country’s exports ___ by 40 percent；decrease by + 幅度（減少多少）／decrease to + 數值（減至多少）

詞彙題.stem: The potato chips have been left uncovered on the table for such a long time that they no longer taste fresh and _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這些洋芋片沒加蓋放在桌上太久了，已經不再新鮮酥脆。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 酥脆的, 鬆脆的；搭配：they no longer taste fresh and ___；crispy bacon／chips／fried chicken（配的是酥脆的那一類食物。別跟 crisp air 冷冽的空氣搞混）

詞彙題.stem: The townspeople built a _____ in memory of the brave teacher who sacrificed her life to save her students from a burning bus.
詞彙題.stemZh: 鎮民建了一座紀念碑，紀念那位為了從燃燒的公車中救出學生而犧牲性命的勇敢老師。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 紀念碑, 紀念物, 石碑；搭配：built a ___ in memory of the brave teacher；build a monument in memory of sb（立碑紀念某人）

詞彙題.stem: The students in Professor Smith’s classical Chinese class are required to _____ poems by famous Chinese poets.
詞彙題.stemZh: 史密斯教授的中國古典文學課要求學生背誦中國著名詩人的詩作。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 背誦, 朗讀, 敘述；搭配：required to ___ poems by famous Chinese poets；recite a poem（背誦、朗讀）／recite sth from memory（憑記憶背出）

詞彙題.stem: Although Mr. Tang claims that the house belongs to him, he has not offered any proof of _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管唐先生聲稱這棟房子是他的，他卻沒有提出任何所有權的證明。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 所有權, 物主身份；搭配：has not offered any proof of ___；proof of ownership（所有權證明）／offer proof of + N（proof 此處不可數，不加冠詞）

詞彙題.stem: Ancient Athens, famous for its early development of the democratic system, is often said to be the _____ of democracy.
詞彙題.stemZh: 古雅典因其早期發展民主制度而聞名，常被稱為民主的搖籃。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 搖籃, 發祥地, 孩提時代；搭配：the ___ of democracy；the cradle of civilization（文明的發祥地）

詞彙題.stem: The candy can no longer be sold because it was found to contain artificial ingredients far beyond the _____ level.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這款糖果被發現人工添加物含量遠超過容許標準，因此不能再販售了。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 容許的, 允許的, 許可的；搭配：far beyond the ___ level；the permissible level（容許標準）／It is permissible to V（可以…）

詞彙題.stem: Jack’s excellent performance in last week’s game has _____ all the doubts about his ability to play on our school basketball team.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑克上週比賽的出色表現，消除了大家對他能否勝任校籃球隊一員的所有疑慮。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 消除, 擦掉, 抹去, 刪除（erase 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：has ___ all the doubts about his ability；erase doubts about + N（消除對…的疑慮）

詞彙題.stem: It is bullying to _____ a foreign speaker’s accent. No one deserves to be laughed at for their pronunciation.
詞彙題.stemZh: 嘲笑外國人的口音是一種霸凌行為，沒有人應該因為自己的發音而被嘲笑。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 嘲笑, 嘲弄, 模仿, 挫敗；adj. 模擬的, 假的；n. 模擬考試；搭配：It is bullying to ___ a foreign speaker’s accent；mock sb／tease sb／laugh at sb（嘲笑，mock 與 tease 及物，laugh 須加 at）

詞彙題.stem: Mary lost ten kilograms in three months, so her _____ skin-tight jeans are now hanging off her hips.
詞彙題.stemZh: 瑪麗三個月瘦了十公斤，所以她以前緊身的牛仔褲現在都鬆垮垮地掛在臀部上。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 從前, 以前

詞彙題.stem: The police officer showed us pictures of drunk driving accidents to highlight the importance of staying _____ on the road.
詞彙題.stemZh: 警官給我們看酒駕事故的照片，強調開車保持清醒的重要性。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 清醒的, 未醉的, 冷靜的, 嚴肅的, 樸素的；搭配：the importance of staying ___ on the road；stay sober（保持清醒、不喝酒）

詞彙題.stem: The claim that eating chocolate can prevent heart disease is _____ because there is not enough scientific evidence to support it.
詞彙題.stemZh: 吃巧克力能預防心臟病的說法是有爭議的，因為並沒有足夠的科學證據支持。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有爭議的, 有討論餘地的, 不確定的；搭配：The claim that eating chocolate can prevent heart disease is ___；a disputable claim（有爭議、有待商榷的說法）

詞彙題.stem: Due to a budget cut, our company's annual year-end party, which is usually quite a treat, has to be held at a ______ cost.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於預算削減，我們公司通常相當豐盛的年度年終派對，必須以____的成本舉行。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 最小的, 極微的, 最小限度的；搭配：has to be held at a ___ cost；at a minimal cost（以極低的成本，介系詞用 at）／minimal effort／damage／risk（極少的力氣、極小的損害、極低的風險）

詞彙題.stem: A plot to rob the bank was ______ to the police, and all the people involved in the plan were caught.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一項搶劫銀行的陰謀被____給警方，所有參與該計畫的人都被抓獲了。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 揭露, 顯示, 透露, 洩露（reveal 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：A plot to rob the bank was ___ to the police；reveal sth to sb（向某人揭露某事，介系詞用 to）／reveal that + 子句（透露…）／be revealed as + N（被揭露為…）

詞彙題.stem: One good way to ______ questions you don't want to answer in a conversation is to change the topic.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在對話中____你不想回答的問題的一個好方法是轉移話題。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 避開, 迴避, 躲避；搭配：one good way to ___ questions you don't want to answer；dodge a question／the issue／responsibility（迴避問題、爭議、責任）／dodge a bullet（僥倖躲過一劫）

詞彙題.stem: To apply for a job, you need to have ______ such as skills, education, and experience required by the job.
詞彙題.stemZh: 要申請一份工作，你需要具備該工作所要求的____，例如技能、教育和經驗。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 資格, 資歷, 條件, 合格證書, 限制條件（qualification 的複數）；搭配：you need to have ___ such as skills, education, and experience；have／meet the qualifications for + N（具備、符合某職位的資格，介系詞用 for）／academic／professional qualifications（學歷、專業資格，慣用複數）

詞彙題.stem: For years, Lily has been ______ all incoming calls on both her mobile phone and home phone because she hates to be bothered by unknown callers.
詞彙題.stemZh: 多年來，莉莉一直在____她手機和家裡電話的所有來電，因為她討厭被陌生來電者打擾。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 過濾, 篩選（filter 的現在分詞）；搭配：Lily has been ___ all incoming calls；filter calls／water／information（過濾來電、水、資訊）／filter out + N（把…濾掉、篩除）

詞彙題.stem: Many people felt extremely sad and angry over the ______ news of a stray dog found abused and killed in the park.
詞彙題.stemZh: 對於在公園裡發現一隻流浪狗被虐殺的____消息，許多人感到極度悲傷和憤怒。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 悲傷的

詞彙題.stem: Chris never shows up at meetings on time. His excuse for being ______ late is that he wants to avoid small talk at the beginning of the meetings.
詞彙題.stemZh: 克里斯開會從不準時。他____遲到的藉口是想避免會議開始時的閒聊。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 一貫地, 始終如一地, 持續地

詞彙題.stem: Steve will quit his job next week. His ______ is completely unexpected, especially after his promotion and pay raise two months ago.
詞彙題.stemZh: 史蒂夫下週將辭職。他的____完全出乎意料，尤其是在他兩個月前升職加薪之後。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 辭職, 辭呈, 聽從；搭配：his ___ is completely unexpected；hand in／submit one's resignation（遞辭呈，動詞固定用 hand in，不說 give）／accept sb's resignation（批准某人辭職）／resign from + N（辭去…職務，動詞形）

詞彙題.stem: People with an ______ illness should avoid going to public places to keep the diseases from spreading.
詞彙題.stemZh: 患有____疾病的人應避免去公共場所，以防疾病傳播。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 有傳染性的, 易傳染的；搭配：people with an ___ illness should avoid going to public places；an infectious disease／illness（傳染病，醫學上的固定說法）／infectious laughter／enthusiasm（有感染力的笑聲、熱情）

詞彙題.stem: Although electronic devices are very popular nowadays, paper ______ are still most common in major elections around the world.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管如今電子設備非常普及，但在世界各地的主要選舉中，紙本____仍然最為普遍。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 選票, 無記名投票（ballot 的複數）；搭配：paper ___ are still most common in major elections；cast a ballot（投票，動詞固定用 cast，不說 throw）／a secret ballot（不記名投票）／the ballot box（票匭）

詞彙題.stem: Tom is really a naughty boy. He likes to _____ and play jokes on his younger sister when their parents are not around.
詞彙題.stemZh: 湯姆真是個調皮的男孩，父母不在時他喜歡捉弄、惡作劇他的妹妹。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 戲弄, 逗弄, 取笑, 招惹；搭配：likes to ___ and play jokes on his younger sister；tease sb about sth（拿某件事取笑某人，介系詞用 about）

詞彙題.stem: Elderly shoppers in this store are advised to take the elevator rather than the _____, which may move too fast for them to keep their balance.
詞彙題.stemZh: 建議這間店裡的年長顧客搭電梯而不要搭手扶梯，因為手扶梯的速度可能太快，讓他們難以保持平衡。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 電扶梯, 手扶梯；搭配：take the elevator rather than the ___；take／ride the escalator（搭手扶梯）；step onto／off the escalator（踏上、走下手扶梯）

詞彙題.stem: Upon hearing its master’s call, the dog wagged its tail, and followed her out of the room _____.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一聽到主人的呼喚，這隻狗就搖著尾巴，乖乖地跟著她走出房間。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 順從地, 聽話地, 服從地

詞彙題.stem: Since many of our house plants are from humid jungle environments, they need _____ air to keep them green and healthy.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於我們許多室內植物都來自潮濕的叢林環境，它們需要濕潤的空氣才能保持翠綠健康。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 潮濕的, 濕潤的；搭配：they need ___ air to keep them green；moist air／soil／skin（配的是含水分的那一類名詞）

詞彙題.stem: The skydiver managed to land safely after jumping out of the aircraft, even though her _____ failed to open in midair.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這位跳傘者從飛機跳下後，儘管降落傘在半空中未能順利打開，最終仍安全著陸。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 降落傘；搭配：her ___ failed to open in midair；a parachute opens／fails to open（傘打開或沒打開，主詞就是傘本身）

詞彙題.stem: The invention of the steam engine, which was used to power heavy machines, brought about a _____ change in society.
詞彙題.stemZh: 用來驅動重型機械的蒸汽機的發明，為社會帶來了一場革命性的變革。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 革命的, 革命性的；搭配：brought about a ___ change；a revolutionary change／idea／technology（劃時代的。bring about 的搭配見 93 學測第 11 題）

詞彙題.stem: To encourage classroom _____, the teacher divided the class into groups and asked them to solve a problem together with their partners.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了鼓勵學生在課堂上互動，老師將全班分組，讓他們與同伴一起解決問題。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 互動, 交流, 相互作用；搭配：to encourage classroom ___；interaction between A and B／interaction with sb（互動的對象用 between 或 with，不用 to）

詞彙題.stem: Lisa _____ onto the ground and injured her ankle while she was playing basketball yesterday.
詞彙題.stemZh: 麗莎昨天打籃球時跌倒在地，傷了腳踝。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 跌倒, 摔倒, 滾落, 倒塌, 暴跌（tumble 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：___ onto the ground and injured her ankle；tumble onto the ground／down the stairs（後面接的是往下摔的方向）

詞彙題.stem: Hundreds of residents received free testing _____ from the city government to find out if their water contained any harmful chemicals.
詞彙題.stemZh: 數百名居民從市政府那裡收到免費檢測套組，以確認自來水中是否含有害化學物質。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 套組, 成套工具, 全套裝備（kit 的複數）；搭配：received free testing ___；a testing／first-aid kit（檢測套組／急救箱）

詞彙題.stem: The 2011 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded _____ to three women for the efforts they made in fighting for women’s rights.
詞彙題.stemZh: 2011 年諾貝爾和平獎由三位女性共同獲得，以表彰她們為爭取女性權益所做的努力。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 共同地, 連帶地；搭配：was awarded ___ to three women；be awarded jointly to（共同頒發給）

詞彙題.stem: The company is _____ and making great profits under the wise leadership of the chief executive officer.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在執行長的英明領導下，這家公司蓬勃發展，獲利豐厚。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 繁榮, 蓬勃發展, 茂盛（flourish 的現在分詞）；adj. 繁榮的, 興旺的；搭配：the company is ___ and making great profits；a business／an economy／a culture flourishes（生意、經濟、文化蓬勃發展，這個字不接受詞）

詞彙題.stem: It is absolutely _____ to waste your money on an expensive car when you cannot even get a driver’s license.
詞彙題.stemZh: 連駕照都考不到，卻把錢浪費在昂貴的車子上，這實在是太荒謬了。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 荒謬的, 不合理的, 可笑的；搭配：it is absolutely ___ to waste your money；absolutely absurd／an absurd idea（荒謬本身已是極端語氣，程度副詞用 absolutely 不用 very）

詞彙題.stem: The problem of illegal drug use is very complex and cannot be traced to merely one _____ reason.
詞彙題.stemZh: 非法毒品使用的問題非常複雜，不能單純歸咎於單一原因。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 單一的, 單數的, 特別的, 奇特的

詞彙題.stem: The non-profit organization has _____ $1 million over five years to finance the construction of the medical center.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這個非營利組織已承諾在五年內投入一百萬美元，資助這座醫療中心的興建。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 犯（罪、錯）, 承諾, 投入（時間或金錢）, 將…送進（監獄或醫院）（commit 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 致力於…的, 忠誠的；搭配：has ___ $1 million over five years；commit money／funds／resources to + N（承諾投入經費，to 後面接名詞或動名詞）

詞彙題.stem: One week after the typhoon, some bridges were finally opened and bus service _____ in the country’s most severely damaged areas.
詞彙題.stemZh: 颱風過後一週，該國受創最嚴重的地區部分橋樑終於開通，公車服務也恢復了。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 重新開始, 恢復, 繼續（resume 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：bus service ___；resume work／service（復工／恢復通車）

詞彙題.stem: When Jeffery doesn’t feel like cooking, he often orders pizza online and has it ______ to his house.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑弗瑞不想煮飯時，常常在網路上訂披薩，讓外送送到家。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 遞送, 運送, 投遞, 發表（演說）, 兌現（承諾）（deliver 的過去式及過去分詞）

詞彙題.stem: Jane is the best ______ I have ever had. I cannot imagine running my office without her help.
詞彙題.stemZh: 珍是我遇過最好的助理，我無法想像沒有她的幫忙，我要怎麼經營我的辦公室。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 助手, 助理, 助教；搭配：the best ___ I have ever had；an assistant to the manager／a personal assistant（某人的助理用 to 不用 of）

詞彙題.stem: The temple celebrated Mazu Festival by hosting ten days of lion dances, Taiwanese operas, and traditional hand ______ shows.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這間廟宇舉辦了為期十天的舞獅、歌仔戲與傳統布袋戲來慶祝媽祖誕辰。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 木偶, 布偶, 傀儡；搭配：traditional hand ___ shows；a hand puppet show（布袋戲）；a puppet government（傀儡政權，這個字的另一個用法）

詞彙題.stem: The new vaccine was banned by the Food and Drug Administration due to its ______ fatal side effects.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這款新疫苗因可能致命的副作用，被食品藥物管理局禁用。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 可能地, 潛在地；搭配：due to its ___ fatal side effects；potentially fatal／harmful／hazardous（配的是「可能造成危害」那一類形容詞，hazardous 的拼字要留意）

詞彙題.stem: ______ the photos with dates and keywords help you sort them easily in your file.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為照片加上日期和關鍵字標籤，能幫助你在檔案中輕鬆整理它們。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 加標籤, 貼標籤, 標記（tag 的現在分詞）；搭配：___ the photos with dates and keywords；tag sth with + N／tag sb in a photo（標上資訊用 with，在照片裡標記某人用 in）

詞彙題.stem: An ______ person is usually pleasant and easy to get along with, but don’t expect that he or she will always say “yes” to everything.
詞彙題.stemZh: 隨和的人通常討人喜歡、容易相處，但別期待他/她對任何事都會說「好」。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 令人愉快的, 宜人的, 欣然同意的；搭配：an ___ person is usually pleasant；an agreeable person／manner（隨和、討人喜）；be agreeable to + N（同意某事，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Hidden deep in a small alley among various tiny shops, the entrance of the Michelin star restaurant is barely ______ to passersby.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這間米其林星級餐廳的入口藏身在滿是小店的巷弄深處，路人幾乎看不到。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 看得見的, 明顯的, 顯然的；搭配：the entrance is barely ___ to passersby；be visible to sb／visible from + 地點（看得見的對象用 to，從哪裡看得到用 from）

詞彙題.stem: The original budget for my round-island trip was NT$5,000, but the ______ cost is likely to be 50 percent higher.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我環島旅行原本的預算是新台幣 5,000 元，但最終花費可能會多出 50%。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 最終的, 最後的；搭配：the ___ cost is likely to be 50 percent higher；the eventual outcome／result／winner（配的是一連串過程之後的那個結局）

詞彙題.stem: After watching a TV program on natural history, Adam decided to go on a ______ for dinosaur fossils in South Dakota.
詞彙題.stemZh: 看完一個自然史電視節目後，亞當決定到南達科他州展開尋找恐龍化石的探索之旅。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 探索, 尋求, 調查；搭配：go on a ___ for dinosaur fossils；go on a quest for + N（展開尋找…之旅）

詞彙題.stem: With pink cherry blossoms blooming everywhere, the valley ______ like a young bride under the bright spring sunshine.
詞彙題.stemZh: 粉紅色的櫻花處處綻放，這座山谷在明亮的春日陽光下，彷彿新嫁娘般泛起紅暈。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 臉紅, 泛紅（blush 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：the valley ___ like a young bride；blush with embarrassment／blush at a compliment（因…而臉紅，不接受詞）

詞彙題.stem: The bus driver often complains about chewing gum found under passenger seats because it is ______ and very hard to remove.
詞彙題.stemZh: 公車司機常常抱怨在乘客座位下發現的口香糖，因為又黏又難清除。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 黏的, 有黏性的, 濕熱的, 棘手的；搭配：it is ___ and very hard to remove；a sticky note／sticky rice（便利貼、糯米）；a sticky situation（棘手的處境，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Jesse is a talented model. He can easily adopt an elegant _______ for a camera shoot.
詞彙題.stemZh: 傑西是位很有天分的模特兒，他能輕鬆擺出優雅的姿勢拍照。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 姿勢, 姿態, 裝腔作勢；v. 擺姿勢, 造成, 提出（問題）；搭配：adopt an elegant ___ for a camera shoot；strike a pose（擺姿勢，動詞用 strike 不用 do 或 make）；pose a threat／a problem to + N（造成威脅、帶來問題，這是動詞用法）

詞彙題.stem: In order to draw her family tree, Mary tried to trace her ______ back to their arrival in North America.
詞彙題.stemZh: 為了繪製家族族譜，瑪麗試著追溯她的祖先最初抵達北美洲的歷史。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 祖先, 祖宗（ancestor 的複數）；搭配：trace her ___ back to their arrival；trace one's ancestors／roots back to + 時間或地點（把祖先追溯到…）

詞彙題.stem: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost ______ and the stock nearly gone.
詞彙題.stemZh: 一發布強颱警報，南西就衝去超市，卻發現貨架幾乎都空了，存貨所剩無幾。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 赤裸的, 無遮蔽的, 空的, 僅最基本的；搭配：find the shelves almost ___；bare shelves／feet（空蕩蕩的貨架／赤腳）

詞彙題.stem: Even though Jack said “Sorry!” to me in person, I did not feel any ______ in his apology.
詞彙題.stemZh: 儘管傑克當面向我說了「對不起」，我卻絲毫感受不到他道歉的誠意。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 真誠, 誠懇, 誠心誠意, 誠實；搭配：did not feel any ___ in his apology；lack sincerity／doubt sb's sincerity（缺乏誠意、懷疑某人的誠意）

詞彙題.stem: My grandfather has astonishing powers of ______. He can still vividly describe his first day at school as a child.
詞彙題.stemZh: 我祖父有驚人的記憶力，他至今仍能生動地描述自己小時候上學第一天的情景。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 回想起, 記得, 召回, 收回；n. 記憶力, 召回；搭配：astonishing powers of ___；vaguely／dimly recall（隱約記得）；distinctly recall（清楚記得，正好相反。vividly recall 見 108 學測第 12 題）

詞彙題.stem: Recent research has found lots of evidence to ______ the drug company’s claims about its “miracle” tablets for curing cancer.
詞彙題.stemZh: 最近的研究找到大量證據，反駁該藥廠對其治癌「神奇」藥錠功效的宣稱。
詞彙題.explanation: vt. 反駁, 反擊, 對抗；搭配：evidence to ___ the drug company’s claims；counter a claim（反駁主張）

詞彙題.stem: Corrupt officials and misguided policies have ______ the country’s economy and burdened its people with enormous foreign debts.
詞彙題.stemZh: 貪腐的官員與錯誤的政策已重創該國經濟，使人民背負龐大的外債。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 嚴重削弱, 重創, 使殘廢, 使跛腳（cripple 的過去式及過去分詞）；搭配：have ___ the country's economy；cripple the economy／an industry／a system（重創，接的是體系或產業這一類）

詞彙題.stem: As a record number of fans showed up for the baseball final, the highways around the stadium were ______ with traffic all day.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於創紀錄的球迷湧入觀看棒球總決賽，體育場周邊的高速公路整天都塞滿了車潮。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 堵塞, 塞滿, 窒息, 哽住（choke 的過去式及過去分詞）；adj. 哽咽的；搭配：were ___ with traffic all day；be choked with traffic（塞得水洩不通）

詞彙題.stem: Studies show that the ______ unbiased media are in fact often deeply influenced by political ideology.
詞彙題.stemZh: 研究顯示，號稱公正客觀的媒體，實際上往往深受政治意識形態影響。
詞彙題.explanation: adv. 據稱, 據說, 一般認為；搭配：the ___ unbiased media；supposedly objective／neutral／independent（號稱、據稱，配的是「宣稱有、實際上未必」的那一類形容詞）；supposedly derived from（據稱源自…，derive 後面固定接 from，不用 of）

詞彙題.stem: People who desire a ______ figure should exercise regularly and maintain healthy eating habits.
詞彙題.stemZh: 想要擁有苗條身材的人應該規律運動，並維持健康的飲食習慣。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 苗條的, 纖弱的, 微少的, 微薄的；搭配：desire a ___ figure；a slender figure／build（苗條的身材）；a slender chance／hope（渺茫的機會，另一個意思）

詞彙題.stem: Watching the sun ______ from a sea of clouds is a must-do activity for all visitors to Ali Mountain.
詞彙題.stemZh: 觀賞旭日從雲海中升起，是每位造訪阿里山的遊客必做的活動。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 浮現, 出現, 露出, 顯露（emerge 的現在分詞）；adj. 新興的；搭配：watching the sun ___ from a sea of clouds；emerge from + N（從…浮現，介系詞固定用 from）；an emerging market／trend（新興市場、新興趨勢）

詞彙題.stem: Do you know what time the next bus is ______? I’ve been waiting here for more than 30 minutes.
詞彙題.stemZh: 你知道下一班公車預計何時到嗎？我已經在這裡等了超過 30 分鐘了。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 預定的, 預計的, 到期的, 應付的, 應得的；搭配：what time the next bus is ___；be due（預定到達，常接 at／in + 時間）

詞彙題.stem: The roasting heat and high ______ made me feel hot and sticky, no matter what I did to cool off.
詞彙題.stemZh: 炙熱高溫加上高濕度，讓我不管怎麼做都覺得又熱又黏。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 溼度, 潮溼, 溼氣；搭配：the roasting heat and high ___；high／low humidity（濕度高低用 high 與 low，不用 big 或 strong）

詞彙題.stem: Artwork created by truly great artists such as Picasso and Monet will no doubt ______ the test of time.
詞彙題.stemZh: 畢卡索、莫內等真正偉大藝術家創作的作品，無疑經得起時間的考驗。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 禁得起, 承受住, 忍受, 站立, 位於；n. 立場, 看台, 攤位；搭配：will no doubt ___ the test of time；can't stand + N／V-ing（受不了，後面接動名詞不接 to V）

詞彙題.stem: In some countries, military service is ______ for men only; women do not have to serve in the military.
詞彙題.stemZh: 在某些國家，兵役僅對男性強制實施，女性不需要服兵役。
詞彙題.explanation: adj. 強制的, 義務的, 必修的；搭配：military service is ___；compulsory education／military service（義務教育／兵役）

詞彙題.stem: The team complained that its leader always took the ______ for all the hard work done by the team members.
詞彙題.stemZh: 團隊成員抱怨他們的領導總是把大家辛苦的成果都攬為己有。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 功勞, 讚揚, 榮譽, 信用, 賒帳, 學分；v. 把…歸功於, 相信, 存入（帳戶）；搭配：always took the ___ for all the hard work；take the credit for + N（把…的功勞攬為己有）

詞彙題.stem: Located at the center of the city, the business hotel ______ not only good service but also convenient public transport.
詞彙題.stemZh: 這間位於市中心的商務飯店不僅保證提供優質服務，交通也十分便利。
詞彙題.explanation: v. 保證提供, 承諾, 答應（promise 的第三人稱單數）；搭配：the business hotel ___ not only good service；promise + N（保證提供…，可直接接名詞）

詞彙題.stem: As blood supplies have fallen to a critically low level, many hospitals are making an ______ for the public to donate blood.
詞彙題.stemZh: 由於血液庫存降到危急的低水位，許多醫院正呼籲民眾捐血。
詞彙題.explanation: n. 呼籲, 懇求, 上訴, 吸引力；v. 呼籲, 上訴, 吸引；搭配：making an ___ for the public to donate blood；make an appeal for + N（呼籲…）

詞彙題.stem: David felt disappointed when he found out that he could not choose his study partners, but would be ______ placed in a study group.
